1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E01 - Everybody Are Looking for Love
1.plot: As he mourns his late mother alongside his father Shulem, Akiva starts a new job where he meets a woman named Elisheva who diverts his attention.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E02 - Elisheva Agrees to Meet Akiva
1.plot: While Akiva looks to get better acquainted with Elisheva, his sister Giti tries to figure out her husband's whereabouts.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E03 - Shulem Pushes Akiva to Get Engaged
1.plot: Giti must secure a new opportunity in secret as Shulem urges Akiva to meet with a woman named Esti.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E04 - Giti and Akiva Find Jobs
1.plot: Akiva and Giti each consider a financial proposition while their brother Zvi Arye looks to resolve a pesky problem at home with his wife Tovi.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E05 - Akiva hasitates
1.plot: A major event leaves Akiva with second thoughts and troubles Shulem, who has other concerns about his co-worker Aliza.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E06 - Shulem Feels Guilt
1.plot: Shulem and Akiva deal with the repercussions of their fallout as Giti and her children cope with the realities of their home life.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E07 - Akiva's Portrait
1.plot: After a robber invades Giti's home, Shulem and Akiva both experience revelations at their respective jobs.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E08 - Oy No No
1.plot: An incident spurs Shulem to ponder his mortality as Akiva helps his friend after trying to connect with Elisheva.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E09 - The Baby
1.plot: In the pursuit of romance, Akiva and Shulem both take bold steps. Meanwhile, Giti faces resistance from her daughter Ruchami over family news.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E10 - The White Man
1.plot: A significant shift takes place at Shulem's school. A stipulation affects Akiva's marital status. Elsewhere, a familiar face returns.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E11 - Kolonia
1.plot: An admission leads to an unexpected outcome for Akiva, Giti privately wrestles with a life-changing choice and their grandmother faces hardship.

1.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S01E12 - Cry Here
1.plot: Lipa adjusts to home, Gitti takes a vacation. Shulem pushes his mother to give up the TV. Akiva tells Shulem about his agreement with Elisheva.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E01 - Lemons
2.plot: Shulem's brother Nuchem pays the family a timely visit with his daughter Libbi. Elsewhere, Giti and her husband Lippe respond to a peculiar ad.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E02 - A Very Important Friend
2.plot: While Libbi encourages Akiva to seek artistic inspiration, Giti and Lippe find themselves in a debate over a baby name.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E03 - Shteingletz and Shutenshtein
2.plot: As Giti struggles to forgive Lippe, Shulem and Nuchem investigate a matchmaking mystery involving Libbi.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E04 - Mauricio
2.plot: Ruchami and a student named Hanina become closer. Akiva and Libbi confront the tension in the air. Akiva's grandmother receives unfortunate news.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E05 - Love Pains
2.plot: After Akiva is awarded an arts residency, his acceptance speech takes a turn. Giti and Lippe deal with the ramifications of Ruchami's impromptu wedding.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E06 - Snow
2.plot: Matters of the heart lead Akiva and Shulem to each make rash decisions while Zvi Arye grapples with an important question on his mind.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E07 - The Lost Children's Good Will
2.plot: Akiva seeks space away from his father. Giti tries to facilitate a resolution for Ruchami's situation.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E08 - Jerusalem Customs
2.plot: Akiva gets immersed in the company of a fellow artist as the Shtisel family quickly comes together after a somber discovery.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E09 - The Consoled
2.plot: As the Shtisels mourn a loss, Akiva must choose between his career and family. Meanwhile, Giti and Lippe force an end to their conflict with Ruchami.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E10 - The Tragic Symphony
2.plot: Nuchem asks Shulem for help as Akiva faces a roadblock in his efforts to move forward with his life.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E11 - Concealment in the Concealment
2.plot: While artistic opportunities yield different results for Akiva and Zvi Arye, Giti and Lippe make some seismic changes within their own family.

2.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S02E12 - Last Of The Season
2.plot: A career triumph comes at a price for Akiva while Giti's family must come to terms with issues on multiple fronts.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E01 - White Flags
3.plot: Deep in grief, Akiva struggles to fit into the art world. Shulem makes a mistake, threatening his place in the Cheder. Yosa'le meets the wrong girl.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E02 - The Bird
3.plot: Shulem carves his own path, enraging the community. Hanina seeks guidance to break an impasse with Ruchami. Akiva tries to win back his paintings.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E03 - Public Telephone
3.plot: Yosa'le keeps getting calls, but the line is silent. Under pressure from Giti, he pursues meetings with Shira Levinson. Akiva makes a blunder.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E04 - First Smile
3.plot: Akiva finds a surprising savior to help with his daughter's situation. Ruchami makes a difficult decision. Shulem stumbles forth with Nechama.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E05 - White
3.plot: Yosa'le struggles with his feelings for the two Shiras. Ruchami and Hanina come to the same conclusion without realizing it. Lippe has an idea.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E06 - Cestrum Nocturnum
3.plot: Akiva panics when he finds himself getting closer to Racheli. Zvi Arie and Tovi have opposing perspectives. Shulem's heart aches, in different ways.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E07 - A Long Path that is Short
3.plot: Hanina is worried about Ruchami's predicament. Akiva and Racheli discover their truths by enacting a fiction for the social worker.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E08 - Mame, Mame
3.plot: Akiva is still blinded by his love for Libbi and can't fully see Racheli. Yosa'le reunites with the first Shira, but Giti disapproves.

3.title: FR - Les Shtisel : Une Famille à Jérusalem - S03E09 - Where Does Everyone Suddenly Go?
3.plot: Shulem has confrontations with Akiva, Racheli, Nechama and Nuchem. Ruchami fights for her life, and her baby's.

meta.plot: Shitsel raconte l’histoire tourmentée de Shulem, Malka, Giti et Akiva, Juifs haredis du quartier ultra-orthodoxe de Geula, à Jérusalem.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Michael Scofield, a structural engineer, attempts to rob a bank in order to get incarcerated at Fox River State Penitentiary, where his brother Lincoln Burrows, accused of murdering the Vice President's brother, is scheduled to be executed. At Fox River, Michael approaches a number of inmates, all of whom play an important role in his plan to free his brother from the inside. Meanwhile, agents Kellerman and Hale are determined to make sure the execution goes through as planned. Lincoln's son LJ gets into trouble.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E02 - Allen
1.plot: Michael seeks help of his fellow prison inhabitants to execute his escape plans.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E03 - Cell Test
1.plot: When Michael reveals his escape plan to Sucre, Sucre chooses to be no part of it, and requests a cell transfer. Michael gets a new cellmate called Haywire.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E04 - Cute Poison
1.plot: Veronica keeps uncovering new information regarding Lincoln's case and decides she wants to work on the case full-time.  When no one wants to help her on the case, Nick Savrinn (an attorney) offers his assistance and the two of them visit Lincoln.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E05 - English, Fitz or Percy
1.plot: Kellerman and Hale blackmail Warden Pope. Michael finds out he might get out earlier than anticipated. Veronica becomes uncertain of her allies.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E06 - Riots, Drills and the Devil (1)
1.plot: Michael creates a lockdown by sabotaging the air conditioning in order to execute his breakout plan properly, and unintentionally causes a riot that gets Sara into huge trouble. Meanwhile, an ex-con is blackmailed into seeing to that Lincoln is killed.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E07 - Riots, Drills and the Devil (2)
1.plot: While the riot intensifies, Abruzzi and Sucre join forces. Michael must decide whether or not to save the life of Dr. Tancredi.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E08 - The Old Head
1.plot: Michael finds out a storeroom fundamental to his escape plans has been converted into a break room. Veronica and Nick are being threatened.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E09 - Tweener
1.plot: Abruzzi's demotion in the prison hierachy puts the entire escape plan at risk. Michael finds himself in the uneviable position of trying to protect T-Bag's new "fish" and facing the threat of T-Bag exposing the plan to the guards. The inmates dig themselves into a hole.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E10 - Sleight of Hand
1.plot: Michael is forced to give up Fibonacci's location to Philly Falzone, and Kellerman and Hale get a little unwanted help to track down LJ who has gone missing. Veronica and Nick uncover evidence against the man Lincoln was convicted of murdering.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E11 - And Then There Were 7
1.plot: The escapees and Dr. Tancredi are shocked when they learn the identity of Michael's visitor, who brings with her a very important piece of the escape plan.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E12 - Odd Man Out
1.plot: Michael sees proof his plan is working, so he begins to overcome the last obstacle. As the escape draws near, the group tries to reduce its number by one and targets T-Bag.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E13 - End of the Tunnel
1.plot: With Lincoln's execution scheduled for the following day, Veronica comes out of hiding to contact him and gains an ally. Kellerman makes the ultimate sacrifice to preserve the conspiracy. Michael looks for a way to get Lincoln out of solitary confinement in time for the escape that evening. The inmates risk everything as they attempt their escape.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E14 - The Rat
1.plot: Veronica and Nick request a judge to postpone Lincoln's execution. A C.O. becomes suspicious about a broken door.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E15 - By the Skin and the Teeth
1.plot:
As Lincoln is about to be executed, he briefly sees his father in the viewing room. A phone call from judge Kessler delays the execution. After reviewing the newly surfaced evidence, the judge orders the exhumation of Steadman's body.

Michael creates a new, more dangerous, break-out plan, involving going through the prison yard. An accident puts Michael's new plan in danger.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E16 - Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Flashbacks shed light on the past actions that led to the incarceration of Lincoln, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note. Basis of Michael's ingenious break-out plan are revealed. Dr. Tancredi memorizes how she ended up in Fox River State Penitentiary.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E17 - J-Cat
1.plot: Lincoln is worried about Michael's sanity while Michael has trouble remembering some parts of the prison schematics. Sucre has to conceal the hole in the guard's break room. Warden Pope transfers Michael to solitary after he declines his request.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E18 - Bluff
1.plot: In an effort to recreate the missing piece of the tattoo, Michael gets transferred to the psych ward, seeking the help of Haywire. T-Bag and C-Note have to join forces.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E19 - The Key
1.plot: Michael must get the key to the infirmary and enlist the help of an old face, while Lincoln learns the identity of his kidnapper and another inmate learns of the escape.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E20 - Tonight
1.plot: Westmoreland wants Michael to speed up the planned escape, and gets Bellick one step closer to unraveling it. Michael has to decide whether to involve Sara in the breakout plan. Tweener's devotion is put to a test. Veronica finds out that her ally unexpectedly has a connection to an inmate serving time at Fox River.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E21 - Go
1.plot: Everyone's ready to make their escapes across the high wire. Veronica and Nick realize they may be in over their heads. And Agent Kellerman helps Vice President Reynolds calm down before her debate.

1.title: FR - Prison Break - S01E22 - Flight
1.plot: As the escape is in progress, Warden Pope and Captain Bellick begin a search to detain the escapees. Michael and co. have to reach the aircraft fast as the police is hot on their heels. Veronica discovers a major piece of evidence that could prove Lincoln's innocence. The Vice President is worried about losing her authority.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E01 - Manhunt
2.plot: As eight hours has passed since the escape, Michael, Lincoln, Sucre, C-Note and Abruzzi attempt to evade their seekers. Bellick is forced to relinquish the command of the search party to FBI Special Agent Alexander Mahone whose ingenious approach makes Michael's life as a fugitive harder. As a result from her overdose, Dr. Tancredi is in critical condition. A short-handed T-Bag faces the ultimate challenge.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E02 - Otis
2.plot: Mahone tries to lure the escapees by targeting an imprisoned LJ. Michael and Lincoln come up with a plan to free LJ from jail. Sucre, Abruzzi and C-Note have a plan of their own, but only to break free of their pursuers.Meanwhile, Bellick and Warden Pope feel the heat following their unsuccessful attempts to capture the escapees.Tweener infiltrates a bunch of college students on their way to spring break.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E03 - Scan
2.plot: Michael and a wounded Lincoln try to outmaneuver Mahone, who is hot on their trail. Sara gets a surprise visit to her bedside.Following his suspension, Bellick recruits a resolute partner to aid in his quest to get the escapees behind the bars.Sucre and C-Note head out for their family reunions-regardless of being observed by the authorities.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E04 - First Down
2.plot: Bellick, now teamed up with Michael, Lincoln and Nika, sets out to find the money stolen by Westmoreland during the 1971 skyjacking. Kellerman targets Sara, who receives a long-awaited phone call. T-Bag gets a ride from an unsuspecting family. Abruzzi resumes the search for Fibonacci to settle the scores once and for all.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E05 - Map 1213
2.plot: Michael and Lincoln are eager to locate the Double K ranch where Westmoreland hid his millions. Sucre goes to Las Vegas to prevent Maricruz from marrying his cousin Hector. C-Note gets on a train. Mahone is given an important package.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E06 - Subdivision
2.plot: Mahone takes an interest in the story of DB Cooper.In their quest to find Westmoreland's treasure, Michael and Lincoln travel house-to-house in Utah. Haywire's journey outside the prison walls continues. Sucre bumps into an acquaintance.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E07 - Buried
2.plot: Michael, Sucre, T-Bag and C-Note claim the hidden treasure.An anxious Lincoln risks everything to get to LJ. LJ grows wary about the easy getaway. Kellerman rethinks where his loyalties lie after Sara gets to The Company's hit list. Mahone results to deadly force to get the truth out of Tweener.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E08 - Dead Fall
2.plot: In his efforts to try to get hold of all of the money Sucre runs into some unexpected difficulties. And Captain Bellick and his partner have not given up on finding their old inmates.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E09 - Unearthed
2.plot: In an effort to learn more about his pursuer Michael cozies up to Mahone's wife. L.J. and Lincoln have a bumpy road-trip. T-Bag receives a surprise, and C-Note's wife must choose between her daughter and husband.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E10 - Rendezvous
2.plot: As Michael reunites with Sara, Mahone and Kellerman strive to make sure they stay apart.On the road with LJ, Lincoln meets his father. Sucre tries to contact Maricruz. T-Bag has a reunion of his own.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E11 - Bolshoi Booze
2.plot: As Lincoln tries to reunite with Michael, he has to say goodbye to another loved one. Michael attempts to obtain a getaway plane. T-Bag gets revenge. Sara and Kellerman face-off.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E12 - Disconnect
2.plot: With Mahone on their trail, Michael, Lincoln, their father, and Sucre make a run for the getaway plane. Michael's reunion with his father sheds light on his difficult childhood.The women in Bellick and Kellerman's lives coerce their men to confess their sins.A medical emergency forces C-Note to risk it all.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E13 - The Killing Box
2.plot: Bellick is anything but happy about his sudden homecoming-to Fox River.Elsewhere, Michael and Lincoln might face a homecoming of their own. Mahone and Kellerman use everything they got to make certain that Michael and Lincoln do not get through their road trip alive.Sucre's getaway plane encounters some difficulties. T-Bag closes on Mrs. Hollander.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E14 - John Doe
2.plot: Bellick gets a taste of the medicine he gave out when he was the Captain and Agent Mahone's ex-wife makes another appearance.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E15 - The Message
2.plot: In Mexico, Sucre gets a car but gets in trouble by the police. Bellick has more trouble as the new inmate as prisoners who suffered with him want revenge.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E16 - Chicago
2.plot: C-Note gets into a tricky situation when a robber holds up the diner he is in and demands everyone go into the storage room until the police arrive. Michael, Lincoln and Kellerman get closer to revealing the conspiracy with the help of Sarah. Mahone finds a new ally in Bellick.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E17 - Bad Blood
2.plot: Michael and Sara request Henry Pope's help to retrieve the information that will topple The Company.Mahone pins down an escapee. Sucre discovers a new threat while hitchhiking to reunite with Maricruz. T-Bag brings the Hollander family to his home.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E18 - Wash
2.plot: T-Bag digs deep and finds his 'nice-side' with the help of a psychiatrist. Michael, Lincoln, and Sarah get their hands on evidence needed to bring down The Company, while Kellerman is close to finding the President.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E19 - Sweet Caroline
2.plot: An unlikely alliance forms between Bellick and Sucre while Michael is determined to face the president. T-Bag gets into some trouble when he loses his luggage and C-Note faces major consequences after some of his actions.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E20 - Panama
2.plot: Sara sacrifices herself for the safety of Michael so the brothers can get on with their final plan to attain freedom, but their plan gets 'shipwrecked'. Meanwhile, Bellick blackmails Sucre to partner up as T-Bag's streak of murder continues to the south of the border.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E21 - Fin Del Camino
2.plot: The day has finally come for Sara's trial while critical information that will exonerate her is being debunked. Meanwhile, Michael is determined to get his hands on the 5 million and to stop T-Bag's reign of terror. Bellick is also money hungry and will do whatever it takes to hunt down T-Bag. Kellerman decides his fate while Lincoln and Mahone square off.

2.title: FR - Prison Break - S02E22 - Sona
2.plot: Michael tries to save his brother and himself from the unstoppable Mahone. Kellerman's testimony at Sarah's trial proves different from what was expected, could this be the end for Sarah? Sucre puts everything on the line to save his Maricruz. Just like old times, T-Bag and Bellick are at it again but this time there will be a winner.

3.title: FR - Prison Break - S03E01 - Orientación
3.plot: Now locked up in a Panamanian prison known as Sona, Michael, T-Bag, Bellick, and Mahone try to find a way out. Much to their devastation, they soon find out that the prison has been abandoned by the authorities because of the immense threat from the vile inmates. Michael seeks for an inmate named Whistler in the prison sewers. As Lincoln is puzzled by Sara's sudden disappearance, he learns that LJ has gotten into some trouble. He also tries to recover the 5 million dollars.

3.title: FR - Prison Break - S03E02 - Fire/Water

3.plot: Lechero's demotion devastates Michael's breakout plan as Sammy takes reigns at Sona. T-Bag forces Bellick to fight in a fight where the odds are stacked heavily against him. Lincoln and Sucre have some surprise fireworks set for Susan.

4.plot: Michael, Lincoln and Sucre must crash a police benefit to obtain the next card key. Reeling from another death, Sarah falls back into an old habit. T-Bag arouses suspicion and runs into some old “friends” his first day on the job.

4.plot: Self locates another card hidden in a safe within a secure federal building, as Mahone continues his quest for revenge. Meanwhile, T-Bag's new life may be in jeopardy.

Gretchen teams up with T-Bag who makes an offer to Michael he cannot refuse. Meanwhile, the secrets in Whistler’s bird book are finally revealed.

4.plot: Michael races against time and his ailing health to break into the Company headquarters to steal Scylla, but the break-in’s success lies with Sucre. 4.plot: Lincoln and his new partners arrive in Miami to recover Scylla from its shocking new owner, and Sara searches for a missing Michael who learns some surprising information about his past. Meanwhile, a double-crossing leads to a death and an arrest in "The Sunshine State."

4.title: FR - Prison Break - S04E17 - The Mother Lode
4.plot: Michael and Sara journey to Miami while Lincoln meets with his mother. T-Bag and Self's mission to locate Scylla takes a dramatic turn. The General comes under pressure.

4.plot: Michael and Lincoln come to blows over Scylla as Christina sets the wheels in motion for her plan. Meanwhile, Sara receives life-changing news. T-Bag arrives at the Indian Embassy. The General becomes increasingly paranoid.

4.title: FR - Prison Break - S04E19 - S.O.B.
4.plot: Michael's reunion with Christina is soured when she drops a bombshell regarding Lincoln, and T-Bag grows determined to prove he is worthy of being a member of the Company.

4.title: FR - Prison Break - S04E20 - Cowboys and Indians
4.plot: Pandemonium erupts at the hotel following the assassination, and Christina puts the final pieces of her plan together. Meanwhile, the General makes good on his threat, and Michael is forced to choose between saving either Lincoln or Sara.

4.title: FR - Prison Break - S04E21 - Rate of Exchange
4.plot: Familiar faces return to help Michael end his quest to bring down The Company once and for all.

4.title: FR - Prison Break - S04E22 - Killing Your Number
4.plot: Michael tries to bring down the Company once and for all.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E01 - Phase Six
1.plot: The crew of a lone naval ship try to save humanity when they discover a deadly virus has wiped out most of the population in the series premiere of this drama.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E02 - Welcome to Gitmo
1.plot: The crew members arrive at the Guantanamo Bay military base to collect food, fuel and medical supplies. When they come under attack by escaped Gitmo prisoners, they team up with a gruff private contractor to push back against the offensive.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E03 - Dead Reckoning
1.plot: The crew faces a new foe targeting Rachel and her research, leading Chandler to engage in a series of dangerous strategic maneuvers.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E04 - We'll Get There
1.plot: Chandler's leadership is put to the test when the ship's propulsion system is in danger of breaking down, the crew becomes overworked and exhausted, and Dr. Scott could potentially lose all of her research on the virus.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E05 - El Toro
1.plot: With Rachel close to a breakthrough on her vaccine, she, Chandler and XO Slattery lead a small team into the jungles of Nicaragua on a mission to find monkeys for her vaccine trials. While there, they find much more than they bargained for when they run across a former drug kingpin who will stop at nothing to maintain his stranglehold on his oppressed society. Chandler and his men find themselves in a huge moral dilemma over whether to eliminate this menace or take what they need and continue on with their mission.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E06 - Lockdown
1.plot: After returning from the horrors of Nicaragua, panic begins to spread throughout the ship when Lt. Danny Green comes down with a mysterious illness that could be the virus. Losing faith in Rachel and her failing vaccine trials, Chandler now has to deal with a restive crew. If he fails to keep the crew together, the whole mission is in jeopardy.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E07 - SOS
1.plot: After picking up a distress call near Jamaica, Chandler and a small team stage a rescue attempt. But a surprise attack leave Chandler and Tex stranded at sea. Slattery and the crew search desperately to find their lost at sea Captain and his comrade, hoping to do so before their enemies beat them to it.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E08 - Two Sailors Walk Into a Bar...
1.plot: With Chandler and Tex caught in a dangerous situation, Slattery has to step into the role as commanding officer. Torn between a mission with the fate of the world at stake and a Captain (and friend) in danger, Slattery has to find a way to get his people back without losing the most important asset: the vaccine prototype.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E09 - Trials
1.plot: Rachel and Chandler ask for six volunteers to participate in human trials of her vaccine, but the tests could be a living hell as the virus and the vaccine do battle inside their bodies. Meanwhile back in the States, Chandler’s wife and father are doing everything they can to keep their family alive.

1.title: FR - The Last Ship - S01E10 - No Place Like Home
1.plot: Chandler and his crew finally returns home, where a former D.C. power player is fending off a dangerous warlord who threatens her hopes of restoring law and order in society. Now with a location and a means to finalize their mission, Chandler sets out to save his dying family, only to discover something absolutely terrifying about this brave new world.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E01 - Unreal City
2.plot: After the horrifying revelations and reversals of fortune in Baltimore, Chandler and his fractured team join forces with an underground resistance in an attempt to defeat Amy Granderson. With doses of the cure running low, Rachel tries to do some good for the sick while remaining a prisoner at Avocet. Meanwhile, Slattery and the crew of Nathan James are in a race against time to save an injured Dr. Tophet and regain control of their ship.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E02 - Fight the Ship
2.plot: After the horrifying revelations and reversals of fortune in Baltimore, Chandler and his fractured team join forces with an underground resistance in an attempt to defeat Amy Granderson. With doses of the cure running low, Rachel tries to do some good for the sick while remaining a prisoner at Avocet. Meanwhile, Slattery and the crew of Nathan James are in a race against time to save an injured Dr. Tophet and regain control of their ship.

2.plot: The crew of Nathan James discovers that hospital ship USNS Solace was sent to sea to wait for Dr. Scott's cure. Captain Chandler sees an opportunity to add another ship to their fleet while Rachel is eager to find a lab better equipped to replicate the vaccine. When Solace fails to respond to radio communications, Chandler and his team board the ship...and come face-to-face with an unexpected enemy.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E05 - Achilles
2.plot: With a small group of survivors from Solace in tow, Chandler and his crew square off against an enemy of the most dangerous kind - a nuclear-powered submarine led by rogue British naval officers, Sean and Ned Ramsey. XO Slattery interrogates a captured mercenary from the hospital ship in an effort to extract information on the sub and its mission. As Nathan James engages in a perilous game of cat-and- mouse, the truth about the mercenary sub unfolds.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E06 - Long Day's Journey
2.plot: Chandler tracks a new threat to Northern Florida. Meanwhile, Rachel comes across a secret formula that her mentor, Dr. Hunter, had been perfecting.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E07 - Alone and Unafraid
2.plot: While XO Slattery struggles to evade a submarine, Chandler and his team infiltrate a compound on land.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E08 - Safe Zone
2.plot: Still trying to piece together Dr. Hunter's lost formula, Rachel grapples with her sworn enemy's presence on board the Nathan James.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E09 - Uneasy Lies the Head
2.plot: With Dr. Scott on the verge of a breakthrough, Chandler and his team set out to land in search of much needed supplies and materials for her lab.

2.title: FR - The Last Ship - S02E10 - Friendly Fire
2.plot: Rachel is hard at work on a new, more efficient version of the cure while Alisha decodes a message found on a recovered cell phone.

2.plot: After a message is broadcast implicating the Navy in a devastating disaster, Chandler looks to infiltrate the network and regain the trust of the American people.

2.plot: Nathan James finds itself trapped between the submarine and civilian blockades.

2.plot: With their mission now fully dedicated to spreading the cure, Nathan James puts a call out to civilians to meet at pre-selected ports across the country.

3.plot: Chandler faces his powerful enemy in a final showdown. Kara joins someone that can help with her mission.

3.plot: Chandler returns to America to find out what has really been happening.

3.title: FR - The Last Ship - S03E13 - Don't Look Back
3.plot: The fight for America comes to an end; Chandler faces a challenge that could change his life forever.

4.plot: The crew of Nathan James faces a threat that will test the limits of their Naval tactics and strategies.

5.plot: With nations being rapidly occupied, Chandler tries his hand at diplomacy to unite two hostile countries so they can fight a common enemy.

5.plot: Nathan James must seek the aid of a prominent rebel leader in order to create a staging area before mounting an invasion of their own.

5.plot: Pinned down after days of fighting, Vulture team must find their way into a secretive enemy camp.

5.title: FR - The Last Ship - S05E08 - Honor
5.plot: With a devastating hostage situation occurring back home, Chandler must devise the perfect plan to avoid losing everything.

5.title: FR - The Last Ship - S05E09 - Courage
5.plot: The crew of Nathan James begin preparations for what may be their most ambitious mission to date.

5.title: FR - The Last Ship - S05E10 - Commitment
5.plot: It is all out war as Chandler must face his fears and confront the greatest threat he has ever encountered.
