FR - LEGO: Jurassic World - Legend of Isla Nublar - S01E01 - Mission: Critical!
1.plot: Owen and Claire must rescue a theme-park reviewer from a sabotaged aerialtram… and a salivating T-Rex!

1.title: FR - LEGO: Jurassic World - Legend of Isla Nublar - S01E02 - Stampede!
1.plot: While stranded in the jungle during a massive storm, Claire and Simon unknowingly stumble upon a clue to the whereabouts of the treasure sought by Sinjin.

meta.plot: Set in 2012, three years before the Jurassic World movie, Owen Grady and Claire Dearing team up on Isla Nublar to deal with everything the Jurassic World park throws their way, including a mysterious saboteur who wants to destroy the park forever!

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E01 - Road to Knowhere
1.plot: The newly-christened Guardians of the Galaxy come into possession of a dangerous artifact that has Thanos’ new lieutenant, Korath, after them.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E02 - Knowhere to Run
1.plot: The Guardians struggle to subdue the suddenly-sprung-to-life Celestial head that is the Knowhere space colony, as well as storm Korath’s ship to rescue Quill, Gamora and the mysterious CryptoCube that holds the Cosmic Seed.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E03 - One in a Million You
1.plot: Feeling underappreciated, Rocket accepts an offer to work for The Collector, only to realize his “job” is working as another prisoner in The Collector’s collection.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E04 - Take the Milano and Run
1.plot: The Guardians crash land on a space station run by the Grandmaster, who schemes to get Drax back in the gladiatorial arena to battle his ultimate opponent: Gamora.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E05 - Can't Fight This Seedling
1.plot: When Groot is infected by a parasitic fungus, the Guardians must embark on a perilous journey in order to save him.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E06 - Undercover Angle
1.plot: Caught red-handed by Titus, the Guardians are coerced into infiltrating a notorious gang of weapons dealers known as the Black Order.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E07 - The Backstabbers
1.plot: Quill gets mixed up in a game of deceit when Gamora tries to pit her siblings, Nebula and Korath, against each other.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E08 - Hitchin' a Ride
1.plot: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits â€” fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E09 - We Are Family
1.plot: Rocket is abducted and taken back to his home planet, Half World.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E10 - Bad Moon Rising
1.plot: The Guardians encounter a living planet that's fallen under the control of a revived Ronan.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E11 - Space Cowboys
1.plot: The Guardians get caught up in a rivalry between The Collector and The Grandmaster.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E12 - Crystal Blue Persuasion
1.plot: The Guardians must help save the City of Attilan from Ronan.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E13 - Stuck in the Metal with You
1.plot: The Guardians find the Asgardian Destroyer Armor that leads to an epic battle pitting the Detroyer Armor against Drax the Destroyer.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E14 - Don't Stop Believin'
1.plot: Quill goes missing while following the Cryptocube's readings.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E15 - Accidents Will Happen
1.plot: The Guardians must stop Ronan's plan to blow up the Kree Supreme Intelligence.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E16 - We Are the World Tree
1.plot: In search of the Cosmic Seed, the Guardians unexpectedly find themselves in Asgard where they must outwit Thor and Angela in order to discover the seed's origins.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E17 - Come and Gut Your Love
1.plot: Following a falling out with his father, Star-Lord finds a ship containing the A.I. Rora as he takes it off of Spartax with the Drax the Destroyer and Groot providing a diversion for the Spartax Royal Guards. Afterwards, the Guardians of the Galaxy have to deal with Lucy and Supergiant who are jilted that Star-Lord is the Prince of Sparta.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E18 - Asgard War (1): Lightnin' Strikes
1.plot: When Asgard attacks Spartax, Quill and the Guardians become caught in the middle trying to expose the deception behind the conflict.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E19 - Asgard War (2): Rescue Me
1.plot: The Guardians and Asgardians team up to rescue Quill from Thanos.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E20 - Fox on the Run
1.plot: Gamora attempts to make amends for her past misdeeds only to find herself in a deadly trap set by Nebula, Ronan and the Grandmaster.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E21 - Inhuman Touch
1.plot: The Guardians pay the Inhumans a visit to learn more about the Cosmic Seed.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E22 - Welcome Back
1.plot: The Guardians discover that the Cosmic Seed is back on Earth. In the company of Cosmo, Star-Lord returns to his hometown where he runs into his childhood bully Michael Coogan who is now the sheriff. Now Star-Lord and the Guardians of the Galaxy must find the Cosmic Seed before Korath the Pursuer does.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E23 - I've Been Searching So Long
1.plot: When the Guardians of the Galaxy's search for the Cosmic Seed continues on Earth, Star-Lord contacts Gorgon where he gets the location of the former site of Attilan. While checking out the area, Rocket Raccoon, Groot, and Drax the Destroyer have visions of the Cosmic Seed energy helping them out like Rocket Raccoon's family being re-evolved, Groot being able to restore the Flora colossi, and Drax the Destroyer being able to see his family again. Even after fighting their way past the Cosmic Seed-enhanced worms and spiders, the Guardians of the Galaxy must keep Ronan the Accuser and Nebula from getting the box containing the Cosmic Seed.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E24 - I Feel the Earth Move
1.plot: Now that Thanos has the Cosmic Seed, he takes control of the Earth and molds it into his personal planetary weapon of mass destruction. The Guardians of the Galaxy must work to reclaim the Cosmic Seed from Thanos even when Ronan the Accuser and Nebula plan to dispose of Thanos with plans of having the Earth be destroyed alongside him.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E25 - Won't Get Fooled Again
1.plot: The Guardians discover that Yondu has been impersonating them in order to con unsuspecting victims.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S01E26 - Jingle Bell Rock
1.plot: The team stages a Christmas Carol inspired con-job in order to frighten a despot out of his ill-gotten riches and free his enslaved people.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E01 - Stayin' Alive
2.plot: While trying to dispose of Thanos' asteroid, the Guardians discover it has been taken to a secure facility that belongs to the Avengers.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E02 - Evolution Rock
2.plot: The Guardians and the Avengers team up to find out what powerful secrets lie inside Thanos' asteroid.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E03 - Lyin' Eyes
2.plot: When Rocket and Drax wake up with absolutely no memory of the night before, the Guardians must piece together their adventures.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E04 - Free Bird
2.plot: While the Guardians search for the missing sarcophagus, Groot finds a mysterious egg and does everything in his power to protect it.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E05 - Girls Just Wanna Have Fun
2.plot: When the Guardians are charged with escorting the young and rebellious Rigellian Princess Tana back home, Drax's hardened heart melts as he is reminded of his own daughter.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E06 - Black Helmet Woman
2.plot: After being infused with incredible power from a Nova Helmet, Gamora leads the Guardians and her sister Nebula on a mission to infiltrate the Believer flagship.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E07 - Right Place, Wrong Time
2.plot: Quill and Gamora battle the High Evolutionary, his minion hybrids and a teleport-hijacking Nebula.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E08 - Me and You and a Dog Named Cosmo
2.plot: Cosmo goes undercover on the Believer Flagship but loses his powers when his cover is blown.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E09 - Can't Get It Out Of My Head
2.plot: When the Believer Flagship embeds itself in Knowhere's brain, it causes a planetoid-wide telekinetic zombie outbreak.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E10 - Rock Your Baby
2.plot: When the cocoon opens and reveals a baby warlock inside, the Guardians have to step in to be a positive guiding force to keep his powers in check.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E11 - Symbiote War (1): Wild World
2.plot: The Guardians discover Groot's homeworld, Planet X, has been overrun by Symbiotes who will stop at nothing to get Groot's restarted World Pod for themselves to conquer the galaxy.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E12 - Symbiote War (2): I Will Survive
2.plot: As a comet covered in Symbiotes hurls toward Spartax, the Guardians must team up with Quill's sister to save the planet.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E13 - Symbiote War (3): Thunder Road
2.plot: When the Symbiotes escape to Asgard and venomize Thor, Odin and the other Asgardians, it is up to the Guardians to save them, the World Tree and all of existence.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E14 - Back in Black
2.plot: The Guardians meet Sam Alexander, an Earth teen experimenting with his father’s Nova helmet, but the Guardians aren’t the only ones who know of the helmet’s power.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E15 - Knights in Black Helmets
2.plot: The Guardians chase after J’son and Mantis as they try to manipulate Sam to do their bidding by promising him clues to the location of his missing father.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E16 - Nova Me, Nova You
2.plot: When the Nova Corps catch up with the Guardians and Sam, the fight reaches Sam’s hometown.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E17 - Mr. Roboto
2.plot: Searching for a weapon strong enough to match J’son, the Guardians seek out master boom-maker Ja Kyee.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E18 - Destroyer
2.plot: When the guardians travel to Drax's home planet in hopes of summoning Warlock, they discover Xeron seeks to destroy Adam and Drax's homecoming, which becomes a fight to protect his friends.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E19 - You Can't Always Get What You Want
2.plot: Rocket and Warlock travel to Halfworld to try and re-evolve Rocket's family.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E20 - I've Seen All Good People
2.plot: Gamora trains Warlock to be a strong and powerful warrior like herself. But when Gamora’s lessons become too intense, Warlock clams up and gets kidnapped by the Collector.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E21 - Another One Bites the Dust
2.plot: When Quill and Warlock are hunted by J'son and the Black Order, Quill teaches Warlock the importance of never letting himself slip into the path of evil.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E22 - It's Tricky
2.plot: During the Xandrian Feast of the Three Grinning Moons, the Guardians must pull a reverse heist by planting a dangerous weapon inside a Nova Corps vault.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E23 - You're No Good
2.plot: Warlock has gone dark! By absorbing J’son into his gem, Warlock has become Dark Warlock (Magus) with his sights set on conquering the galaxy, starting with Spartax.

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E24 - Behind Gold Eyes
2.plot: The Guardians and Nova battle Dark Warlock (Magus) and J’son on Planet Y. Can our heroes save their friend Warlock and the universe before it’s too late?

2.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S02E25 - Unfortunate Son
2.plot: In order to save the Guardians from the ruthless asteroid Korvac, Quill must bust J'Son out of prison on Spartax and in the process he sees a new side of his father.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E01 - Mission: Breakout
3.plot: The Guardians must work together to escape the elaborate prisons created for them by The Collector.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E02 - Back in the New York Groove
3.plot: The Guardians meet up with Spider-Man in New York City to defeat Thanos’ super-powered symbiote.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E03 - Drive My Carnage
3.plot: The Guardians team up with Spider-Man to battle Thanos, who has harnessed the power of the Carnage Symbiote to become the ultimate weapon.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E04 - I Fought the Law
3.plot: The Guardians have captured Thanos, but it's no easy task transporting the most wanted criminal in the galaxy.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E05 - Titan Up
3.plot: The Guardians chase Thanos and Sam Alexander (Nova) to Thanos’ home planet of Titan, where they discover a gladiatorial arena featuring Jesse Alexander - Nova’s father!

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E06 - Money Changes Everything
3.plot: The Guardians now have everything they ever dreamed of, but money can’t solve their problems.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E07 - Sisters Are Doin' It for Themselves
3.plot: Gamora decides to use her new riches to repay all of the people she has wronged throughout the years. When Nebula shows up, Gamora tries to teach her the value of doing good.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E08 - We Are the Champions
3.plot: Drax decides he no longer wants to be a Destroyer and looks into new occupations.

3.title: FR - Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy - S03E09 - Fame
3.plot: Quill starts his own talk show after beating Thanos! But to his dismay, everyone seems to hate it, especially the Grandmaster who is rigging the segments to destroy Quill.

meta.plot: Peter Quill is Star-Lord, the brash adventurer who, to save the universe from its greatest threats, joins forces with a quartet of disparate misfits — fan-favorite Rocket Raccoon, a tree-like humanoid named Groot, the enigmatic, expert fighter Gamora and the rough edged warrior Drax the Destroyer.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E01 - East Meets West (1)
1.plot: Vowing to stop Dragon Lord, Shredder's evil successor, wise Master Chung tells his daughter that she must join the Ninja Turtles to save humankind.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E02 - East Meets West (2)
1.plot: Venus De Milo arrives in New York and introduces herself to the Turtles. Then she reveals that she too was dropped into the toxic sludge at birth.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E03 - East Meets West (3)
1.plot: Venus leads the Turtles in meditation to help Splinter escape from his dream state, after which they practice martial arts to enter the Dream Realm.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E04 - East Meets West (4)
1.plot: The Turtles barely escaped the last time they were confronted by Dragon Lord. Now their nemesis has stolen the coveted Serum of Invincibility!

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E05 - East Meets West (5)
1.plot: Donatello and Venus have very different ideas regarding how to neutralize the Serum of Invincibility.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E06 - The Staff of Bu-Ki
1.plot: Dragon Lord reaches through the time warp to steal the Staff of Bu-Ki, an ancient relic with the power to destroy any and all shinobi spell-casters.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E07 - Silver and Gold
1.plot: When a series of high-profile bank robberies ravage New York City, the Turtles choose not to get involved right away.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E08 - Meet Dr. Quease
1.plot: One of Donatello's biggest idols in the world of science, Dr. Quease, is kidnapped by the dragons.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E09 - All in the Family
1.plot: While on an early-morning sewer jog, the Turtles discover a rare baby Turtle in the underground storage house of crazy poacher Simon Bonesteel.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E10 - Trusting Dr. Quease
1.plot: When Dragon Lord and Dr. Quease have an argument, Quease propositions Donatello, because he thinks they should work together.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E11 - Windfall
1.plot: When Michaelangelo finds a winning lottery ticket, he thinks his sewer days are over. But the others have already dreamt of ways to spend the money!

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E12 - Turtles' Night Out
1.plot: After an encounter with Bonesteel, Mikey comes up with an idea -- an all-night rave for animal rights where everybody dresses as their favorite beast.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E13 - Mutant Reflections
1.plot: Our heroes have a hard time sorting out who's who when their evil counterparts start popping up everywhere -- and they all look like the Turtles.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E14 - Truce or Consequences
1.plot: The dragons are tired of Dragon Lord's oppressive regime, and want to help the Turtles send him back into the mirror. Are they for real?

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E15 - Sewer Crash
1.plot: As Donatello is scanning the Web for information, someone breaks into his computer and sends him a coded message -- one that reprograms Donny's brain!

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E16 - Going Ape
1.plot: Raphael is enjoying one of his favorite pastimes -- harassing crazed poacher Simon Bonesteel -- when a platoon of Rank warriors join in the game.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E17 - Enemy of my Enemy
1.plot: When the Turtles stumble upon a man being attacked by dragons in Central Park, they are shocked to learn they've rescued someone from their past!

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E18 - King Wick
1.plot: When an alchemy accident gives Wick telekinetic powers, he not only uses it over the Dragon Lord, but he puts the Ninja Turtles to the test too!

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E19 - The Good Dragon
1.plot: When Venus's life is saved by one of the Dragon Lord's Rank warriors, the Turtles are forced to re-examine their views on dragons.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E20 - The Guest
1.plot: When his apartment burns down, Splinter's chess opponent moves in with the Turtles for a few days.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E21 - Like Brothers
1.plot: The continuing conflict between Raphael and Donatello comes to a head... again. This time, however, Mike and Leonardo get dragged into it.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E22 - Unchain My Heart (1)
1.plot: While the Turtles are busy evading Bonesteel, an old enemy of Chung I's arrives in New York to destroy Chung I's former student: Venus.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E23 - Unchain My Heart (2)
1.plot: Raphael and the Turtles go against the wishes of Venus and Splinter and return Vam Mi's heart. Yet the vampires are determined to destroy Venus.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E24 - Unchain My Heart (3)
1.plot: Bonesteel is sick and tired of the immortal bloodsuckers getting in the way of his efforts to capture the Turtles.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E25 - Unchain My Heart (4)
1.plot: With the Turtles being held hostage by Bonesteel, it's up to Splinter and Venus to defeat the vampires once and for all.

1.title: FR - Tortues ninja, La nouvelle génération - S01E26 - Who Needs Her
1.plot: When Venus accidentally traps someone in a forcefield, they begin to question her value to the team, recounting her numerous mistakes in the past.

meta.plot: Quatre petites tortues exposées à des produits radioactifs dans les égoûts de New York ont muté et deviennent des créatures intelligentes. Entraînées aux art-martiaux par leur maître Splinter, les Tortues Ninjas sortent la nuit, pour faire regner la justice. Une nouvelle menace nommée Dragon Lord arrive et les oblige à intervenir.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E01 - Outcasts
1.plot: It's a full moon and the three mermaids Nixie, Lyla and Sirena are tasked to guard Mako and the moon pool. While Zac and Cam go camping on Mako island. When Zac falls into the moon pool they don't know what to do and leave him on the beach. The next day Zac finds out what he is and what he can do so he tells Cam. Because the girls let the "land boy" as they call him in the moon pool they are being cast out by their pod. So they decide to fix the problem.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E02 - Getting Legs
1.plot: Sirena, Lyla and Nixie must turn Zac back into a land boy. Using Sirena's Moon Ring, they give themselves legs and walk on land to begin their task.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E03 - Meeting Rita
1.plot: In trying to get the Moon Ring back, the mermaids uncover Rita's secret.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E04 - Lyla Alone
1.plot: Nixie and Sirena won't help Lyla try to "zap" Zac's powers, so Lyla decides to do it alone. This misfires when a waitress spills a drink on Lyla and Lyla rushes to hide in the refrigeration room before she transforms into a mermaid! When she can't dry her tail, Nixie and Sirena must save her before she is discovered!

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E05 - Blizzard
1.plot: Lyla and Sirena attempt to use the Moon Ring to stop the rain, but instead make it snow indoors.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E06 - Dolphin Tale
1.plot: Joe, David's brother has bought a new boat and decides to take it out for a spin. His fish finder locates a dolphin, but that dolphin is actually Nixie.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E07 - Zac's Pool Party
1.plot: Zac's struggle with his merman secret intensifies when his girlfriend, Evie decides to throw him a pool party.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E08 - Zac's Return to Mako
1.plot: It's a full moon and the mermaids think that if they keep Zac out of the moonlight, he will lose his powers and return to his land-dwelling self. They stay with him in his garage on the full moon and attempt to keep him indoors.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E09 - The Siren
1.plot: While listening to Sirena sing, Lyla has an idea. If Sirena sings The Enchantment Song to Zac, he will fall under her spell. Everything goes south when David hears the song and falls in love with Nixie.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E10 - Zac Returns to Mako
1.plot: Against Nixie and Sirena's advice, Lyla goes with Zac to Mako Island. She steals Rita's Moon Ring to open the land entrance on Mako. But when the entrance suddenly closes, Zac and Lyla are trapped inside.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E11 - I Don't Believe in Mermaids
1.plot: The girls fear their pod will never return. A despondent Nixie gives "advice" to a young boy named Ben. Zac researches tridents online and Cam snoops. Rita tells Lyla and Sirena about the trident and a pod of mermen that rose up eons ago.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E12 - Close Call
1.plot: Zac continues to try to find the trident. Lyla focuses on keeping him from it. Rita won't keep giving the girls money so Sirena makes bracelets for the Café to sell. While Sirena gathers shell for them, Zac catches a glimpse of her tail.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E13 - Betrayal
1.plot: Rita and the girls worry about the upcoming full moon's effect on Zac.  Nixie thinks they should let Zac find the trident so they can take it  from him and hide it. Lyla thinks they should come clean with him so  he'll in hopes that he'll understand and stay away from it. While Lyla  warns Zac to keep away from Mako Island during the full moon, Evie sees  them holding hands and breaks up with him. Cam discovers that the girls  know Zac's secret but feels uneasy about them helping him. Under the  light of the full moon, Zac goes after the trident with the girls close  behind.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E14 - Battlelines
1.plot: Zac starts to wonder why their principle, Rita, is helping Lyla, Nixie, and Sirena.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E15 - Sirena's Secret
1.plot: David and Sirena's relationship continues to grow, while Nixie and Lyla are worried she won't want to return to the sea.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E16 - Truce
1.plot: Cam gets a new phone and films Zac swimming.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E17 - Moon Ring 2
1.plot: After finding a Moon Ring on the sea floor, Zac gives it to Evie. Now, the mermaids must get it back.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E18 - The Trident Job
1.plot: Zac is being watched by the mermaids, but with Cam's help he evades them.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E19 - Where's the On Button
1.plot: After acquiring the Trident, Zac doesn't know how to turn it on.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E20 - Nowhere to Hide
1.plot: Zac must find a place to hide the Trident from the Mermaids.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E21 - Aquata Returns
1.plot: Aquata returns saying Sirena can come back to the pod, but Lyla and Nixie can't.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E22 - Evie Times Two
1.plot: Rita's cat is turned into a human after walking through a bunch of mermaid powders.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E23 - Zac's Choice
1.plot: Zac leads Lyla to the Trident; they fight for control of it and Lyla is knocked unconscious.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E24 - Trust
1.plot: Lyla teaches Zac about mer history and the ocean but Nixie doesn't trust him.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E25 - Betrayed
1.plot: Nixie agrees to help Cam unlock the Trident, but Evie wants to come along.

1.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S01E26 - Decision Time
1.plot: Cam betrays Nixie after planning to become a merman and rule Mako.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E01 - The Seventh Cycle
2.plot: When the pod decides Zac is a threat and must give up his merman powers, two new mermaids, Mimmi and Ondina, are sent to make sure he obeys.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E02 - Sticky Situation
2.plot: With Evie now a mermaid, Mimmi and Ondina try a dangerous spell to change her back to a human form, but the results are less than ideal.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E03 - Discovery
2.plot: When Zac has a powerful vision about his connection to Mako Island, he and the mermaids visit the island to investigate.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E04 - A New Tail
2.plot: Erik's curiosity about the girls and Mako Island becomes a problem when he decides to investigate further.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E05 - Bad For Business
2.plot: When Evie's dad decides to take tourists on dive charters to Mako Island, the gang must find a way to change his mind.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E06 - Stormy Seas
2.plot: Sirena gives Evie mermaid lessons, which rubs Ondina the wrong way, while Erik tries to get to the bottom of Zac and Cam's falling out.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E07 - Awakening
2.plot: With the full moon approaching, Zac's plan to avoid Mako Island is dealt a blow when his father insists they go on their annual camping trip.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E08 - Land School
2.plot: When Mimmi goes to the first day of the new school year, things get out of hand fast when she runs afoul of the science teacher.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E09 - Stowaway
2.plot: When a young mermaid follows Ondina back to Mako Island after a mermaid council meeting, it could spell trouble with the pod.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E10 - Keeping The Secret
2.plot: When David sees Evie in the water as a mermaid, it puts Zac and the girls' secret at risk unless they can convince David he's wrong.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E11 - Only As Young As You Feel
2.plot: Ondina adds too much jellyfish extract to Mimmi's body lotion, and the results put Principal Santos in dangerous waters at the marine park.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E12 - Supersized
2.plot: When Mimmi loses her moon ring in the Ocean Café's cooler room, it creates havoc for David and his brother's business.

2.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S02E13 - Reunion
2.plot: On the night of the full moon, Zac and Erik swim to Mako Island and unlock the merman chamber, revealing a startling secret.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E01 - A Visit from the East
3.plot: Ondina is tasked with teaching the younger mermaids. A mermaid from China joins the pod. During a full moon ceremony, a terrifying beast emerges.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E02 - Seeing Is Believing
3.plot: When marine park workers are sent to investigate the reported sea monster, the mermaids must create a credible explanation to stop further inquiries.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E03 - Recipe for Success
3.plot: Weilan casts a knowledge transference spell on Zac to help him pass a biology test. But more than just science facts transfer from her body to his!

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E04 - Mopping Up
3.plot: When Evie tries using her new moon ring to magically finish her chores, things quickly get out of control. Joe makes an upsetting announcement.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E05 - The Puzzle Box
3.plot: Weilan comes up with the idea of using a Chinese puzzle box to trap the sea dragon. Cam panics when Carly suggests they take dance lessons.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E06 - New Beginnings
3.plot: Evie's moon ring lesson with Ondina takes an unexpected turn. At the marine park, Mimmi discovers the reason for a rescued dolphin's distress.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E07 - Turning the Tide
3.plot: Zac begs Weilan to teach him an Eastern spell few have mastered, which he hopes to use against the dragon. Joe encounters a water ball.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E08 - The Way of the Dragon
3.plot: On the eve of the full moon, Ondina and Mimmi defy Veridia's orders. Evie becomes suspicious when she spots Zac and Weilan meeting in secret again.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E09 - Reversal of Fortune
3.plot: After overhearing Ondina blaming her for Evie's loss, Weilan runs off. Meanwhile, Mimmi and Ondina combine their powers to try to restore Evie.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E10 - Wishful Thinking
3.plot: Zac realizes a shell he found has magical powers, and he accidentally sends the mermaids back in time five years, where they meet his younger self.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E11 - Lost and Found
3.plot: While Ondina teaches the little mermaids to walk on land, her fastest-learning student wanders off and soon runs into Chris and Karl on the beach.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E12 - Trust Issues
3.plot: When Mimmi and Chris go on a date at the beach, Ondina goes to great lengths to protect her. Cam tries to lure more upscale customers to the cafe.

3.title: FR - Les sirènes de Mako - S03E13 - Letting Go
3.plot: Mimmi and Zac are startled by a mysterious yet strangely familiar vision. Cam's dual role as Carly's boss and boyfriend becomes difficult to manage.

meta.plot: Zac, 16 ans, décide de camper avec son ami, Cam, sur la mystérieuse île de Mako. Il trouve une ouverture dans la roche et tombe. Chargées de défendre cette roche volcanique, trois sirènes le sauvent. Le lendemain, Zac découvre qu'il est devenu triton doté de pouvoir surnaturels. 1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E01 - The Wives Celebrate
1.plot: When Yeong-jae gets accepted into a top medical school, his mom becomes the envy of the other mothers, who all want to know just how she managed it.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E02 - Yeong-jae’s Tablet
1.plot: While everyone’s still reeling from the shock of what happened, a new family whose background and values seem very different moves into Sky Castle.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E03 - Winds Of Change In Sky Castle
1.plot: Han Seo-jin confronts the entrance exam coordinator. Lee Su-im joins the Sky Castle reading group, but it’s nothing like what she expected it to be.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E04 - Seo-jin’s Crumbling Pride
1.plot: Sky Castle is abuzz about the pending vote but Cha Min-hyeok is confident. Seo-jin will do anything for Ye-seo – and stoop as low as deemed necessary.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E05 - At Any Cost
1.plot: Seo-jin runs into Yeong-jae and tries to talk to him. Su-im ponders what to do about Ye-bin. No Seung-hye and Min-hyeok scramble to formulate a plan B.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E06 - Meritocracy
1.plot: Seung-hye challenges Min-hyeok head on. Seo-jin thinks that she’s fixed things but doesn’t count on Kang Jun-sang. Ye-bin finds an unlikely confidante.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E07 - Never-ending Rivalry
1.plot: Su-im and Ye-bin are stunned by what they uncover. Seung-hye and Su-im speculate about Yeong-jae and his family. Kim Ju-yeong puts Ye-seo in her place.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E08 - At Gunpoint
1.plot: Running mates Kim Hye-na and Hwang U-ju are the favorites in the school election, but Seo-jin colludes with Min-hyeok to ensure that their kids win.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E09 - A Celebration Party
1.plot: Kang Jun-sang delights in Seo-jin’s plan to host a dinner as an occasion to gloat over the other couples, but things get heated over Su-im’s new book.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E10 - Kwak Mi-hyang’s Reveal
1.plot: Seo-jin incenses Kim Ju-yeong with her reply, and leads the charge against Su-im, but pays a heavy price for her shortsightedness in more ways than one.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E11 - Hye-na’s Arrival
1.plot: Seo-jin relents and has Hye-na move in as Ye-bin’s tutor, but makes a startling discovery. Su-im meets Yeong-jae’s father to get his side of the story.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E12 - Another Daughter
1.plot: Su-im hears a strange fact about Kim Ju-yeong. Seo-jin’s fury boils over. Min-hyeok basks in his daughter’s stories, but Seung-hye spots something odd.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E13 - Coach Kim’s Past
1.plot: Crushed by the truth about Se-ri’s life in Cambridge, Seung-hye fears the repercussions of Min-hyeok finding out. Su-im gets a request from Yeong-jae.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E14 - Ye-seo In Coach Kim’s Grasp
1.plot: Seo-jin lambastes Kim Ju-yeong but realizes she’s no match for her own daughter’s insolence. Seung-hye reflects on her choices and takes a stand.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E15 - Hye-na’s Death
1.plot: Hye-na is rushed to the hospital, but Jun-sang orders Hwang Chi-yeong to operate on another patient. Seo-jin asks Ye-seo what she did at the party.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E16 - U-ju’s Arrest
1.plot: Not caring if U-ju is sacrificed, Seo-jin begs Kim Ju-yeong to save her daughter, but Ye-seo insists he’s innocent. Su-im infers a sinister motive.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E17 - Devastated Jun-sang
1.plot: Jun-sang reproaches Seo-jin and his mother about Hye-na. Seo-jin has harsh words for Kim Ju-yeong but has only one thing on her mind: Ye-seo’s future.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E18 - No Option
1.plot: Jun-sang wants to go to the police and exonerate U-ju, but Seo-jin won’t let him. Seung-hye doesn’t want to live with Min-hyeok – and the kids concur.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E19 - Seo-jin’s Confession
1.plot: Su-im pleads with Seo-jin, who remains determined. Ye-bin tells her mother what she thinks of her. U-ju wants to know why he should forgive Seo-jin.

1.title: FR - SKY Castle - S01E20 - Goodbye, Sky Castle
1.plot: U-ju announces he’s taking a break from school. Jun-sang resigns and Seo-jin readies to leave Sky Castle. Seung-hye prevails and Su-im’s book comes out.

meta.plot: For the families living at Sky Castle, an exclusive residential community that's home to Korea's elite, their children’s success means everything.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E01 - Storm Clouds Gather
1.plot: Pressured by his father and mocked by his peers, 15-year-old Tiuri competes to become a Knight of Dagonaut - just as the kingdom faces a dark threat.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E02 - Isn't She a Sweetheart?
1.plot: With the Red Riders and Novices hot on his trail, Tiuri makes his way to Mistrinaut, where the mayor's daughter takes a keen interest in his mission.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E03 - At the End of the World
1.plot: The Red Riders drive their captives high into the snowy mountains. Caught in a storm, Tiuri and Lavinia take shelter inside an ominous monastery.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E04 - Danger Knights
1.plot: On a ship headed toward Unauwen, Tiuri and Lavinia meet a mysterious passenger who seems to know the secret of Tiuri's past - and his destiny.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E05 - Spiral
1.plot: Ardanwen guides the group to an eerily empty town. Lavinia helps Tiuri practice controlling his powers. A startling discovery divides the Novices.

1.title: FR - L'Écuyer du Roi - S01E06 - When the Blood Moon Rises
1.plot: As the Blood Moon nears and Viridian prepares for his homecoming, Tiuri and friends wrestle with doubt, betrayal and a daunting final test.

meta.plot: Entre anciennes prophéties, pouvoirs magiques et compagnons capricieux, un jeune apprenti chevalier se lance dans une aventure épique pour sauver son royaume.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E01 - #BlackPeopleDontGoToTherapy
1.plot: After Sasha moves in with Brian, a mortifying misunderstanding with a therapist forces them to confront their issues with each other.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E02 - #Godastamaste
1.plot: When Sasha reveals she doesn't believe in God, the family takes her to a church service led by an extravagant reverend. Later, she confides in Stacy.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E03 - #YeezysAndShrimp
1.plot: Waiting in line to cop exclusive kicks, Sasha struggles to keep it low-key when Brian shows up with a tent, grill and karaoke machine.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E04 - #NipplesOrNuts
1.plot: Brian tracks Sasha on his phone and catches her in a lie. When he sees Brodie with other girls, he takes matters into his own hands.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E05 - #TheMotherPucker
1.plot: Sasha's social media video goes viral when a new BAY Cosmetics product causes an adverse reaction — and Brian becomes an Internet sensation himself.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E06 - #ThrillaOnTheGrilla
1.plot: At the family’s annual Juneteenth cookout, Pops faces off against his siblings for a BBQ showdown. Sasha sneaks off to a block party with Brian's truck.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E07 - #RichDadWokeDad
1.plot: Inspired by Floyd Mayweather's book, Brian switches up his parenting style. But when Sasha acts strangely, Brian looks to a drug test for answers.

1.title: FR - Arrête Papa, tu me fais honte ! - S01E08 - #MaybeItsBAYBelline
1.plot: Brian receives an unexpected business offer. Pops tries online dating. After being racially profiled, Sasha and her friends are harassed by police.

meta.plot: Un père célibataire, propriétaire d'une marque de cosmétiques, découvre la paternité sur le tas lorsque sa fille adolescente au caractère bien trempé emménage avec lui.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Drew, a recently divorced father, discovers he needs a kidney and finds his donor in the last person he ever would've imagined.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E02 - Die Alysis
1.plot: When Drew's condition worsens, he needs to make sure Gina is still serious about donating her kidney and winds up making her an offer she can't refuse.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E03 - Foreign Bodies
1.plot: As Gina makes herself at home in Drew's house, Drew begins to question whether he made the right decision.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E04 - Joint Pain
1.plot: After Drew goes through a rough divorce mediation with Julia, Gina gives him a surprise to boost his spirits.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E05 - High Risk Factor
1.plot: Drew downloads a tracking app to keep an eye on Gina after he begins getting concerned about her reckless behavior.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E06 - Open Heart Surgery
1.plot: Gina needs to keep herself together to pass a psych evaluation while dealing with the news of an ex's engagement.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E07 - Phantom Limb
1.plot: After missing Maddies soccer game due to dialysis, a depressed Drew begins to question if all his sacrifices are worth it.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E08 - Integration Therapy
1.plot: Drew realizes he lost all of his friends after his divorce, which prompts Gina to throw a party for his dialysis group.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E09 - B Negative (1)
1.plot: Drew and Gina start thinking about their futures after Jerry gets a surprise call that he's receiving a new kidney.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E10 - B Negative (2)
1.plot: Drew falls into a deep depression after a friend's failed kidney surgery, and it's up to Gina to help him out of it.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E11 - Recessive Gina
1.plot: Gina takes Drew and Norma on a road trip to track down her father's medical records.

1.title: FR - B Positive - S01E12 - Canine Extraction
1.plot: Gina has three days to teach Cannoli the dog new tricks before his owner returns from overseas. Also, Drew must deal with Maddie growing up, at a new time.

meta.plot: Faced with finding a kidney donor, newly divorced dad Drew is at the end of his rope when he runs into Gina, a rough-around-the edges woman from his past who volunteers her own. Together they form an unlikely bond and begin a journey that will change both of their lives.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A young woman discovers she has the ability to hear the innermost thoughts of people around her as songs and musical numbers.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E02 - Zoey's Extraordinary Best Friend
1.plot: Zoey tries to figure out how to control her new abilities while navigating her best friends’ romantic feelings for her. A new medical victory for Mitch gives the family hope.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E03 - Zoey's Extraordinary Boss
1.plot: Zoey must decide whether or not to get involved in her boss Joan's troubled marriage after she hears Joan sing a heart song. Also, Zoey creates a new program for the family to communicate with Mitch, but his first word is not what they expected.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E04 - Zoey's Extraordinary Neighbor
1.plot: Zoey is forced to address her own faith and why she was given these powers as she attempts to help Mo feel comfortable expressing his true self. David creates a “big moment” for Mitch.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E05 - Zoey's Extraordinary Failure
1.plot: After hearing her first duet, Zoey gets a little too involved in her brother's marriage. Leif receives negative feedback at work. Maggie is offered an enticing work opportunity.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E06 - Zoey's Extraordinary Night Out
1.plot: Things get complicated for Zoey at Simon's engagement party. Maggie has a night out alone, but it doesn't go as planned.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E07 - Zoey's Extraordinary Confession
1.plot: Zoey is forced to admit some hard truths to Max. Tobin worries his friendship with Leif is on the rocks. Mo struggles to communicate with the new man in his life.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E08 - Zoey's Extraordinary Glitch
1.plot: After receiving heartbreaking news, Zoey suffers a mysterious “glitch” in her powers.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E09 - Zoey's Extraordinary Silence
1.plot: Zoey tries to help Mitch’s caregiver, Howie, reconnect with his estranged daughter. Max must make a decision about his future at SPRQ Point.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E10 - Zoey's Extraordinary Outburst
1.plot: Zoey surprisingly finds herself getting into major conflict with Simon, Max, Mo and even Howie. Tensions arise at SPRQ Point when the fourth and sixth floors compete over an important piece of code. Mitch and Maggie try to celebrate their anniversary.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E11 - Zoey's Extraordinary Mother
1.plot: Zoey has to figure out a clever way to help her mother with an impossible decision. Max unexpectedly bonds with Leif. Mo hits a rough-patch with Eddie.

1.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S01E12 - Zoey's Extraordinary Dad
1.plot: After hearing an ominous song, Zoey does everything in her power to stop something bad from happening.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E01 - Zoey's Extraordinary Return
2.plot: Zoey returns to the world after an extended time away and discovers that a lot has changed at work and in her personal life in her absence.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E02 - Zoey's Extraordinary Distraction
2.plot: Zoey's attempts to spend private time with Max are continually thwarted by both Mo and work problems. The Clarke family gets a new guest when Emily's sister, Jenna, comes to "help" with the baby.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E03 - Zoey's Extraordinary Dreams
2.plot: Zoey is haunted by bad dreams that start to affect her personal life. Jenna helps Maggie find her creative spark again.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E04 - Zoey's Extraordinary Employee
2.plot: Zoey tries to "choose happiness" but finds it is easier said than done. David re-evaluates his priorities. Mo and Max face their first real challenge as business partners.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E05 - Zoey's Extraordinary Trip
2.plot: Zoey decides to explore her rebellious side with her neighbor from growing up, Aiden. Max's dad comes to visit.

2.title: FR - Zoey et son incroyable playlist - S02E06 - Zoey's Extraordinary Reckoning
2.plot: Simon wrestles with his future at SPRQ Point after calling out racial bias at the company. Mo and Max pitch a new investor for their business venture.

meta.plot: Zoey, dont le père Mitch est atteint d'une maladie neurologique, passe un IRM, craignant de développer elle-même des symptômes. Un tremblement de terre survient pendant l'examen. Zoey se met alors à "entendre" les pensées des gens sous forme de chansons. Cette nouvelle aptitude lui permet d'approcher Simon, un collègue de travail dont elle est amoureuse et de communiquer avec son père. Mais elle découvre également que Max, son meilleur ami, est secrètement amoureux d'elle. Elle gagne la course à la promotion organisée par sa patronne, Joan, en trouvant l'origine du bug qui empêchait la sortie de la nouvelle appli de son entreprise.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E01 - A Bunch of Smart Orphans
1.plot: A good-hearted, unusually gifted orphan named Reynie Muldoon enters a competition to win a scholarship to the prestigious Boatwright Academy. While undergoing a grueling series of tests, Reynie joins forces with two other uniquely gifted orphans, Sticky Washington and Kate Wetherall, and the three of them work together to tackle the challenges in their path. The children are introduced to a fourth gifted orphan, Constance Contraire, and finally to the enigmatic Mr. Benedict.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E02 - Carrying a Bird
1.plot: Mr. Benedict lays out the world-changing stakes of his top-secret mission to Reynie, Sticky, Kate, and Constance: The Emergency is out of control, and the only way to stop it is to infiltrate the mysterious L.I.V.E. Institute on Harbor Island. Our young heroes embark on an undercover operation as transfer students at the school, and learn to navigate unfriendly fellow students, bizarre, nonsensical classes, and a shockingly familiar Headmaster.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E03 - Depends on the Wagon
1.plot: The kids of the Mysterious Benedict Society come to a grim realization about Dr. Curtain’s methods of keeping secrets. They also learn the dire consequences to the mission if they were to slip to the bottom of their classes: they would be kicked out. After receiving a message from the children, Mr. Benedict and his crew investigate his possible connection to Dr. Curtain. The children resolve to learn more about the elite Messenger program at the school.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E04 - A Whisper, Not a Shout
1.plot: The children make a risky play to search for clues right under Dr. Curtain’s nose. Mr. Benedict and Milligan head out into rugged terrain to do some recon of their own. Rhonda and Number Two butt heads about their unique approaches to fighting The Emergency. Sticky gets caught trying to help Kate cheat, and finds out the next phase of Dr. Curtain’s insidious plot. Kate suffers a blow to her academic standing but finds a saving grace in Martina Crowe and her tetherball team.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E05 - The Art of Conveyance and Round-Trippery
1.plot: Reynie and Sticky investigate secret transmissions. Constance and Kate explore the island.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E07 - The Dance of the Celestial Orb
1.plot: Kate embarks on a rogue mission into Dr. Curtain’s secret lab which ends in disaster. Mr. Benedict, Number Two, and Rhonda decide to take matters into their own hands. Reynie accuses Sticky of being taken in by Dr. Curtain’s charismatic ways, while Kate’s deception makes Martina a target. Reynie is called into Dr. Curtain’s office for interrogation. Constance’s unique sensitivity to the Whisperer comes to a head, and the team realizes that their time is running out.

1.title: FR - Le Mystérieux Cercle Benedict - S01E08 - Big Day Today
1.plot: Mr. Benedict, Rhonda, and Number Two arrive at The Institute, ready to take down Dr. Curtain and his minions. The kids form an elaborate plan to destroy the Whisperer once and for all. Milligan’s shocking connection to Dr. Curtain is revealed. Dr. Curtain prepares to take an aggressive step forward in The Improvement. The kids, Benedict’s team, and Dr. Curtain face off in a climactic final showdown, the fate of society itself hanging in the balance.

meta.plot: Un groupe d’orphelins infiltré dans un internat s’efforce de contrecarrer un projet machiavélique d’ampleur planétaire et se découvre par la même occasion une nouvelle famille...

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Before Sam and Dean, there were their parents, John and Mary. This is the untold love story of how they met and put it all on the line to save the entire world.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E02 - Teach Your Children Well
1.plot: John and Millie are on different pages about his new interest in hunting and Ada tries to bridge the gap. Mary follows a trail from her father that points to the disappearance of a teenage boy in Topeka. Meanwhile, Carlos has a heart to heart with Mary as Latika dives into her books to identify the monster.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E03 - You're Lost Little Girl
1.plot: When Mary's next-door neighbor mysteriously goes missing, she and John start digging into the disappearance. During their investigation, John unexpectedly reunites with someone from his past. Carlos and Ada bond as they stakeout a potential lead for the demon's partner. Meanwhile, Latika taps into old folklore passed down from her family in hopes it helps Mary and John.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E04 - Masters of War
1.plot: After the details of a veteran's death don't add up, Carlos brings everyone in to investigate and he shares a detail about his past that makes John see him in a new light. Mary finds an unexpected ally who has been hot on the trail of this monster and Latika tries to help Mary heal and find closure with someone she lost. Meanwhile, John's habit of running headfirst into danger leaves Millie worried for her son.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E06 - Art of Dying
1.plot: Mary gets a call from an old family friend who's looking for some help but when the team arrives, they learn that some crucial details were left out.  While Latika struggles with being a Hunter and questions her future with it, John's eagerness, and commitment to the Hunt worries Mary. Carlos finds himself in a situation he's never experienced before and doesn't know what to do with himself.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E07 - Reflections
1.plot: The Hunt heats up and Mary and John find trails that lead back to their fathers. Carlos helps Mary investigate where the Akrida might be hiding but they discover more than they bargained for. Meanwhile, Millie steps in to help Latika, Ada, and John to decipher notes left behind and they stumble upon a way to get some answers.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E08 - Hang On to Your Life
1.plot: With some intense emotions still lingering after their high stakes recovery mission, Mary and John stay close to home to watch over a newly returned Samuel Campbell. When Latika and Carlos split off to investigate the death of a musician, Carlos is forced to face a part of his past he has been avoiding. Millie spends time helping Samuel recover from his injuries and learns a little more about the Men of Letters.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E09 - Cast Your Fate to the Wind
1.plot: When Vampires make their way into Lawrence, Carlos corrals the gang to find out why. Latika's weeks of sorting through the Men of Letters clubhouse provides vital information when John gets a scary glimpse into the future and enlists Millie's help with his plan. Meanwhile, Mary struggles with the tedious balance between feelings and action when it comes to John.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E10 - Suspicious Minds
1.plot: While Carlos talks through a problem in his personal life, it gives Latika a new idea about how to find the Akrida Queen. Millie's new security system for the Clubhouse proves helpful when Mary and John find an unexpected guest inside. Meanwhile, Latika's idea brings her and Carlos face to face with an unexpected ally.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E11 - You've Got a Friend
1.plot: In the aftermath of the fight with Golem, Carlos, Mary and Latika are cleaning the clubhouse when they hear a noise from outside. They creep out to investigate and spot a figure but can't quite make it out until it turns, and they are shocked to see John standing before them, covered in blood.  Meanwhile, Carlos and Latika set out in search of something important.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E12 - The Tears of a Clown
1.plot: Mary and John's tense discussion is interrupted when Carlos and Latika arrive to discuss a mystery involving a creepy clown. Meanwhile, Ada makes an interesting discovery.

1.title: FR - The Winchesters - S01E13 - Hey, That's No Way to Say Goodbye
1.plot: John receives a message from a mysterious stranger. Meanwhile, Carlos, Latika and Ada work together to find answers, but time is running out. Lastly, Mary and John have a warm but awkward reunion. There is a lot to unpack, but they realize this isn't the time or place.

meta.plot: Before Sam and Dean, there was John and Mary. Told from the perspective of narrator Dean Winchester, this is the epic, untold love story of how John met Mary, and how they put it all on the line to not only save their love, but the entire world.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E01 - Stop Living
1.plot: When Mel's best friend deserts her on her birthday, she tries to salvage the day with a gift that knocks her out and wakes her up.

1.title: FR - How to Die Alone - S01E02 - Lie and Deny
1.plot: Still in pain from her accident, Mel and Rory go on a prescription drug hunt in the airport's underbelly.

2.title: FR - Minuit au Pera Palace - S02E08 - Episode 8

6.title: FR - Voltron: Legendary Defender [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S06E05 - The Black Paladins

8.plot: Flashbacks shine a light on Honerva's past with Lotor and Zarkon, revealing the motivation for her recent actions.

8.plot: The crew heads to the planet Drazan to participate in the festivities of Clear Day, but Allura is plagued by nightmares when she stays behind to rest.

8.plot: The Paladins travel into an expansive void accessed through Allura's mind, where they encounter frightening spirits and cursed souls.

8.title: FR - Voltron: Legendary Defender [MULTI-SUB/AUDIO] - S08E10 - Knights of Light (2)
8.plot: Traveling further into an abyss of memories, the Paladins make shocking discoveries that could alter their reality forever.

8.plot: As Honerva gets closer to creating a catastrophic rift in reality, the Atlas crew races against time to figure out how to locate and stop her.

8.plot: Confronted by a dark energy like nothing they've faced before, the Paladins must draw on their everlasting bond -- and a few Balmera -- to forge ahead.

8.plot: Voltron and Honerva come together at the source of all realities in the ultimate battle between good and evil for the survival of the universe.

1.title: FR - Influence mortelle : réseaux assassins - S01E02 - TikTok Terror
1.plot: As a 28-year-old, Sania battles through divorce, her passionate and searingly honest Tik Toks attract tens of thousands of followers. But she soon discovers that members of her community want to silence her - and will stop at nothing to do it.

1.title: FR - Influence mortelle : réseaux assassins - S01E03 - RIP Bianca
1.plot: Anime-obsessed teenager Bianca becomes an inspiring mental health advocate online and changes lives. But on forums and social media accounts, she discovers a horrifying and violent side: young men primed to threaten, harm, and attack.

meta.plot: Les influenceurs renvoient une image de succès, de marques florissantes et de bénéfices records. Mais dans leur vie, la réalité est bien plus sombre.

1.title: FR - LEGO Star Wars : Reconstruire la Galaxie - S01E01 - Part One
1.plot: Two brothers have their lives changed when they accidentally remove The Cornerstone of the Galaxy.

1.title: FR - LEGO Star Wars : Reconstruire la Galaxie - S01E02 - Part Two
1.plot: On the run, Sig meets Jedi Bob and must learn from him about the secrets of The Cornerstone.

1.title: FR - LEGO Star Wars : Reconstruire la Galaxie - S01E03 - Part Three
1.plot: In an effort to set things right in the galaxy, Sig makes some new, unexpected allies.

1.title: FR - LEGO Star Wars : Reconstruire la Galaxie - S01E04 - Part Four
1.plot: With the fate of the galaxy on the line, Sig and his friends battle Darth Devastator one last time.

meta.plot: La galaxie entière est bouleversée lorsqu'un berger ordinaire du nom de Sig Greebling déterre un artefact puissant provenant d'un temple Jedi caché. Il se retrouve plongé au cœur de l'aventure dans une nouvelle version de la galaxie où les personnages incontournables de l'univers ne sont plus ceux qu'il connaît. Le sort de la galaxie dépend de Sig et de sa capacité à devenir le héros qui remettra les pièces en ordre.

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E01 - EP1
1.plot: Son Hae-yeong, a woman who is calculating by nature and hates to suffer losses. Kim Ji-uk, a civilian officer, neighborhood angel, perfect convenience store part-timer who hates causing trouble to people. After breaking up with her boyfriend to avoid losses, Hae-yeong makes a surprising offer to Ji-uk to win the in-house contest. What offer could she have made?

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E02 - EP2
1.plot: Strange behavior follows after the proposal. Ji-uk rejects Hae-yeong’s offer to be her fake husband without hesitation. Woo-jae shamelessly gaslights Hae-yeong after stealing her idea. Provoked by Woo-jae, Hae-yeong becomes increasingly desperate for a fake marriage and starts searching for a husband on a secondhand app. Will she find a fake husband?

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E03 - EP3
1.plot: This marriage is a failure! Shocked by Ji-uk’s true looks, Hae-yeong vents her frustrations and becomes suspicious of him for knowing so much about her. Rumors about her handsome husband spark her coworkers' curiosity about her proposal story. Hae-yeong asks Ji-uk to propose to her, only to be treated like a weirdo again. Hae-yeong’s wedding plan to erase all memories of her husband begins!

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E04 - EP4
1.plot: What are the odds of staying at the same hotel as your ex on your wedding day? Thanks to Woo-jae and Yi-lin, Hae-yeong and Ji-uk spend the night together. She teases him about his inexperience, and he mentions their kiss. They spend the night discussing gains and losses. Hae-yeong goes on the honeymoon alone while Ji-uk disappears without a word. Hae-yeong spots Ji-uk at an unexpected place!

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E05 - EP5
1.plot: The husband who had been missing and out of contact shows. And as a new recruit, no less. Hae-yeong is shocked to see Ji-uk as a new recruit at Kkulbee. Though he is apologetic, he is unable to share why he had to join the company. Meanwhile, fearing that their fake marriage will be exposed, Hae-yeong devises a plan to get rid of Ji-uk. However, this unexpectedly puts her in a tough spot.

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E06 - EP6
1.plot: Due to Ji-uk’s unpredicted disclosure of his identity, he and Hae-yeong become the talk of the company. Hae-yeong is mistaken for pulling strings to get Ji-uk employed, while Ji-uk is upset that Hae-yeong speculates him to be the one who reported her for workplace harassment. Meanwhile, the mastermind behind Ji-uk’s employment slowly becomes known. Will the true nepo baby’s identity be revealed?

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E07 - EP7
1.plot: Waking up in the same bed as your ex-boyfriend and husband? Hae-yeong and Ji-uk wake up with no memory of the previous night after getting drunk. Woo-jae is upset at Yi-lin over a sudden personnel transfer, while Hae-yeong regrets getting married, prompting Ji-uk to offer a divorce. Meanwhile, Ja-yeon, worried about Gyu-hyun, visits the orphanage and almost runs into Ha-jun.

1.title: FR - Pas de profit, pas d'amour - S01E08 - EP8
1.plot: Hae-yeong and Ji-uk’s long-awaited first kiss leads to a fight. What's the meaning behind Hae-yeong's kiss and Ji-uk's kiss? Ji-uk thinks of different ways to reconcile with the angry Hae-yeong. Who will emerge victorious in their first marital fight? Meanwhile, Hae-yeong visits the orphanage with the new business idea proposed by Ji-uk and faces the risk of Woo-jae discovering her secret.

meta.plot: Une romance zéro perte entre une femme qui déteste perdre et un homme qui se marie pour éviter de déranger.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E01 - 17 Seconds
1.plot: Before its Paris Fashion Week show, the revered Maison LEDU falls into scandal. Young designers Paloma and Ye-Ji seize the moment.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E02 - Nepo Baby
1.plot: Vincent and Perle face off to decide the future of Maison LEDU. Paloma and Ye-Ji come to a creative and personal crossroads.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E03 - The Family Photograph
1.plot: As the media storm dies down, the time comes for tough decisions. Paloma struggles to find her place in a family torn apart by selfish alliances.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E04 - The Divorcée
1.plot: Paloma prepares her first fashion show at LEDU. Under immense pressure, she must figure out who she can count on.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E05 - Like Father, Like Daughter
1.plot: Victor grapples with an uncertain future. Paloma faces the realities of life in the spotlight—and the price of her position.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E06 - Message in a Bottle
1.plot: The entire Ledu family gathers for Christmas, but the festive joy is short-lived as the celebration takes a turn.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E07 - La Vie en Rose
1.plot: Paloma stays in Brittany to spend more time with Vincent, which enrages Ye-Ji and her team back in the studio.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E08 - Sea Change
1.plot: A few days before the show, Paloma is still without a creative plan. Caroline is ready to make her move.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E09 - Ledu or Not Ledu
1.plot: As a final act of defiance, a united Maison LEDU makes a last-ditch effort. Victor feels trapped.

1.title: FR - La Maison - S01E10 - The Isle of the Dead
1.plot: The Ledu family and the Rovel family battle for control as Paloma takes a big risk.

meta.plot: High fashion meets high drama in this behind-the-curtain look at an iconic French haute couture house. When the family dynasty behind the house falls into scandal, they must find a way to reinvent themselves—or be destroyed by their rivals.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: After a tragic accident, Mickey Bolitar finds himself living with his aunt in Kasselton, New Jersey—a town with a lot of buried secrets. When a classmate disappears without a trace, Mickey’s drawn into a conspiracy so shocking that it makes high school drama seem like a luxury…and leaves Mickey questioning everything about the life he thought he knew.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E02 - Catch Me If U Can
1.plot: The investigation into Ashley’s disappearance leads the gang to a dangerous man. As Mickey reunites with his mom, Shira bumps into an old friend. And in a town filled with secrets that people would kill to keep buried, what is Mrs. Friedman—Mickey’s history teacher—hiding?

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E03 - The Dirt Locker
1.plot: Mickey learns more about the mysterious Bat Lady’s past. Shira spends time with an old friend, while Ema makes a new one. At Ellen and Alan Bolitar’s 49th wedding anniversary party, the family struggles to come to grips with Brad’s absence.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E04 - Phantom Threads
1.plot: Mickey has a breakthrough in the search for Ashley. Chief Taylor has a tense confrontation with Bat Lady. Ema and Spoon make beautiful music together.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E05 - See Me Feel Me Touch Me Heal Me
1.plot: Mickey and Spoon discover Ema’s big secret. To find Ashley, Rachel needs a gigantic favor from Troy. Mickey and Rachel trail a suspect to a surprising location. Mickey finds a shocking photo.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E06 - Candy's Room
1.plot: Mickey makes an outlandish request. Shira finds herself in an awkward position. Ema reacts with rage to a betrayal. A major mystery is solved, but Mickey finds himself in over his head.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E07 - Sweet Dreams Are Made of This
1.plot: Spoon, Ema, and Rachel take a road trip, while Mickey runs into someone he recently met.

1.title: FR - À découvert - S01E08 - Found
1.plot: Everything is revealed.

meta.plot: Basé sur la série de livres à succès d'Harlan Coben, "À découvert" raconte l'histoire de Mickey Bolitar après la mort de son père qui le mène à commencer une nouvelle vie dans le New Jersey. Lorsqu'un nouvel élève disparaît, Mickey se retrouve mêlé à des secrets. Avec l'aide de ses amis, Spoon et Ema, il découvre un souterrain sombre qui pourrait contenir les réponses à des années de disparition.
