Mais, suivi à la trace par la caméra de son petit frère, il va surmonter épreuves et polémiques pour redéfinir les contours du rap et devenir l’un des artistes français les plus populaires de sa génération.

1.plot: Yakko sings a song to the tune of the "Mexican Hat Dance" listing the nations of the world.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E05 - Cookies for Einstein
1.plot: As scouts in Switzerland, the Warners attempt to sell cookies to Albert Einstein and accidentally help him discover the mass-energy conversion formula (mistakenly referred to as the formula for his theory of relativity).

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E06 - Win Big
1.plot: Brain competes on the trivia game show Gyp-Parody! to win enough money to buy the final part of a device that Brain is building in order to take over the world.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E07 - H.M.S. Yakko
1.plot: The Warners perform a musical tribute to Gilbert & Sullivan.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E08 - Slappy Goes Walnuts
1.plot: Slappy and Skippy Squirrel gather nuts from Doug the Dog’s yard.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E09 - Yakko's Universe
1.plot: Yakko leads a trip through the universe as he sings about the galaxies.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E10 - Hooked On a Ceiling
1.plot: The Warners help Michelangelo paint the Sistine Chapel.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E11 - Goodfeathers: The Beginning
1.plot: To become a Goodfeather, Squit must pass the initiation test: find some food.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E12 - Taming of the Screwy
1.plot: When potential foreign investors want to meet the wacky Warner siblings, the studio boss orders Dr. Scratchansniff to train the untamable trio.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E13 - Temporary Insanity
1.plot: Plotz hires the Warners after the his secretary goes home sick.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E14 - Operation: Lollipop
1.plot: Buttons tries to keep Mindy safe after her lollipop gets stuck on the side of a mail truck.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E15 - What Are We?
1.plot: The Warners are hypnotized by Dr. Scratchansniff in order to make them less zany. Dr. Scratchansniff fails and asks them what they are, leading the Warners to offer a number of suggestions.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E16 - Piano Rag
1.plot: The Warner siblings disrupt a piano concert at Carnegie Hall.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E17 - When Rita Met Runt
1.plot: A savvy cat and naive pooch join forces to escape the city pound.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E18 - The Big Candy Store
1.plot: The Warners meet the meanest candy store owner.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E19 - Bumbie's Mom
1.plot: Slappy Squirrel tries to convince Skippy that "Bumbie's Mom" didn't really die in the famous movie.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E20 - Wally Llama
1.plot: The Warners trek to Tibet seeking answers to the mysteries of life from a famous sage.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E21 - Where Rodents Dare
1.plot: Pinky and The Brain infiltrate a summit of world leaders in the Swiss Alps in an attempt to take over the world.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E22 - King Yakko
1.plot: A freak accident of lineage results in Yakko becoming "King Yakko" of Anvilania.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E23 - No Pain, No Painting
1.plot: Modern art is born when the Warners help Pablo Picasso discover his painting style.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E24 - Les Miseranimals
1.plot: In a musical parody of Victor Hugo's novel Les Miserables, Runt breaks out of Le Pound to save Rita and the Miserable Cats.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E25 - Garage Sale of the Century
1.plot: The Warners attempt to buy the seller's garage at the Garage Sale of the Century.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E26 - West Side Pigeons
1.plot: The Goodfeathers battle the Sparrows over possession of a statue of Martin Scorsese in a musical spoof of "West Side Story."

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E27 - Hello Nice Warners
1.plot: While running away from Ralph, the Warners get hired by a Jerry Lewis-based comedy director for his movie, leading to a clash of comedic styles. Soon, the Warners end up directing, giving the director the worst day of his life.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E28 - La Behemoth
1.plot: The Hip Hippos cope without their maid.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E29 - Little Old Slappy From Pasadena
1.plot: Slappy Squirrel takes her car for a drive, set to the tune of a classic rock 'n' roll song "The Little Old Lady (from Pasadena)."

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E30 - La La Law
1.plot: Dr. Scratchansniff gets a parking ticket and is represented in court by the firm Warner, Warner and Warner.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E31 - Cat on a Hot Steel Beam
1.plot: Mindy pursues a kitty into a dangerous construction site, and Buttons tries desperately to save her.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E32 - Space Probed
1.plot: The Warners are abducted by aliens and taken aboard their spaceship where their hijinks begin to annoy the aliens.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E33 - Battle for the Planet
1.plot: Brain wants to take over the world by tricking people into thinking that aliens are invading Earth and having them flee the cities in a panic.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E34 - Chalkboard Bungle
1.plot: The studio hires a new teacher named Miss Flamiel to teach the Warners. Despite her best efforts, she meets only with frustration and is unable to teach them anything.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E35 - Hurray for Slappy
1.plot: Slappy goes to a banquet held in her honor in order to receive an award while three of her old nemeses (Walter Wolf, Sid the Squid, and Beanie the Brain-Dead Bison) plot revenge for years of torment by her.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E36 - The Great Wakkorotti: The Master and His Music
1.plot: Wakko belches The Blue Danube by Johann Strauss.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E37 - Roll Over, Beethoven
1.plot: As chimney sweeps, Yakko, Wakko, and Dot annoy Ludwig van Beethoven, and accidentally give him inspiration for his Fifth Symphony.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E38 - The Cat and the Fiddle
1.plot: In 1690s Italy, a violinist named Stradivarius takes a stray cat (Rita) in so that he can make violin strings out of her "catgut."

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E39 - Pavlov's Mice
1.plot: In turn of the century Russia, Brain plans to take over the world by stealing the crown jewels of Russia, yet with one setback: he and Pinky have been conditioned by psychiatrist Ivan Pavlov.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E40 - Chicken Boo-Ryshnikov
1.plot: In New York, Chicken Boo is mistaken for a ballet dancer and dances in a performance of Tchaikovsky's Swan Lake.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E41 - Nothing But the Tooth
1.plot: Rasputin has a toothache preventing him from hypnotizing Tsar Nicholas. Unfortunately for him, the Warners are his dentists.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E42 - Meatballs or Consequences
1.plot: During a visit to Sweden, the Warners run afoul of Death, who tries to bring Wakko to the realm of the dead after he eats one too many Swedish meatballs during a contest. To save him, Yakko and Dot challenge Death to a game of checkers.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E43 - A Moving Experience
1.plot: Flavio and Marita head to New York in order to find a trendy new place to live.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E44 - The Flame
1.plot: A candleflame guides us through a special night in American history.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E45 - Four Score and Seven Migraines Ago
1.plot: On a train to Gettysburg, the Warners help Abraham Lincoln write the opening of the Gettysburg Address.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E46 - Wakko's America
1.plot: In a Jeopardy!-style game in Miss Flamiel's classroom, Wakko has to name the 50 states and their capitols, but fails to put his answer in the form of a question, instead putting it in the form of a song sung to the tune of "Turkey in the Straw."

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E47 - Davy Omelette
1.plot: Chicken Boo is mistaken for the frontiersman Davy Omelette. He helps a number of pioneers who are being attacked by a bear

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E48 - Hearts of Twilight
1.plot: A crazy film director is millions of dollars over budget, so Plotz sends the Warners out to stop him.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E49 - The Boids
1.plot: The Goodfeathers are hired as stunt birds for The Boids. They try to keep their jobs, but the movie shoot turns out to be harder than they expected.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E50 - Guardin' the Garden
1.plot: Slappy protects Adam and Eve from eating an apple in the Garden of Eden, just as a snake tries to grab it and tempt them to do so.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E51 - Plane Pals
1.plot: Onboard a plane, the Warners annoy a tightwad named Ivan Blosky who is forced to sit by them because of a computer error.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E52 - Be Careful What You Eat
1.plot: The Warners sing about the names of the ingredients in a carton of ice cream and a candy bar.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E53 - Up the Crazy River
1.plot: When Mindy chases a butterfly into a rain forest that is being cut down for wood, Buttons follows and attempts to protect her.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E54 - Ta da Dump, Ta da Dump, Ta da Dump Dump Dump
1.plot: Bobby and Squit must help Pesto when he gets his head caught in a plastic six-pack ring while the trio are rummaging through the garbage in a garbage scow.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E55 - Opportunity Knox
1.plot: Brain wants to steal all of the gold in Fort Knox as part of his latest plan to take over the world.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E56 - Wings Take Heart
1.plot: When a male moth and a female butterfly fall in love they head to the city, leading to disaster.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E57 - Hercule Yakko
1.plot: The detective Warners go in search of Marita's missing jewel on a cruise ship filled with "the unusual suspects."

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E58 - Home on De-Nile
1.plot: Rita gets adopted by Cleopatra, and Runt saves her after he finds out that Rita is about to be sacrificed.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E59 - A Midsummer Night's Dream
1.plot: The Warners perform a unique interpretation of William Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E60 - Testimonials
1.plot: Several old-time movie stars talk about their encounters with the Warners and how Milton Berle hated Yakko.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E61 - Babblin' Bijou
1.plot: An old black-and-white Warner cartoon where Dot goes into the movies (literally) to find the man of her dreams.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E62 - Potty Emergency
1.plot: In the midst of watching a scary sci-fi movie, Wakko drinks too much soda and scrambles to find an available bathroom. Even after he finds a toilet in his "gag bag", his quest to relieve himself goes from bad to worse when he cannot find any privacy.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E63 - Sir Yaksalot
1.plot: The Warners are recruited by King Arthur to save Camelot from a dragon.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E64 - You Risk Your Life
1.plot: Greek playwright Aristotle tries to win cash and prizes on "You Risk Your Life," a game show hosted by Yakko.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E65 - I Got Yer Can
1.plot: A discarded soda can sparks an escalating, one-sided battle of wits between Slappy and her conceited neighbor, Candie Chipmunk.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E66 - Jockey for Position
1.plot: In order to win funds for his latest world-conquering scheme, Brain enters the Kentucky Derby as the world's smallest, lightest jockey. But Pinky's meddling alters the outcome of the race in an unexpected manner. First appearance of Phar Fignewton, a parody of Phar Lap. Tchaikovsky's "Romeo and Juliet: Love Theme" plays in this skit.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E67 - Moby Or Not Moby
1.plot: The Warners protect the legendary Moby-Dick from the wrath of Captain Ahab.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E68 - Mesozoic Mindy
1.plot: In the Stone Age, cavegirl Mindy gets in trouble and Buttons rescues her.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E69 - The Good, The Boo And The Ugly
1.plot: Chicken Boo finds himself as a sheriff in the midst of a spaghetti Western.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E70 - Hot, Bothered And Bedeviled
1.plot: Lost once again, the Warners end up in the fiery realm of Hades, where they end up giving Satan his own eternal torment.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E71 - Moon Over Minerva
1.plot: First Minerva Mink skit. A melancholic Minerva Mink avoids the come-ons of geeky Wilfred Wolf, until the full moon brings out the real wolf in both of them.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E72 - Skullhead Boneyhands
1.plot: In a parody of Tim Burton's Edward Scissorhands, Mr. Skullhead (a character brought over from Tiny Toon Adventures)) is adopted and finds acceptance in a suburban family.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E73 - Draculee, Draculaa
1.plot: In an attempt to head towards their ancestral home of Pennsylvania (since their parents are the pencils that drew them), the Warners end up at the estate of Count Dracula in Transylvania.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E74 - Phranken-Runt
1.plot: Rita and Runt end up being chased by a crazy female mad scientist who wants the idiot dog's brain for her own experiments.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E75 - O Silly Mio
1.plot: After witnessing their stained-glass window get destroyed by prima donna opera singer Madame Bruntvin, the Warners torment her in their own variations on Carmen.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E76 - Puttin' on the Blitz
1.plot: In the midst of the Nazi invasion of Poland, Rita and Runt help a little girl reunite with her father while avoiding the enemy (and Newt, a tenacious dachshund).

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E77 - The Great Wakkorotti: The Summer Concert
1.plot: Wakko belches Dance of the Hours.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E78 - Chairman of The Bored
1.plot: The Warners are tortured going through the longest, most boring one-sided conversation of their lives courtesy of a drone-voiced man, Francis "Pip" Pumphandle (Ben Stein), that they meet at a party.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E79 - Planets Song
1.plot: Yakko sings about the planets in our solar system. Wakko notifies him at the end that he forgot Uranus, leading to one of the show's elusive innuendos.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E80 - Astro-Buttons
1.plot: Buttons and Mindy are part of a space colony, and Buttons goes after Mindy when she chases after her ball.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E81 - Cartoons in Wakko's Body
1.plot: In a running gag throughout the episode, Wakko has various medical maladies caused by cartoons that are inside him.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E82 - Noah's Lark
1.plot: Noah (who looks and speaks like comedian Richard Lewis) is instructed by God to build an ark for the Great Flood and to gather animals two-by-two, including the Hip Hippos.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E84 - Hiccup
1.plot: Squit gets a case of the hiccups, forcing the other Goodfeathers to come up with different ways to get rid of them.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E85 - Clown And Out
1.plot: A clown (who looks and speaks like the Jerry Lewis-esque Mr. Director) is hired by Mr. Plotz for Wakko's birthday party, but Plotz learns from Dr. Scratchansniff that, like Mr. Plotz, Wakko has a bad fear of clowns, resulting in the clown being battered and bruised. The skit has become somewhat of an internet meme.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E86 - Bubba Bo Bob Brain
1.plot: The Brain becomes a country-western star in order to plant hypnotic suggestions for world domination. But his main problem in his rise to fame: Pinky keeps screwing up his name.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E87 - Very Special Opening
1.plot: The Warners announce that this will be a very special episode due to characters being mixed up.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E88 - In The Garden of Mindy
1.plot: Brain tries to prepare a plan for world domination, all the while watching over Mindy's mischief. This is followed by a short skit called "Pinky and the Cat", where Pinky is swallowed whole by his cagemate, Rita.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E89 - No Place Like Homeless
1.plot: Runt and Pesto find a home with a kind old woman who does not like pigeons.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E90 - Katie Ka-Boo
1.plot: In Katie Ka-Boom's first appearance, she discovers the hard way that her latest boyfriend is a giant chicken (Chicken Boo to be exact).

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E91 - Baghdad Cafe
1.plot: The Warner Brothers (and their sister Slappy in place of Dot) pay a visit to Sodarn Insane (a parody of Saddam Hussein).

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E92 - Critical Condition
1.plot: After movie critics Hiskel and Egbert (parodies of Siskel & Ebert) blast her cartoons on a review show, Slappy decides to get revenge: first by blowing their home up, then by sabotaging their latest film viewing. Note: Includes clips from the Looney Tunes shorts What's Opera, Doc?, Duck Amuck, and Porky in Wackyland. Shirley the Loon from Tiny Toon Adventures makes a non-speaking cameo.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E93 - The Three Muska-Warners
1.plot: The Warners, as the Three Musketeers, protect Louis VIII from the threat of "the Viper".

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E94 - Dough Dough Boys
1.plot: The Goodfeathers (as carrier pigeons) are forced to deliver an important message through a World War I battlefield.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E95 - Boot Camping
1.plot: The Warners head for summer camp but wind up in basic training instead, leading to chaos, confusion and an angry drill sergeant.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E96 - General Boo-Regard
1.plot: The Southern Rebels of the Civil War are led by Chicken Boo.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E97 - Spell-Bound
1.plot: Pinky and The Brain become "Spellbound" when they attempt to use Merlin's book of magic to take over the world.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E98 - Smitten With Kittens
1.plot: Rita and Runt find a litter of "puppies" that cling to the stray cat as their mother.

1.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S01E99 - Alas Poor Skullhead
1.plot: Yakko recites a monologue from William Shakespeare's "Hamlet", while Wakko plays Horatio and digs and Dot translates.

2.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S02E01 - Take My Siblings Please
2.plot: The Warners confront a troll who won't let them cross his bridge.

2.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S02E02 - The Mindy 500
2.plot: Mindy's pursuit of a brightly painted "clown car" leads her to the Indianapolis 500 Speedway.

2.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S02E03 - Morning Malaise
2.plot: The Warners upstage controversial radio talk show host Howard Tern.

2.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S02E04 - We're No Pigeons
2.plot: The Goodfeathers try to outwit a hungry young owl.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E01 - Deduces Wild
3.plot: The Warners bother Sherlock Holmes for help with their scavenger hunt.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E02 - Rest in Pieces
3.plot: Slappy is asked to attend Walter's funeral, which is really a ruse planned by Walter to blow Slappy sky-high.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E03 - U.N. Me
3.plot: The Warners sing about the United Nations to the tune of "Down by the Riverside".

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E04 - Super Strong Warner Siblings
3.plot: In a parody of Mighty Morphin Power Rangers, the Warners fight against a giant insect destroying the Warner Studio.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E05 - Nutcracker Slappy
3.plot: Slappy and Skippy resort to extreme measures in order to crack the last nut in the kitchen, accompanied by music from The Nutcracker. Guest appearance by Charlton "Baynarts" Woodchuck (from "Hollywoodchuck").

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E06 - Wakko's New Gookie
3.plot: Wakko tries to come up with a new "gookie", or bizarre facial expression.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E07 - A Quake, a Quake!
3.plot: The Warners sing a song about the 1994 Northridge earthquake.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E08 - Variety Speak
3.plot: Yakko and Dot explain to Wakko through song about how to read the headlines in Variety Magazine.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E09 - Three Tenors and You're Out
3.plot: Slappy's plans to take Skippy to a baseball game at Dodger Stadium go wrong when an opera performance by the famed Domino, Pepperoni, and Carumba is scheduled for that night instead. The singers (a parody of the Three Tenors) return at the end of the show to perform a shortened version of the Animaniacs theme. This episode also features parodies of Close Encounters of the Third Kind and Simon.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E10 - Bingo
3.plot: Dr. Scratchansniff has only one player for his weekly bingo game – Wakko.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E11 - A Hard Day's Warners
3.plot: In a parody of The Beatles in A Hard Day's Night, the Warners run from their fans as they try to reach a cartoon convention. Guest appearances by Pinky and the Brain; Elmyra Duff is among the crowd of fans.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E12 - Gimme A Break
3.plot: Slappy tries to get away from the filming of a blockbuster action movie on her vacation day.

3.title: FR - Les Animaniacs - S03E13 - Please Please Please Get a Life Foundation
3.plot: The Warners try to tell people in a TV commercial to "get a life" instead of going over every little reference in their show.

meta.plot: Yakko, Wakko et Dot sont les frères et sœur Warner, créés au début de l'âge d'or de l'animation américaine. Ces héros de cartoons loufoques s'avèrent rapidement incontrôlables, et sèment la panique dans les studios Warner Bros. Enfermés dans le château d'eau du studio, ils s'en échappent occasionnellement pour vivre bon nombre d'aventures historiques, face à des adversaires impuissants devant leurs bêtises.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E01 - One's Place in the World
1.plot: Helene and Elisabeth travel to meet Emperor Franz, who is expected to ask for Helene’s hand. At the party, he stuns everyone with a surprise decision.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E02 - The Arrival
1.plot: Elisabeth arrives in Vienna for her wedding. Soon enough she faces palace intrigue while Franz attempts to protect his country from going to war.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E03 - The Wedding
1.plot: Elisabeth marries Franz, and the royal family gets a taste of her rising popularity. Sophie’s former lover attends the wedding and discovers a secret.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E04 - The Hunt
1.plot: Sophie and the council push for military action, but Franz refuses to engage. Elisabeth upsets the czar's son, leading to severe political consequences.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E05 - The Shoes
1.plot: Maximilian gathers support for an evil plan while Elisabeth's well-intended gesture backfires, leading her to befriend the dubious maid, Leontine.

1.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S01E06 - The God Who Us Has Freedom Sent
1.plot: Elisabeth spends her time partying with Maximilian while Franz is desperate to reconcile with her. Leontine gets herself into a precarious situation.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E01 - An Heir to the Throne
2.plot: Pregnant with her second child, Elisabeth is under pressure to provide a male heir to the throne. An incident occurs during a state visit.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E02 - The Dream
2.plot: Franz sends Maximilian on a diplomatic mission to make an ally of Napoleon III. Sophie schemes to sideline Elisabeth and take charge of her children.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E03 - A Letter from the Empress
2.plot: Elisabeth embarks on a charm offensive across Lombardy-Venetia. Franz gives Maximilian an opportunity to prove his loyalty.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E04 - The Stars During the Day
2.plot: As Leontine asks Alexander to abscond together, he makes a shocking discovery. A visit to Hungary brings tragedy to Franz and Elisabeth.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E05 - The Forest Inside of Us
2.plot: Seeking an escape, Elisabeth retreats to her family in Bavaria. Sophie seizes the moment to procure a better match for Franz.

2.title: FR - L'Impératrice - S02E06 - All We Can Do
2.plot: As the Austrian Empire plunges into war, Elisabeth fights to keep her family together. Sophie discovers the consequences of her actions.

meta.plot: Cette mini-série va se concentrer sur la période qui a immédiatement suivi la rencontre entre les monarques Élisabeth “Sissi” von Wittelsbach et François-Joseph.

FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S01E01 - Tiger Cat
1.plot: Tom and Jerry are pursuing each other in a zoo. During the chase, Tom accidentally destroys the painting of an art-loving monkey. This leads to the monkey becoming quite angry, but his temper cools after he makes Tom look like a tiger by dipping him in orange paint and adding black stripes on with his paintbrush. All the other characters in the episode, save the monkey himself, see Tom and develop the concept that he is a real tiger.

1.title: FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S01E02 - Feeding Time
1.plot: Jerry frames Tom for feeding zoo animals so Spike can fire him.

1.title: FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S01E03 - Polar Peril
1.plot: A polar bear protects Jerry from Tom and Butch.

1.title: FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S01E04 - Joy Riding Jokers
1.plot: Spike mistakes Tom and Jerry for valets.

1.title: FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S01E05 - Cat Got Your Luggage?

2.title: FR - Tom and Jerry Tales - S02E01 - More Powers to You
2.plot: Tom is the pet of a team of superheroes, the Amazing Acquaintances (a parody of Power Rangers), charged with guarding their power rings. However, when Jerry gets into the room where the rings are kept, he and Tom end up having a super-powered duel. To make matters worse, Doomdog (Spike), the Acquaintances' arch-enemy, breaks into the hideout unnoticed and wants all the rings for himself. Tom and Jerry have to work together—pooling their powers of fire and ice—to take the villain down. The heroes congratulate Tom on the capture of Doomdog, but Jerry—with the help of a growth-powered ring—reminds him not-so-gently that he didn't exactly do it alone.

meta.plot: Super Mario Bros est une série télévisée américaine basée sur les jeux vidéos Super Mario Bros et Super Mario Bros 2. Il a été diffusé à l'origine via la syndication de première diffusion pour la plupart des stations de télévision indépendantes ou Fox du 4 septembre 1989, au 1er décembre 1989, avec des rediffusions se poursuivant jusqu'au 6 septembre 1991. Le Family Channel a ramassé la série le 23 septembre 1991, et l'a diffusée jusqu'au 26 août 1994. Le spectacle a été produit par DiC animation et a été distribué par Viacom Enterprises en association avec Nintendo. DHX Media, la société remplaçante de Cookie Jar Entertainment et DiC, est le distributeur actuel.

Pendant 3 mois, les gendarmes vont mener une enquête implacable, exemplaire, le plus discrètement possible, pour amasser des preuves, puis faire avouer celui dont ils ont la conviction qu'il ne dit pas tout : Jonathann.

4.plot: A startling discovery seems to confirm the story of the strangled child, but the team are forced to leave the scene before they can properly investigate. Fearing their witness is in danger, they redouble their efforts to find him.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: Robin discovers a startling truth close to home. The government minister’s blackmailer becomes the prime suspect in the case, but Robin and Strike believe there was an accomplice.

4.title: FR - Strike - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Robin admits the truth to Strike, and a valuable clue helps them solve the case. Season finale.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: Strike is approached by a woman asking for help to find her mother, Margot Bamborough, who went missing in 1974 when a psychopathic serial killer stalked the streets.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: The investigation takes a dangerous turn as a disturbing piece of evidence leads Robin and Strike into London’s underworld. Robin risks her life by pursuing a vicious suspect.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: Spurred on by the father of a young woman who also went missing in the 1970s, the detectives attempt to outwit an incarcerated serial killer who may hold the key to the case.

5.title: FR - Strike - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: Strike realises that Margot’s killer is responsible for many other murders that have gone undetected, and lays a trap.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E01 - Episode 1
6.plot: Edie Ledwell, the co-creator of a cult TV cartoon, The Ink Black Heart, is being harassed by an online figure, Anomie. She asks Robin to uncover Anomie's true identity.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E02 - Episode 2
6.plot: Robin, Strike and Barclay all take risks to further the investigation now that they think Anomie probably killed Edie Ledwell. Strike receives an unexpected and unwelcome visitor.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E03 - Episode 3
6.plot: Robin and Strike make a major breakthrough, having eliminated several suspects. Robin's cover is blown, and Strike stays the night at her new flat. Meanwhile, Anomie claims another two victims.

6.title: FR - Strike - S06E04 - Episode 4
6.plot: The agency is the target of a devastating attack. Strike figures out who killed Edie, and having secured proof, Robin puts herself in danger in order to save lives.

meta.plot: A war veteran turned private detective operates out of a tiny office in London’s Denmark Street. Although wounded both physically and psychologically, his unique insight and background as a military police investigator prove crucial in solving complex crimes that have baffled the police. Based on the bestselling novels written by J.K. Rowling under the pseudonym Robert Galbraith.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: With the help of Vic and Henry, Longmire investigates a backcountry murder with ties to a tribal family.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E02 - The Dark Road
1.plot: Longmire and his team investigate the death of an exotic dancer with possible Amish roots. Cady's new relationship stirs up controversy.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E03 - A Damn Shame
1.plot: Longmire uncovers long-buried family secrets when he probes the deaths of a man and his award-winning horses in a barn fire.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E04 - The Cancer
1.plot: A fisherman discovers the bodies of two murder victims, including a teen from the Cheyenne reservation.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E05 - Dog Soldier
1.plot: Walt and the team look into the disappearances of several Cheyenne foster children and an unregistered sex offender.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E06 - The Worst Kind of Hunter
1.plot: Walt suspects a bear was baited to fatally attack a released murderer. Branch's retired uncle, a former sheriff, can't resist the lure of law enforcement.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E07 - 8 Seconds
1.plot: A wealthy beer distributor is brutally assaulted for a seemingly worthless painting; Vic's husband is jealous of her relationship with Walt; Branch's father uncovers information damaging to Walt's campaign.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E08 - An Incredibly Beautiful Thing
1.plot: Henry uses his tracking abilities to locate an unstable young woman who may be involved in the murder of a gas-station owner.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E09 - Dogs, Horses and Indians
1.plot: The Tribal Council president is found dead on county land but it s clear he died elsewhere and there is soon a large suspect list. Walt deals with feelings of betrayal when he uncovers Cady and Branch s affair.

1.title: FR - Longmire - S01E10 - Unfinished Business
1.plot: In the first-season finale, a teen is murdered after being acquitted of raping a Cheyenne girl. Later, Walt is forced to finally confront his wife’s death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E01 - Unquiet Mind
2.plot: A prison transfer goes awry and Walt urgently pursues a serial killer and his fellow escapees, who have taken hostages, up a mountain. Facing an impending storm with very limited resources, Walt’s mettle is put to the test and hypothermic hallucinations force him to face his past.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E02 - Carcasses
2.plot: When a body is found in a compost heap, the victim's history of abusive behavior leads to a varied list of suspects. Walt and the team must cross county lines to track down the killer. Branch looks into Cady's abrupt departure from Absaroka.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E03 - Death Came in Like Thunder
2.plot: Walt and the team explore Absaroka's Basque community when a shepherd and his dog are found dead. Branch walks a thin line in his alliance with Jacob Nighthorse. Meanwhile, Cady looks to Detective Fales for answers about her mother's death.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E04 - The Road to Hell
2.plot: A cattle heist sends the team on an urgent search for the missing livestock and driver as well as the thieves. Walt is concerned by Vic's fearful behavior when she receives a mysterious bouquet of flowers.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E05 - Party's Over
2.plot: When a teenage girl is found dead, Walt and the team investigate ties to the illegal sale of prescription drugs. Meanwhile Henry reconnects with an old flame and Cady returns home.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E06 - Tell It Slant
2.plot: Walt is tipped off to the murder of a supposed psychic by the Contrary Warrior, a Cheyenne who does the opposite of what people expect. While deciphering his backwards clues, Walt must also deal with a public debate against Branch.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E07 - Sound and Fury
2.plot: After Henry overhears a disgruntled husband try to order a hit on his wife, Walt and the team must use what little information they have to prevent her murder. Vic is wary when an ex-cop from Philly shows up in Durant.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E08 - The Great Spirit
2.plot: When a wild horse is found dragging a dead body, Walt discovers evidence of an illegal rodeo at a local farm. Detective Fales comes to town to talk to Henry.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E09 - Tuscan Red
2.plot: Following an explosion on the reservation and the discovery of a charred dead body, Walt is bombarded with public confrontation as the Cheyennes blame the blast on gas leaked from fracking by Newett Energy. Meanwhile, Branch reconnects with Cady and uncovers information that could help him in the election.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E10 - Election Day
2.plot: On election day, Walt and Branch aren't thinking about politics when Cady is badly injured by a hit-and-run driver. Vic and Ferg investigate, and Walt has a flashback to when Cady was a little girl.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E11 - Natural Order
2.plot: When a game warden is killed alongside an elk that was poached, Walt discovers a connection to a rare expensive supplement. Walt completes his sacrifice, and Branch closes in on the truth about Cady's accident.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E12 - A Good Death Is Hard to Find
2.plot: Longmire investigates after he receives a safe deposit box from a just-murdered inmate that contains a severed finger that is linked to both a new murder and a 20-year-old armed robbery. At the same time, Vic's paranoia peaks when she suspects she is being stalked, forcing her to confide in Walt.

2.title: FR - Longmire - S02E13 - Bad Medicine
2.plot: Walt and Branch team up when an apparent suicide is connected to Cady's accident. Meanwhile, Detective Fales returns with warrants, forcing Walt and Henry to face what happened in Denver.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E01 - The White Warrior
3.plot: Walt deals with the aftermath of Henry's arrest and Branch's shooting.The search for the shooter, however, is complicated by Branch's insistence that it was someone known to be already dead.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E02 - Of Children and Travelers
3.plot: An investigation into the murder of a Russian adoptee leads the team into a shady underworld. Henry faces trouble behind bars while Cady attempts to secure him competent legal representation.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E03 - Miss Cheyenne
3.plot: Walt splits his time working on a murder investigation and serving as a judge for a local pageant. Cady hopes an old friend can help with Henry's case.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E04 - In the Pines
3.plot: Walt and the team track missing teenage campers on a leadership trip in the wilderness. Branch continues his unauthorized search for his shooter.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E05 - Wanted Man
3.plot: Walt teams up with Lucian Connally to narrow the field of suspects in his wife's murder. Branch's behavior causes problems.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E06 - Reports of My Death
3.plot: A media frenzy erupts when a long-lost heir who went missing 30 years earlier is found dead. Henry makes a risky decision on his own.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E07 - Population 25
3.plot: Vic's vacation turns deadly after she and Sean are kidnapped following an accident. Walt is forced to make an unusual alliance to rescue the pair.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E08 - Harvest
3.plot: A life insurance policy complicates the investigation into a farmer's apparent murder. Branch and Cady check out a lead in Denver. Vic receives an ultimatum from Sean.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E09 - Counting Coup
3.plot: Walt is seriously concerned by Branch's behavior, but makes a key discovery in the David Ridges case. Henry faces a major setback in his trial. Vic makes an important decision about her future.

3.title: FR - Longmire - S03E10 - Ashes to Ashes
3.plot: Walt seeks closure in his wife's murder and Henry's case. Branch is suspended but continues to investigate Jacob Nighthorse.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E01 - Down by the River
4.plot: The team struggles with the fallout from Branch's confrontation with Barlow, and Walt's crusade to bring Nighthorse to justice spins out of control.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E02 - War Eagle
4.plot: Walt is forced to split his focus between new evidence in a personal case, and the murder of a caretaker at a former Japanese internment camp.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E03 - High Noon
4.plot: The investigation of Nighthorse heats up, but not in the way that Walt was hoping for. Cady makes a shocking discovery.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E04 - Four Arrows
4.plot: A body found in the luggage of a tour bus further complicates Walt's troubles with Nighthorse. Henry makes a bold move to help a mother and son.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E05 - Help Wanted
4.plot: When the husband of a former soldier is assaulted during an apparent robbery, Walt is drawn into an emotionally charged investigation.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E06 - The Calling Back
4.plot: A young Native American girl is raped on the reservation, which sparks new, volatile tensions between local oil rig workers and the Cheyenne people.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E07 - Highway Robbery
4.plot: A highway robbery sets off an investigation into a strange relationship, while Walt struggles to let go of the past.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E08 - Hector Lives
4.plot: When a former suspect in a rape case ends up dead in another county, Walt and Vic aren't convinced the death is an accident.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E09 - Shotgun
4.plot: Henry's attempt at justice backfires, resulting in new problems for him and a new investigation for Walt.

4.title: FR - Longmire - S04E10 - What Happens on the Rez...
4.plot: The line between justice and the law gets even blurrier for Henry and Walt as their hunt for a killer intensifies.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E01 - A Fog That Won't Lift
5.plot: A shaky Walt searches for Donna as he and Vic reconstruct what happened in the cabin. Mathias has a deal for Henry. Cady tells Walt about a job offer.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E02 - One Good Memory
5.plot: Henry renegotiates his deal with Mathias. Walt's search for Donna leads to too many suspects. A phone message sends Walt down an unexpected path.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E03 - Chrysalis
5.plot: Walt unravels the puzzling case of a girl and her missing father. Henry helps Cady find a place on the rez. Malachi and Jacob's alliance is weakening.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E04 - The Judas Wolf
5.plot: Walt and Vic investigate the bizarre kidnapping of a despised drug company CEO. Henry and Mathias deal with the ramifications of an overdose.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E05 - Pure Peckinpah
5.plot: Mathias must join forces with Walt after Henry discovers a drug dealer's body. Vic solves her housing problem. Malachi puts a bounty on Hector's head.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E06 - Objection
5.plot: Depositions for Walt's case go badly. Ferg loses confidence in himself. Henry and Vic help lead Walt toward the big boss at Manifest Destinations.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E07 - From This Day Forward
5.plot: When treasure hunters discover a body in a hollow tree, Walt finds a connection to an old case. Cady struggles to help a battered woman on the rez.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E08 - Stand Your Ground
5.plot: Walt looks deeper into the Irish mob. Henry finds the book he needs, while Cady gets legal advice. Malachi and Jacob lob accusations at each other.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E09 - Continual Soiree
5.plot: Walt's obsession with Jacob leads to more tension with Cady. Vic testifies against Gilbert. Walt's anger erupts at the Red Pony.

5.title: FR - Longmire - S05E10 - The Stuff Dreams Are Made Of
5.plot: Walt gets more bad news from the mayor. Vic does a strange favor. As Walt learns what's behind the lawsuit, Henry and Cady each face tribal rituals.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E01 - The Eagle and the Osprey
6.plot: A bank robbery ends in a shooting, giving Sawyer more leverage against Walt. When Henry goes missing, Cady tells Walt about a disturbing vision.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E02 - Fever
6.plot: While Henry recuperates, Walt investigates the murder of a man whose land is popular with treasure hunters.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E03 - Thank You, Victoria
6.plot: Chance Gilbert's plea appearance takes a dramatic turn that pulls Walt away from his own case and sets him and Vic on the path to a showdown.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E04 - A Thing I'll Never Understand
6.plot: An emotional Vic re-examines her life choices. Henry and Jacob join forces to pursue Malachi. Ferg helps Meg's mother avoid the tribal police.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E05 - Burned Up My Tears
6.plot: As the civil trial begins, things don't look good for Walt -- especially after a murder puts him and Vic under suspicion.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E06 - No Greater Character Endorsement
6.plot: The bizarre death of a drug dealer points to a violent new Hector. Cady tries to help a sick child whose parents don’t trust Western medicine.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E07 - Opiates and Antibiotics
6.plot: Walt wonders if a presumed-dead member of the Irish mob is alive. Mathias questions Cady about Catori. A mobile clinic raises Henry's suspicions.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E08 - Cowboy Bill
6.plot: While Ferg secretly works the Cowboy Bill case, Walt and Vic try to find Shane Muldoon. Cady's office is trashed.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E09 - Running Eagle Challenge
6.plot: Vic gets a surprise visit from her father. An FBI agent helps Walt pin down the mole working with Malachi. A tough race enables Vic to move forward.

6.title: FR - Longmire - S06E10 - Goodbye Is Always Implied
6.plot: Jacob's troubles escalate at the casino. Walt gets an unexpected visitor. An inevitable confrontation leads to changed lives.

meta.plot: A Wyoming sheriff rebuilds his life and career following the death of his wife. Based on the “Walt Longmire” series of mystery novels written by best-selling author Craig Johnson.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E01 - Might Need a Bigger Boat
1.plot: The NT is home to over 150,000 crocs and one man, Matt Wright, is on a quest to protect them all.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E02 - Life Insurance Ain't That Good, Baby
1.plot: A family fishing trip turns dangerous when the catch is bigger than expected; Matt reveals his unique bond with a wild crocodile; the boys are stalked during a risky night-time operation.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E03 - Sink or Swim
1.plot: Matt attempts to relocate a crocodile threatening human lives. An unexpected rookie joins the team causing frustration for Willow. An airboat mission is derailed by an emergency.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E04 - Don’t Hold Back
1.plot: Matt sets out to prove that perseverance pays off; the team races against the clock to catch an evasive croc; and a romantic fishing trip is ruined when Matt takes a dangerous detour.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E05 - Trouble in Paradise
1.plot: A sightseeing boat is stalked by an aggressive monster croc. An emergency phone call turns Matt's day upside down. Matt is tasked with apprehending an "uncatchable" crocodile.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E06 - Escape Artist
1.plot: The team chase a bait-robbing croc under the cover of darkness; a cunning escape artist forces Matt to pursue a new strategy; the boys launch a rescue mission to save a disoriented deadly predator.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E07 - Feeding Time
1.plot: The rookie Finn has his hands full at Matt's croc sanctuary. On the Tiwi Islands, a new build tests the team. A huge croc in a small waterhole sets nerves (and a boat) on edge.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E08 - Don’t Get Chewed
1.plot: With a flash flood predicted, Matt and Willow improvise a trap to tempt a hungry croc; Kaia and Banjo hone their foraging skills with a First Nations elder; Finn’s forgetfulness almost ends in disaster.

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E09 - Wright or Wrong
1.plot: Kaia must deal with an unwanted visitor at home. A animal relocation tests Matt's skills for logistics and engineering. Banjo gets his first fishing rod. But will he catch a fish?

1.title: FR - Wild Croc Territory - S01E10 - The Reckoning
1.plot: The inexperienced Finn faces his last challenge; a teammate’s accomplishment is the subject of an outrageous celebration; Matt and Kaia unveil their stunning new home on the remote Tiwi Islands.

meta.plot: Australia’s wild and rugged Northern Territory is home to more than 150,000 crocodiles and one man is on a quest to protect them all. Wild Territory takes you inside the mission as legendary croc wrangler Matt Wright catches and relocates the biggest crocodiles on Earth to keep people and crocs safe.

FR - Eat the Rich: The GameStop Saga - S01E01 - I Like The Stock
1.plot: In 2020, a few plucky upstarts on Reddit spot an opportunity to get rich quick and stick it to Wall Street — by investing in a declining retail chain.

1.title: FR - Eat the Rich: The GameStop Saga - S01E02 - To the Moon
1.plot: The Redditors get more people on board with their plan, and GameStop stock starts flying up. But economic disaster could be on the horizon.

1.title: FR - Eat the Rich: The GameStop Saga - S01E03 - The Reckoning
1.plot: After the squeeze, one Redditor and investing app Robinhood come under suspicion for their ties to the financial establishment.

meta.plot: A community of amateur traders enacts a daring plan to get rich quick and wreak havoc on the stock market. But can they beat Wall Street at its own game?

1.title: FR - FIFA Uncovered - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: In 2015, 14 executive members of FIFA are arrested on suspicions of corruption. An investigation ensues into how a World Cup's host country is selected.

1.title: FR - FIFA Uncovered - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Joseph Sepp Blatter wins a dubious victory as FIFA president. As South Africa is chosen to host the 2010 Cup, rumors swirl around executive Jack Warner.

1.title: FR - FIFA Uncovered - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Following Russia and Qatar's unexpected wins of the 2018 and 2022 World Cup bids, shifty transactions come to light, suggesting bribery and betrayal.

1.title: FR - FIFA Uncovered - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Chuck Blazer makes a deal to evade prison. Sepp Blatter faces a thorny reelection. As FIFA looks to restore its image, questions remain about its future.

meta.plot: Des luttes de pouvoir aux enjeux politiques mondiaux, cette série explore l'histoire tumultueuse de la FIFA et les exigences liées à l'organisation d'une Coupe du monde.

1.title: FR - We Are: The Brooklyn Saints - S01E01 - Welcome to the Saints Young Man
1.plot: The Saints coaches and staff prepare their players for a new season and instill in them the values of hard work and camaraderie.

1.title: FR - We Are: The Brooklyn Saints - S01E02 - My Brother's Keeper
1.plot: Coach Gawuala pours his heart into his team despite struggles off the field. Players, parents and coaches cope with the physical dangers of the sport.

1.title: FR - We Are: The Brooklyn Saints - S01E03 - Like Son, Like Father
1.plot: D-Lo tries to persevere through an emotional time. Kenan looks forward to a future beyond football. The 9U team gets ready for the trip to Florida.

1.title: FR - We Are: The Brooklyn Saints - S01E04 - Any Darn Day
1.plot: The 9U Saints head to Florida to strengthen their bond and play for a title. Kenan chooses his high school. Gawuala starts a new chapter in life.

meta.plot: A Brooklyn youth football program and its selfless coaches provide a safe haven for kids to compete and learn lessons that will take them far in life.

meta.plot: A group of friends set out on a road trip when an unexpected fourth passenger forces an abrupt change of plans.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Reporter Gerd Heidemann needs a real scoop, as he hasn't had a big story in a while. Konrad Kujau, not making enough selling fake memorabilia to old Nazis, desperately needs money and has the idea of forging Hitler’s diaries.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Kujau finally agrees to do business with Heidemann, and all it’s left is for Stern to approve payments. Hans admits his Nazi past, and Elisabeth helps him by destroying his file - unaware that she is photographed while doing it.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Kujau forges some letters to provide Heidemann with documents to verify the diaries. Leo Gold threatens Elisabeth to reveal her father’s guilty past, if she won’t provide him with information about the diaries.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Wishing to sell the international rights of the diaries, Stern approaches an American media mogul, who however has an agenda. Elisabeth, while trying to find out if Kujau is a fake, learns something upsetting about her father.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Elisabeth tells the editors of Stern that she believes the diaries are fake, so Bloom has no choice but to fire her. Kujau panics with the impending publication of the diaries, so he forces Heidemann to keep his identity a secret.

1.title: FR - Faking Hitler : L'arnaque du siècle - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Following the publication of the diaries, Stern continues to assert that they are real, but what will the examination prove? Moreover, will Elisabeth be able to win back her place in Stern?

meta.plot: En 1978, le journaliste allemand Gerd Heidemann s'allie à Konrad Kujau un faussaire désargenté, pour écrire de faux journaux intimes d'Hitler. Retour sur un scandale.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E01 - There Is a Light
1.plot: Lonely Becky spends her life on Chloe's social media, always on the outside looking in, until a sudden tragedy pulls her in deeper than she ever dreamed possible

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E02 - Out of Reach
1.plot: Armed with her new alter ego Sasha, Becky makes herself indispensable to Livia. A party in Elliot's honour gives her the chance to get closer to Chloe's grief-stricken husband.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E03 - The Holy Trinity
1.plot: Becky begins investigating the secrets which Chloe kept from Elliot, Livia and the rest of the friends, but an unexpected run-in with Richard leads to a painful conclusion.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E04 - However Rotten
1.plot: As she embraces life as Sasha, Becky loses herself in the luxurious world Chloe left behind, but she is forced to face the ghosts from her past at Phil’s art exhibition.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E05 - Grimy Friend
1.plot: New information causes Becky to look at everything with fresh eyes as she tries to untangle the threads Chloe left behind, while increasingly at risk of being discovered.

1.title: FR - Chloe - S01E06 - She Called Me
1.plot: Becky’s carefully constructed web of lies begins to crumble around her and it’s a race against time to discover the truth before Elliot’s political launch.

meta.plot: L'outsider Becky est obsédée par l'influenceuse Chloé - jusqu'à ce que la tragédie l'entraîne plus profondément qu'elle ne l'aurait jamais imaginé.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Struggling to figure out where he fits in, Dean decides to pursue his calling as "The Great Uniter" and attempts to organize the first integrated baseball game between his team and his friend Brad's team.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E02 - Green Eyed Monster
1.plot: While Dean reckons with his first taste of heartbreak and betrayal, the adults in his life are overly empathetic and assume his grief is from mourning current events.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E03 - The Club
1.plot: Dean stumbles upon some “racy literature” and shares it with friends at school. When he is caught by the school principal, Bill and Lillian navigate uncharted territory as parents and Dean learns that manhood isn’t all it’s cracked up to be.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E04 - The Workplace
1.plot: It’s “Take Your Son to Work Day” and Dean heads to band practice with Bill. But the “grown folks’ business” at the music studio prompts Lillian to have to pick up Dean. While at her office, Dean finally learns what his mom does while he’s at school all day, gaining a newfound respect for her career and ambition.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E05 - The Lock In
1.plot: Dean is reluctant to attend the annual church lock-in until Kim tells him it’s where she got her first kiss. He enlists his friends to help him pair up with Keisa, but his plans are thwarted when he instead gets paired up with the pastor’s daughter, Charlene.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E06 - Be Prepared
1.plot: When Coach Long and Bill take the boys on a camping trip as part of their newly formed scout troop, their starkly different approaches to the outdoors show Dean that his father isn’t good at everything. As a thunderstorm threatens an eerie quest through the woods, Bill leans into his expertise to save the day.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E07 - Independence Day
1.plot: As Kim’s campaign for a car coincides with the need to take Grandaddy Clisby’s keys away, Bill proposes a solution that is only pleasing to him: Kim can drive, so long as she takes her grandfather and Dean around town. Later on at the mall, Dean is worried about seeming uncool when Clisby ends up chaperoning him and his friends, but Clisby has a few crowd-pleasing tricks up his sleeve.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E08 - Science Fair
1.plot: After seeing Dean bullied by Michael after school Lillian goes to confront his parents and learns he needs more compassion than discipline. Much to Dean’s dismay, she takes Michael under her wing and helps him with his project for the science fair – an event where Dean typically excels

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E09 - Home For Christmas
1.plot: Dean can’t wait to spend Christmas with his older brother, Bruce, when he returns home from Vietnam. But adjusting to life back in Montgomery comes with unexpected challenges for Bruce, and the rest of the Williams family rely on their favorite holiday traditions to bring cheer

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E10 - Lads and Ladies and Us
1.plot: Bill and Lillian decide to join high society club Lads & Ladies as a way to introduce Kim and Dean to positive influences in the community. Bill, Kim and Dean fit right in, but things take a turn when Lillian is treated differently for being a working mom.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E11 - Brad Mitzvah
1.plot: Brad works through his nerves preparing for his bar mitzvah speech while Dean ends his friendship with Keisa when Charlene tells him he can’t be friends with other girls. Things come to a head when the whole group comes together to celebrate Brad’s bar mitzvah.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E12 - I'm With The Band
1.plot: When Dean loses his position as first chair saxophone in the school band, Bill lays the pressure on him to earn it back.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E13 - The Valentine’s Day Dance
1.plot: Dean’s plans to ask Keisa to the Valentine’s Day Dance are foiled when another boy asks her out first after a new makeover makes her the talk of the school. Meanwhile, Bill and Lillian make Kim sign up for a Big Sister program to have extracurricular activities for her college applications.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E14 - Country Dean
1.plot: The family spends spring break with Lillian's parents in the countryside, and Dean lies to his cousins about city life in Montgomery to impress them. Meanwhile, Lillian helps to settle a land dispute between her parents and their neighbors to impress her difficult-to-please mother.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E15 - Black Teacher
1.plot: When their teacher goes on maternity leave, Dean, Cory and Keisa are excited to be taught by Mr. Brady, the school’s first Black teacher. Mr. Brady encourages the students to try out for the Knowledge Bowl team where Dean faces some unexpected challenges

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E16 - The Sleepover
1.plot: When Dean learns that Corey’s dad, Coach Long, is in the doghouse, he struggles to keep this secret from his friend.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E17 - Jobs and Hangouts
1.plot: Kim is excited to start her new job as a waitress at the local diner, which Dean adopts as his local hangout. When Kim experiences drama with her friends, she finds unlikely allies in a tough coworker and her younger brother.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E18 - Goose Grease
1.plot: When Dean comes down with the chicken pox on his way to a hunting trip with Bill and Grandaddy Clisby, Lillian forces the three of them to quarantine together. Clisby pushes homemade remedies on them out of his mistrust of doctors, but he’s forced to reckon with this when Dean’s condition worsens.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E19 - Love & War
1.plot: Bruce returns home from Vietnam, and the family is shocked to find out he is dating an older woman with an 8-year-old son with whom he is eager to start his life. When they learn more about Bruce’s latest deployment, they begin to understand his survivors’ guilt and come together to support him.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E20 - Bill's New Gig
1.plot: Bill is excited to have made tenure at the university, only to find that his focus on career and family has cost him his spot in his band; Bruce adjusts to living at home.

1.title: FR - Les Années Coup de Cœur - S01E21 - Where No Dean Has Been Before
1.plot: Dean tries to impress Keisa's cool new boyfriend by inviting him and his friends to a party Kim is throwing while Bill and Lillian are away for the night; things get out of hand just as Bill and Lillian arrive home.

meta.plot: La série met en scène un adulte afro-américain qui se remémore sa jeunesse à Montgomery dans l'État d'Alabama à la fin des années 1960 avec en toile de fond le contexte historique de l'époque (guerre du Viêt Nam, festival de Woodstock, scandale du Watergate…)

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E01 - Birth
1.plot: Expectant young couple Mehmet and Zeynep host some spoiled houseguests — while their most eagerly anticipated arrival is reluctant to emerge.

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E02 - Right at This Moment
1.plot: Metin is born, and Zeynep and Mehmet struggle with the demands of parenting. But it's when the baby falls asleep that the drama really begins.

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E03 - First Breakup
1.plot: Five-year-old Metin is brokenhearted and wants to talk things through with his ex-girlfriend. Back at home, his parents' relationship is also suffering.

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E04 - 66
1.plot: Metin struggles at school, preferring to make music alone in his bedroom. Zeynep announces she's not in the mood to celebrate her birthday this year.

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E05 - Plants & Friends
1.plot: While working as a DJ, Metin bumps into an old flame. His mother begs for an answer to the question that's been bothering her since the day he was born.

1.title: FR - A Round of Applause - S01E06 - The Return
1.plot: Frustrated by her marriage and let down by motherhood, Zeynep tells both men in her life how she feels — but neither gives her the reaction she wants.

meta.plot: Struggling with existential angst and longing for his past life in an orange, a man navigates his quirky family in this decades-spanning drama.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E01 - We are the same.
1.plot: New recruit Erling Haaland joins Manchester City and sets the tone for the 2022-23 season with his striking goalscoring feats.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E02 - We have to take responsibility.
1.plot: A victory in the season's first Manchester derby pits the Blues against rivals Arsenal in an exciting Premier League title race.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E03 - I want my warriors!
1.plot: Club manager Pep Guardiola drives up the pressure after City suffers a loss against Southampton, knocking them out of the EFL Cup.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E04 - We can beat them all.
1.plot: The Blues move within sight of the treble win as they advance to the quarterfinals of the UEFA Champions League and the FA Cup.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E05 - Do you want to play in the final?
1.plot: After clinching the title from Arsenal and winning the first-ever Manchester derby final, City secures the Premier League and FA Cup double.

1.title: FR - Together: Treble Winners - S01E06 - We're going to win.
1.plot: The Blues arrive in Istanbul to face Inter Milan in a hard-fought UEFA Champions League final and lock in the continental treble.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire revient sur le triplé historique réalisé par les hommes en bleu du Manchester City FC lors d'une saison 2022-2023 extraordinaire.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E01 - Sip Stop Hooray
1.plot: While Joey settles into a new domestic routine, Justine kick-starts her career with a wildly innovative debut product.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E02 - U Can't Crash This
1.plot: Justine scores an exclusive dinner invite, Skyler makes a major decision, and Veronica finds an unsettling surprise in her boyfriend’s apartment.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E03 - They Call Me Too Nice
1.plot: As Joey teaches Justine a crucial business lesson, Wes learns about the pitfalls of collaboration. Meanwhile, Daevon brushes up on his manners.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E04 - Yo! Bum Rush The Secret Show
1.plot: Arsenio encourages Joey to step back into the spotlight. Daevon struggles with an identity crisis. Justine tries a risky marketing strategy.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E05 - Please Hamper, Don't Hurt ‘Em
1.plot: The Washingtons take in a special guest, Joey attempts to teach Daevon a lesson, and Skyler prepares for her academic future.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E06 - Papa Said Log You Out
1.plot: When Joey shares some exciting news, Justine struggles with an internet troll. Veronica helps Skyler tackle an unexpected fear.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E07 - You Gots the Chills
1.plot: Veronica gets caught in a social media predicament, Joey confronts an old rival, and Justine hatches a plan to spend more time with Wes.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E08 - Follow the Leaker
1.plot: Justine and Joey clash over Veronica’s love life while Wes and Daevon team up for a special project. Skyler hosts an elaborate sleepover.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E09 - Pranksta's Paradise
1.plot: As Wes strikes up a new romance, Skyler seeks sisterly revenge. Joey and Justine help Malik with a baby-sitting debacle.

1.title: FR - All About the Washingtons - S01E10 - Snow Diggity
1.plot: An icy blizzard brings the kids together, Joey prepares for a new kind of gig, and Justine unpacks a family mystery.

meta.plot: L'icône du hip-hop MC Joe Speed quitte le show-business et trouve un nouveau rythme entre travail, vie sentimentale et quotidien familial chaotique.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E01 - Fast Food to Fancy
1.plot: Hopefuls turn healthy leftovers like pork tenderloin and marinated veggies into cozy comfort fare, then revamp fast-food favorites into high-end eats.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E02 - Game Day Gourmet
1.plot: Game day appetizers morph into meals that score big points with the judges. The contestants must reimagine smoky barbecue takeout as a gourmet feast.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E03 - The Holidays!
1.plot: A festive meal means lots of leftovers. So how about glazed ham, apple pie and green bean casserole… on a sandwich? Later, Greek food gets a new life.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E04 - Pot Roast to French Toast
1.plot: The cooks serve up a spectacular breakfast using fancy date-night leftovers from the fridge, then wow the judges with fresh takes on Italian takeout.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E05 - Down-Home to Uptown
1.plot: Bacon-wrapped brats and blueberry cobbler get a second look as late-night snacks, and duck confit and cassoulet evolve into entirely different dishes.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E06 - Welcome to the Neighborhood
1.plot: Potluck castoffs return with a vengeance as sinful desserts before the challengers tackle chilled Chinese takeout, including egg rolls and chow mein.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E07 - Fiesta Feast
1.plot: The cooks use food from a children's party to make cocktails and an indulgent brunch. Mexican dishes are remade into gnocchi, dumplings and more.

1.title: FR - Best Leftovers Ever! - S01E08 - Bland to Flavor Bomb
1.plot: After creating a "flavor bomb" from notoriously bland foods like rice and toast, the competitors take on a new challenge: transforming Thai takeout.

meta.plot: Des pâtes délicieuses à base de frites de la veille ? Dans cette compétition culinaire, des cuisiniers chevronnés concoctent des plats gourmands à base de restes.

1.title: FR - Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner - S01E01 - Vancouver with Seth Rogen
1.plot: On a heady trip back to his hometown, Seth reminisces over dim sum with David. Later, the duo attempt a maze and meet octopus Ceph Rogen.

1.title: FR - Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner - S01E02 - Marrakesh with Chrissy Teigen
1.plot: After a sprawling breakfast and succulent lamb in the medina, Chrissy and David try their hand at creating tagines, then hump it through the desert.

1.title: FR - Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner - S01E03 - Los Angeles with Lena Waithe
1.plot: Saucy crawfish, deep-fried brownies, bowling alley chow and sneaker shopping are all on the menu as Lena and David share their trusty LA go-tos.

1.title: FR - Breakfast, Lunch & Dinner - S01E04 - Phnom Penh with Kate McKinnon
1.plot: Kate and David learn how Cambodia's tragic history has impacted its food culture, dig into durian and consider snackable tarantulas and cockroaches.

meta.plot: Chef David Chang takes his insatiable curiosity about food, culture and identity on the road, in the convivial company of fun-loving celebrity guests.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E01 - I Love The Way You Lie
1.plot: The game's first player, a Ph.D. candidate at Stanford, tries to outsmart the challengers. But will a science question lead to his fall?

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E02 - No Risk, No Reward
1.plot: More contestants chase after life-changing money, doing their best to tackle trivia on everything from Kevin Costner to Cinnabon.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E03 - It Pays to Play
1.plot: One competitor closes in on the million-dollar prize while another closes in on the realization that this game isn’t for them.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E04 - Is Any of This True?
1.plot: Notting Hill is famous for what type of festival? How did Buzz Aldrin get his name? What animal has the stinkiest farts? Do your best. Take a guess.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E05 - Weasel Words
1.plot: An attorney’s ability to stretch the truth is put to the test. Also, a dad presses his luck and hopes his poker face will help him win big money.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E06 - This Game Is Not Rocket Science
1.plot: This game isn't rocket science, but that doesn't make it easy. The topics range from the Ten Commandments to actors with dirty mouths.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E07 - Disarmingly Dishonest
1.plot: A convincing contestant inches toward the million-dollar prize, answering a bevy of baffling questions — often incorrectly

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E08 - I Can't Read Her
1.plot: Is she really smart or just really good at dishing b.s.? A self-proclaimed trivia nerd proves hard to read for the panel of human lie detectors.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E09 - Can You Find the Fraud?
1.plot: A real-life fraud detector joins the game, hoping to uncover whether a contestant knows her stuff — or if she's full of it.

1.title: FR - Bullsh*t The Gameshow - S01E10 - The Final Fib
1.plot: A new challenger mixes next-level bluffing with old-fashioned smarts to take the three panelists on a wild ride they won't soon forget.

meta.plot: Les concurrents doivent donner la bonne réponse à des questions difficiles. Et lorsqu'ils ne savent pas, une seule solution : mentir comme des arracheurs de dents.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E01 - Getting Started
1.plot: In the first episode Gordon teaches how to cook with confidence. Recipes include delicious pork chops with sweet and sour peppers, and pan-fried scallops with crunchy apple salad, and Gordon shares a tip for keeping your knives sharp.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E02 - Keeping It Simple
1.plot: Gordon teaches how to keep it simple. Recipes include chilli beef lettuce wraps, and miso-poached salmon, and there's a guide to buying perfect fish.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E03 - Cooking with Chilli
1.plot: Gordon shows how to cook with chilli. Recipes include red mullet with sweet chilli sauce, classic jerk chicken, and a super simple spicy beef salad.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E04 - Cooking with Spice
1.plot: Gordon's cookery course continues as he shows how to cook with spices. Recipes include a gutsy slow-cooked fiery lamb, a curry-spiced sweetcorn soup, and a simple but delicious aromatic rice pudding.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E05 - Ultimate Food on a Budget
1.plot: Gordon shows how to make dream food on a budget. Recipes include sausage rice, roasted mackerel with garlic and paprika, and unforgettable lamb with fried bread.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E06 - More Ultimate Food on a Budget
1.plot: Gordon's cookery course continues as he shows how to cook more delicious food on a budget. Recipes include leek and gruyere rosti with fried eggs, a delicious apple crumble, and seriously impressive homemade gnocchi.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E07 - Stress-Free Cooking
1.plot: Gordon's cookery course tackles stress-free cooking. Recipes include sticky pork ribs, a spicy chutney, and an amazing chilli chicken with ginger and coriander that just gets better and better with time.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E08 - Making It Easy
1.plot: Gordon's course continues with meatballs in fragrant coconut broth and a fabulous alternative to a chocolate brownie: white chocolate blondies.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E09 - Real Fast Food
1.plot: Gordon shows how to make real fast food. Recipes include smoky pork sliders with homemade BBQ sauce, chicken stir-fry with rice noodles, and a fast noodle soup.

1.title: FR - Gordon Ramsay - Les Recettes du Chef 3 Etoiles - S01E10 - Street Food Classics
1.plot: Gordon demonstrates some home-cooked street food classics. Recipes include beef tacos with wasabi mayo, and flavour-packed chilli dogs, and there's a shopping guide to help you buy the finest chocolate.

meta.plot: Gordon Ramsay nous dévoile les secrets de ses petits plats mijotés, en cocotte ou au four. Pour nous mettre en appétit, il commence par des fabuleux travers de bœuf braisés, avant de nous guider dans le choix de l'aliment phare du mijotage : la viande. Mais la cuisson lente donne aussi de délicieux desserts !

1.title: FR - Buy My House - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Buy My House - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Buy My House - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Buy My House - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Buy My House - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Buy My House - S01E06 - Episode 6

meta.plot: Des propriétaires américains présentent des biens à vendre à quatre agents immobiliers chevronnés, dans l'espoir de faire la vente qui changera leur vie.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E01 - No Guts, No Glory
1.plot: Six recession-hit patriots from Oregon stake everything on mining and head north to Alaska to dig for gold and save themselves from financial ruin. The team of greenhorns beg, borrow and build all the equipment they need to mine for gold. Loaded with supplies, they leave their loved ones behind and drive from Oregon to southeast Alaska in a Klondike convoy.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E02 - Gold, Guns, and Bears
1.plot: The stakes get higher at the Porcupine Creek prospect as reality sets in about just how little time they have to get to their gold. The miners start to rebuild the mining ghost town but the bears aren't so keen on their new neighbors — and they let them know it.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E03 - Running Dirt
1.plot: The crew races to set up the mining plant and start running dirt. When the families arrive from Oregon and question the lack of gold — and master mechanic Harness becomes dangerously ill — the tension builds so high that Dorsey and Todd almost come to blows.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E04 - The Ultimate Price
1.plot: The team attempts to finally run potential pay dirt through the wash plant. But a visit from the Department of Fish and Game reveals a violation, jeopardizing their vital water supply to the mine. Then disaster strikes as Todd's daughter fights for her life.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E05 - The Pain Barrier
1.plot: The miners continue to run dirt but an equipment malfunction brings the operation to a halt. Meanwhile, James Harness collapses and Jimmy Dorsey drives a wedge between himself and the crew when he takes on an extra job to earn cash. But hard work late into the night finally hits a pay streak.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E06 - Gold Fever
1.plot: The miners' futures are on the line at Porcupine Creek. After 80 days, the miners are behind schedule, and the Hoffmans have run out of money and deliver the crew an ultimatum: find $10,000 worth of gold in the next two days, or the families have to head home to Oregon. Meanwhile, after Dorsey struggles with the wave table, tensions flare and fists fly.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E07 - Going For Broke
1.plot: With winter weather closing in, a gold recovery expert comes to help the rookies. Todd discovers a major design flaw in the equipment and is forced to make huge modifications. With the credit cards maxed out, he is forced to take desperate measures.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E08 - Bad Blood
1.plot: The crew remains in deep financial hole. Veteran miner "Dakota" Fred thinks he can turn things around and he cranks up production faster than ever before. But when things start falling apart, tensions mount and Harness can't keep his frustration in.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E09 - Bedrock or Bust
1.plot: Desperate to get to bedrock and large quantities of gold, Todd and Jack throw caution to the wind and dig deeper than ever before. With the brutal Alaskan winter threatening, they battle floods, cave-ins and equipment breakdowns.

1.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S01E10 - Never Say Die
1.plot: With the arctic winter looming, the crew races against the clock. Rain and thawing snow flood the mine and Jack puts his life on the line as the glory hole caves in around the massive 100,000 pound excavator.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E01 - Twist of Fate
2.plot: The Hoffmans have to find gold and fast. The crew arrives in Porcupine Creek reinvigorated and in record time, they are on the gold. But just they celebrate their best clean out ever, "Dakota Fred" returns and drops a bombshell on Todd, Jack and crew.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E02 - Virgin Ground
2.plot: The Hoffman crew heads north to the Klondike in a desperate bid to find a new claim and salvage their mining season. 16-year-old Parker Schnabel takes over the Big Nugget Mine, while Dakota Fred gets a new start at Porcupine Creek.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E03 - Family Feud
2.plot: Jack and Todd go head to head over how to set up their new claim. At Porcupine Creek, Dakota Fred rips out the wash plant and finds gold that he forced the Hoffmans to leave behind. At Big Nugget mine, Parker continues to hit pay dirt.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E04 - Slippery Slope
2.plot: The Hoffman crew confronts the permafrost that lies between them and the gold. As the Dakota Boys set up their new wash plant, Fred pushes his son too hard and Dustin storms off. Parker faces a breakdown that leaves his mining season at a stand still.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E05 - Drill or Die
2.plot: A crew rebellion forces Todd Hoffman to dig test holes on the claim. The tension mounts as they wait to see if they're sitting on a gold-rich paystreak or about to go bust. Then, Fred is forced to abandon mining as floods in North Dakota destroy his home.

2.title: FR - Alaska : la ruée vers l'or - S02E06 - Lovestruck
