1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Jan Michelsen is investigating the disappearance of a young woman called Julie Vinding from a Copenhagen suburb. Six months later, Jan is the only one who believes that she is still alive.  Jan finds a ten-year-old case from the same neighbourhood where a 17-year-old girl, Natasha, disappeared on her way home from a party. Jan discovers the remains of Natasha in a lake. She was murdered. Suspecting a link between the two crimes, Jan brings in an expert on serial killers, Louise Bergstein.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Jan and Louise’s investigation into Natasha’s death leads them to suspect Anders Kjeldsen, a man who has been arrested before for violent crimes including rape. Trapped in a basement, Emma tries to comfort a traumatised Julie, but soon needs comforting herself.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Jan and Louise find an unsolved murder case in Sweden that has similarities with Natasha's, although this one has an unusual signature: the victim's ring finger was cut off. Louise doesn't believe that the murder has been committed by Anders Kjeldsen.  Meanwhile, on a farm that Anders Kjeldsen stayed at as a child, the police make a gruesome discovery. Stine is forced to help Anders with the women in the basement, who are planning to escape.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Louise realises that Anders Kjeldsen does not kill alone but has a partner who is the dominant of the two. In the basement, Emma tries to persuade Stine to help her to escape.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The public appeal for information on Anders Kjeldsen leads to the identification of the third victim from the farm and an explanation of how all the women met their killer. Louise suspects he has a female accomplice.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Stine Velin is taken into police custody, but insists that she is also one of Anders Kjeldsen’s victims and does not know where either Anders or Emma are.

1.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Jan and Louise find Anders Kjeldsen. Louise fears that Stine’s family is in danger and places them in a safe house.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: Five years ago, Alice Ejbye's 18-year-old son Markus was murdered by a serial killer who was never found. Alice is now seriously ill and asks criminal profiler, Louise Bergstein, the daughter of her best friend, to help solve the case. At the same time, elsewhere on Funen, a man named Peter Vinge receives a fatal message from his wife Masja.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: A young man has been found in the woods, tortured and stabbed to death. Profiler Louise Bergstein and the head of the investigation Karina Horup try to find evidence for whether the murder can be attributed to a serial killer who, after a five-year hiatus, may now be active again. They slowly work their way towards the killer's highly unusual motive. Meanwhile, Peter Vinge struggles with being a single parent to his son, Johannes, and looks for his next victim.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: Louise Bergstein and Karina Hørup discover that the serial killer has a claimed a new victim, William Fjeldby, who was kidnapped and abducted in his own car. William's father, multimillionaire Gorm Fjeldby, clings to the hope that his son has been kidnapped for a ransom and is therefore still alive. As the police search for William, Peter Vinge tries to celebrate Johannes's birthday without Masja. It dawns on Johannes that his father is hiding something from him.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Alice Ejbye receives some bad news from the doctor. At the same time, despite two new victims, the police have yet to find the man who killed her son Markus. Desperate, Alice posts a video on social media offering a reward which has consequences for her relationship with Louise. The police are inundated with information from people who are after the reward, and Karina and Louise struggle to determine whether there is anything useful among all the information. Peter takes his frustration out on his next victim.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Seven weeks after Alice's death, Louise is in mourning and wants to go home as Karina issues her with an ultimatum regarding the case. Alice's death raises a new suspicion which takes the investigation in a new direction. Peter Vinge focuses on his work at a local sawmill, where he receives an unexpected offer from Leif. At the same time, Peter is in conflict with Johannes who remains in a stage of teenage revolt against his father.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Louise Bergstein continues to assist the investigation to find the serial killer, who now has six brutal murders to his name. With Karina Hørup, Louise returns to the first victims in an attempt to find out where they may have met their killer. Peter notices that the police are closer to him than ever before, and at the same time happens to meet Louise again.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: Unaware of who he really is, Louise gets far too close to Peter. But the terrible truth lurks beneath the surface. Karina tries to find new evidence for the investigation on her own, and an earlier clue resurfaces, moving the case forward. Peter sorts his life out and gives Johannes a message that his son has a hard time coming to terms with.

2.title: FR - Le Tueur de l'ombre - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The police take Johannes to the station, and Louise fears that the truth about her and Peter Vinge will be revealed. Meanwhile, Peter meets his ex-wife Masja, who has returned from Singapore without notice in order to set things straight. Karina, Søren and Torben desperately try to find Peter before he can claim another victim.

meta.plot: Collaboratrice de la police danoise, la profileuse Louise Bergstein traque les tueurs en série. Thriller danois haletant aussi noir qu’efficace, la série « Le tueur et son ombre » nous embarque dans l’âme des psychopathes, et les tréfonds de la société danoise.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E01 - It’s Summertime
1.plot: Renowned Mexican wakeboarder Steffi arrives at a remote Argentine resort to compete in a revived competition... and she's looking to uncover a secret.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E02 - Memories of Sky Vibes
1.plot: A pair of famous twins arrive at Cielo Grande. Steffi finds old photos that raise new questions. Luz and her friends sing while restoring Sky Vibes.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E03 - Friend Zone
1.plot: The twins' manager threatens to leave as the staff worries about Cielo's future. Julian discusses his crush on Luz, who has eyes for someone else.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E04 - New Competition
1.plot: Juan attempts to win Steffi over, with Ian's help. The Cielo Grande crew makes final preparations for Sky Vibes. A new competitor joins the ranks.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E05 - Who’s That Girl?
1.plot: Julian attempts to calm Steffi's nerves after the arrival of her rival Natasha rattles her. Luz launches Sky Vibes, but opening night hits a snag.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E06 - Date Night
1.plot: The identity of the girl in the photograph that Steffi found is revealed. Nati confesses she has a crush on someone. Luz and Tony go on a date.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E07 - Unexpected Trouble
1.plot: When one of the wakeboarders is injured during training, Luz makes a startling discovery. Steffi speaks to her father about his past.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E08 - Bird Leaves the Nest
1.plot: Luz and Steffi join forces to try to solve the mystery surrounding their past. Back at the resort, the crew practices a new "friend zone" song.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E09 - Truth or Dare?
1.plot: Steffi and Luz peel back multiple layers of deception when they confront Ron and Cynthia. Julian leads a meditation the night before the competition.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E10 - Summer Crush!
1.plot: It's finally the day of the Summer Crush competition, and Natasha and Steffi face off for the trophy as their friends and family watch.

1.title: FR - L'Été à Cielo Grande - S01E11 - Save Cielo
1.plot: The friends sing and perform in the "Save Cielo" fundraiser to help the resort pay its bills. Steffi has a heartfelt conversation with her father.

meta.plot: En relançant sa compétition de wakeboard, un hôtel reculé d'Argentine éveille l'intérêt de Steffi, une athlète mexicaine bien décidée à percer un secret de famille.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The bucolic tranquility of Greylock, New Hampshire, is upended when a massive vein of an incredibly valuable mineral is discovered under the town.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E02 - Power
1.plot: Sarah is faced with her first major challenge as a leader when Greylock's power is shut off. Bella pushes boundaries with her dad when it comes to spending time with Tyler and Sarah.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E03 - The Lines Between Us
1.plot: When the governor of New Hampshire closes Greylock's borders, Sarah calls on Bella, Tyler and Maya to help her solve the problem. Corinne pushes Danny to reveal a secret that he's been keeping from everyone.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E04 - In Us We Trust
1.plot: When Sarah discovers that everyone in Greylock is being charged foreign transaction fees, she enlists her friends to help her create own currency. Grover shares with Danny what really happened to Corinne after he left.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E05 - The Criminals it Deserves
1.plot: With Lydon's workers causing problems, Sarah drafts an executive order to help protect Greylock's residents. Grover introduces Danny to a new friend, but they have more in common than Danny realizes. Maya feels abandoned.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E06 - A Show of Hands
1.plot: After a damaging magazine article is written about Sarah, she realizes that it's time for Greylock to create a more representative government. With an election open to anyone, Danny, Maya, AJ, and Corinne take a shot at the four available seats.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E07 - Sanctuary
1.plot: Greylock's fledgling congress must decide their immigration policy now that new people want to immigrate. Sarah and Danny face someone from their past and have different reactions to the visitor.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E08 - The Perfect Conditions for Disaster
1.plot: After an unexpected snowstorm leaves Greylock stranded with no plows, Sarah and the town come up with a creative plan to clear the roads. During the storm, Sarah gets two unexpected guests and tries to figure out how to navigate both circumstances.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E09 - Sons and Daughters
1.plot: When Corrine confides in Sarah about what happened with Danny, Corinne also admits that she needs Sarah's help with something she has always questioned. Sarah confronts Danny about what happened, leaving Danny to make a decision about his future.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E10 - From Simple Sources
1.plot: Greylock is threatened with a massive flood as unseasonably warm weather melts the snow from the recent blizzard. Knowing Greylock will be underwater in hours, Sarah must ask for help from the last person she wants to rely on—Paul.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E11 - Pledge Allegiance
1.plot: Sarah and Paul start to make headway in their relationship. Ellen surprises everyone by coming home earlier than expected. Danny accidentally makes things harder for Corinne, leaving her with a tough choice about some of the people in her life.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E12 - Two Imposters
1.plot: When Danny shares good news about Greylock's finances, Sarah winds up in a debate that traps her between her two closest friends. Corinne is trying to right her wrongs, but she can't catch a break, especially after Sarah drops a major bombshell. Meanwhile, Bella and Tyler get creative with each of their school projects, which helps Sarah and Grover in ways they didn't realize they needed.

1.title: FR - The Republic of Sarah - S01E13 - The Last Rabbit
1.plot: Sarah is offered a chance for international recognition of Greylock but the price may be too high. Danny offers to help Corinne with her legal woes but she asks him for something unexpected.

meta.plot: Confrontée à la destruction de sa ville par une société minière cupide, l'enseignante rebelle du secondaire Sarah Cooper utilise une obscure faille cartographique pour déclarer son indépendance. Maintenant, Sarah doit diriger un jeune groupe d'inadaptés alors qu'ils tentent de créer leur propre pays à partir de zéro.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E01 - LUX
1.plot: Esther cannot reach her husband after a great loss. She decides to look for him. Evi is assigned a murder case, which is linked to the suspected human trafficking couple Sylvia and Ingmar. Sylvia is offered a deal to testify against Ingmar, but declines. In the evening she receives one of her regular customers: Eric. Due to a misunderstanding, things get out of hand and Eric flees.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E02 - Maman
1.plot: Esther reports Eric's missing. She finds out that Eric is cheating on her from photos of him and a woman with a specific tattoo, which she finds on her father's computer. Evi gets drunk at her twins' party and this leads to a big confrontation with Gust. Ingmar brings Imana to Amsterdam, where he has a fight with his rival Elarbi. Sylvia finds out that she is pregnant.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E03 - "E"
1.plot: Sylvia lies that she had an abortion. She is confronted by the police with a photo of Ingmar, Petra and their child. Imana is brought back mutilated by Elarbi and wants to escape. Ingmar plots revenge on Elarbi. Evi goes to stay with Sam because Gust has kicked her out of the house. Esther finds out that the family business is almost bankrupt and Veronqiue is not the woman with the tattoo from Eric's photos. Everything becomes too much for her during a performance.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E04 - Kashmir
1.plot: The body in the Scheldt turns out to be Eric's. Esther turns out not to be pregnant and is told not to use Eric's seed now that he is dead. Veronique confesses that she saw Eric at Tropicana and Evi and Sam are going to investigate further. They inform Esther about his visit to the club. Sylvia makes an appointment with the police. Esther decides to go to Tropicana herself. She finds herself in a dire situation and when she runs off, she recognizes Sylvia by her tattoo.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E05 - Tropicana
1.plot: Esther is questioned by Evi and Sam about Eric's death. Esther insists she has nothing to do with it. Then she contacts Sylvia, who does not want to hear about it. Sylvia has enough on her mind betraying Ingmar. Together with the police, she makes a plan how they can catch Ingmar in the act. Evi and Gust seem to get closer to each other and for a moment they seem like a real family again, but Evi can't handle it anyway.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E06 - Dearest Mother
1.plot: Esther tries in vain to contact Sylvia again and gives her a business card. Evi and Sam question Sylvia again. Sylvia complains about Esther harassing her. Evi follows Veronique, they arrive at Eric's funeral. Sam finds out that Veronique has an alibi. The police action is ready to begin when Sylvia warns Ingmar at the last minute and flees. Esther is shocked by an unexpected visit.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E07 - Peacock Eye
1.plot: Esther does not know what to do with Sylvia and gives her money for a hotel. Esther becomes intimate with Jeroen when she confides in him. Evi is honest with Gust that she doesn't want to be a mother, which Gust doesn't understand at all. The research now focuses on Ingmar and Sylvia and Evi works together with Anna and Kamiel. Ingmar finds out about Sylvia's whereabouts and flees back to Esther. Sylvia makes Esther a very strange proposal ...

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E08 - Our House
1.plot: Evi and Sam help the human trafficking department with a large-scale raid on the bungalow park of Ingmar. Evi concludes that Sylvia is now the main suspect in Eric's case. Evi informs Esther and Esther confronts Sylvia. Sylvia does not understand and tells Esther what she thinks happened on that night. She tries to convince Esther to buy the baby. Evi suspects that Sylvia is with Esther and decides to observe them. Ingmar has apparently also received this information.

1.title: FR - Red Light - S01E10 - Awake
1.plot: A confrontation ensues between Ingmar and the women. It finally becomes clear who is responsible for Eric's death. Esther and Sylvia struggle to flee, while Evi goes after Ingmar and his henchmen. Esther and Sylvia go to Spain, where Eric is said to have a house where Sylvia is safe. Meanwhile, Evi is faced with betrayal from someone close to her.

meta.plot: Trois femmes se retrouvent empêtrées dans le monde de la traite des êtres humains et de la prostitution lorsque le mari d'Esther disparaît soudainement. Venant d'univers complètement différents, les vies de ces femmes s'entremêlent. Elles découvrent qu'elles ont besoin les unes des autres pour échapper aux situations difficiles dans lesquelles elles se trouvent.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E01 - Chapter 1: It Was Murder, She Said!
1.plot: Forty years after he appeared in the sky to save humanity, Marvelous Man makes a televised address that shocks the world — and his Guardians of Justice.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E02 - Chapter 2: A Mentally Shattered Megalomaniac
1.plot: As crime and chaos spin out of control, Knight Hawk starts to investigate the "god killer" bullet and Marvelous Man's mysterious demise.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E03 - Chapter 3: Anubis and How I Learned to Love the Nuke
1.plot: Anubis terrorists leave a gruesome trail of destruction while power-hungry world leaders move toward nuclear war. The Guardians suffer painful losses.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E04 - Chapter 4: You Can Own the Word "Justice"
1.plot: As the public loses faith, Knight Hawk's interrogations uncover more of the Guardians' buried secrets. Sparks fly between the Speed and Awesome Man.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E05 - Chapter 5: When Guardians Fall in Love
1.plot: A visit to Golden Goddess' lair leaves Knight Hawk undone. Motion Blur comes forward with shocking information about the "god killer" bullet.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E06 - Chapter 6: Shame Is a Lower Vibration than Anger
1.plot: Knight Hawk finds out more about Marvelous Man's secret life — and the truth about his death. The Mellow Devil drug ravages the streets.

1.title: FR - The Guardians of Justice - S01E07 - Chapter 7: Proximity to Power Corrupts More than Power Itself
1.plot: Armed with the truth, the Speed races to stop a catastrophe. Knight Hawk and Awesome Man face terrible choices for "the greater good."

meta.plot: Quand ils ne peuvent plus compter sur leur chef, qui semblait pourtant invincible, des super-héros en crise sont confrontés au mal qui ronge le monde… et leurs vies.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E01 - Imaginary Friends
1.plot: Young Dylan arrives at his relatives' home needing a place to live, but his streetwise swagger upends the conservative Wilson household.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E02 - Street Smart
1.plot: Yasmine’s celebrity client DJ Khaled visits, presenting Dylan with a golden opportunity to prove his rap credentials and score a record deal.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E03 - Chasing That Dream
1.plot: Dylan has trouble adjusting to the Wilson family’s rules, leading to confrontation with his uncle that makes him feel unwanted.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E04 - Plain Faces
1.plot: Dylan doesn’t want to attend school, and does whatever it takes to avoid going, including convincing little Charlie not to go, either.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E05 - The Enforcer
1.plot: On his first day at school, Dylan starts a classroom protest over having to wear uniforms.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E06 - Speechless
1.plot: The kids help Myles plan Yasmine’s big dinner at the house for her boss. While Myles struggles to write a speech in honor of his wife, the kids throw out the catered food and plan their own menu.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E07 - Flowers
1.plot: After failing to get approval to go to the school dance, Rebecca tells her date that she can’t go because her grandmother has died, a lie that leads to a series of misunderstandings within the family.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E08 - In Too Deep
1.plot: As Myles and Yasmine sort out the truth behind a lie that spun out control, Dylan helps them plan payback on Rebecca before she gets home.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E09 - Mother May I
1.plot: Dylan writes a serious rap about his mom, prompting Martin to read his diary to find out if he’s doing ok. Dylan catches him in the act, triggering an escalating run of each family member invading the others’ privacy.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E10 - Teachable Moments
1.plot: Rebecca is being bullied online, prompting Dylan to encourage Martin to respond to some of the posts. His posts are not anonymous, however, and the family must deal with the fallout.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E11 - Natural Beauty
1.plot: Dylan tries to help Charlie with his homework, but his unconventional style of doing his homework comes to a head with Dylan gets into a rap battle with their teacher.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E12 - Special Delivery
1.plot: Rebecca is babysitting Charlie and Dylan, but when a deliveryman arrives with a package from Dylan’s mom, Rebecca and Dylan fight over the rule about not opening the door.

1.title: FR - Tyler Perry's Young Dylan - S01E13 - The Rap Game
1.plot: The family can't get any peace while Dylan plays the drums all day and night, and everyone tries to convince him that he needs to give up his new instrument for good.

meta.plot: La grand-mère du jeune Dylan décide de l'envoyer vivre indéfiniment avec la famille de son fils aisé. Le ménage de la famille Wilson est bientôt renversé alors que les modes de vie s'affrontent entre l'aspirant star du hip-hop et ses cousins ​​à lacets droits.

1.title: FR - Catching Killers - S01E01 - Body Count: The Green River Killer
1.plot: The unsolved murders of women around Green River near Seattle haunt investigators for decades — until crime scene science finally catches up.

1.title: FR - Catching Killers - S01E02 - Manhunter: Aileen Wuornos
1.plot: A serial killer’s deadly road trip through Florida in 1990 leaves several men dead and spurs investigators to go undercover for an unexpected suspect.

1.title: FR - Catching Killers - S01E03 - True Lies (1): The Happy Face Killer
1.plot: Odd suspects, questionable confessions and ever-shifting stories confuse detectives in the hunt for a young Oregon woman's killer in the early 1990s.

1.title: FR - Catching Killers - S01E04 - True Lies (2): The Happy Face Killer
1.plot: A consequential letter surfaces with stirring claims and upends the seemingly closed case, calling into question the guilt of the convicted criminals.

2.title: FR - Catching Killers - S02E01 - Bind. Torture. Kill: BTK
2.plot: A terrifying Kansas serial killer reemerges after 30 years. Using DNA technology and help from the media, investigators race to prevent another murder.

2.title: FR - Catching Killers - S02E02 - Thrill Kills: The Phoenix Serial Shooter
2.plot: A serial shooter targets random pedestrians on the Phoenix streets, leading detectives on a desperate hunt for a criminal driven to kill for sport.

2.title: FR - Catching Killers - S02E03 - Missing Men (1): The Toronto Village Killer
2.plot: After multiple gay men sharing similar features go missing in Toronto, detectives follow an international tip with horrific claims of cannibalism.

2.title: FR - Catching Killers - S02E04 - Missing Men (2): The Toronto Village Killer
2.plot: As more men vanish, a fresh task force assembles. New surveillance footage and recovered computer files provide a final chance to identify the killer.

meta.plot: Dans cette série de crimes réels, les enquêteurs chargés de célèbres affaires de tueurs en série révèlent les détails poignants et glaçants de leur incroyable travail.

1.title: FR - Derby Girl - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Derby Girl - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Derby Girl - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Derby Girl - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Derby Girl - S01E05 - Episode 5
FR - Derby Girl - S01E06 - Episode 6

FR - Derby Girl - S01E09 - Episode 9
FR - Derby Girl - S01E10 - Episode 10

FR - Derby Girl - S02E02 - Episode 2

FR - Derby Girl - S02E04 - Episode 4
FR - Derby Girl - S02E05 - Episode 5
FR - Derby Girl - S02E06 - Episode 6
FR - Derby Girl - S02E07 - Episode 7

meta.plot: Lola Bouvier, 25 ans, star déchue du patinage artistique à l’égo surdimensionné, décide de devenir «la plus grande championne de Roller Derby de tous les temps» en intégrant, malgré elle, une des plus mauvaises équipes de l’hexagone : les Cannibal Licornes.

1.title: FR - Le bonheur - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Le bonheur - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Le bonheur - S01E04 - Episode 4
FR - Le bonheur - S01E05 - Episode 5

meta.plot: François Plante (Charette), qui est enseignant, décide de tout plaquer pour déménager à la campagne où il souhaite écrire un roman. Au bout du rouleau, il est en quête d’un équilibre qui pourrait rimer avec «sainte paix», mais parfois, quand l’on souhaite appliquer une recette toute faite et idéalisée, on provoque un sacré bordel.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E01 - Arrival
1.plot: Dr. Nancy Jaax has one of the most dangerous jobs in the world handling deadly viruses; after a lab accident, she is faced with a possible Ebola outbreak on U.S. soil.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E02 - Cell H
1.plot: Dr. Nancy Jaax and her lab partner, Dr. Peter Jahrling, must take matters into their own hands to determine the source of the virus before it spreads; Dr. Jaax convinces an employee to hand over samples from infected monkeys.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E03 - Charlie Foxtrot
1.plot: When representatives from varying agencies disagree on how to handle Dr. Nancy Jaax's discovery, she realizes there are few protocols in place for containing a deadly virus on U.S. soil; an employee at the monkey research facility falls ill.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E04 - Expendable
1.plot: An employee at the monkey research facility falls ill, causing Dr. Nancy Jaax to fear the virus has spread to the human population; Jerry Jaax searches for a way to protect his wife; Dr. Wade Carter is obsessed with exposing the dangers of Ebola.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E05 - Quarantine
1.plot: Dr. Nancy Jaax works tirelessly to find out why the virus is behaving differently than expected in human victims; unforeseen dangers arise at the research facility; Jaax is forced to make a choice between her family and her duty to her country.

1.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S01E06 - Hidden
1.plot: A volatile situation inside the research facility comes to a head; Dr. Jaax steps up, but exhaustion threatens the precision needed to sterilize the threat; the press arrives, and neighbors become aware of the danger next door.

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E01 - Noble Eagle
2.plot: In Florida, a man mysteriously falls ill and dies. Special Agent Matthew Ryker suspects an anthrax attack - how many others have been infected?

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E02 - Hell's Chimney
2.plot: Ryker’s investigation moves to New York as another case of anthrax occurs. Bruce Ivins begins having suspicions of his coworkers.

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E03 - Neither Rain Nor Sleet...
2.plot: An attack on Capitol Hill sends Ryker and his team to a mail facility that’s become a hot spot for anthrax infections.

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E04 - Dream Boldly, Live Fully
2.plot: The FBI learns more about Bruce Ivins’ peculiar past behaviors after an old colleague raises red flags. Ryker and Dani trace the origin of the letters.

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E05 - Stentor Roeselii
2.plot: All eyes shift to “Mr. Z.” As they start to zero in on a suspect, Ryker and Dani get new assignments - but that won’t stop them from chasing their lead.

2.title: FR - The Hot Zone - S02E06 - RMR-1029
2.plot: With two suspects in question, Ryker’s own beliefs about the case are tested.

meta.plot: La terrifiante histoire vraie des origines du virus Ebola, un virus mortel et hautement infectieux né dans les forêts humides d'Afrique Centrale. En 1989, il apparaît soudainement aux Etats-Unis chez un chimpanzé d'un laboratoire de Washington DC. Aucun remède n'est alors connu. Une équipe va tenter d'empêcher le virus de se propager jusque dans la population...

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Inspired by a news story, Phileas Fogg is goaded into betting that he can circle the globe in just 80 days, despite never having been abroad before.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Fogg's self-respect is shattered by an arrogant widower's ridicule, worrying Abigail and Passepartout even before a disaster strikes.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Stuck on Yemen’s west coast, foolhardy Fogg decides on a dangerous desert crossing, leaving Abigail Fix in a place where even a fellow Englishwoman proves hostile.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: In remote India, Fogg grumpily waits for a wedding to be over, but the groom is grabbed by the army. Passepartout is torn about potentially sabotaging the trip, while Miss Fix’s self-belief has been shaken.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Passepartout's knowledge of Hong Kong proves useful when Fogg’s finances are blocked. However, there is a high price to be paid. Abigail’s latest article could humiliate Phileas at a party in his honour.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Pacific castaways, Passepartout attempts to atone for his treachery, and Abigail is apologetic, but Phileas remains stubborn as revelations and regrets drive wedges between them. The Reform Club hears the distressing news that Fogg and ‘Fix’ are lost at sea.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Racing through the Rockies, Fogg unwillingly lets a laconic lawman and his prisoner share the chartered stagecoach, unaware the captive’s cronies are in hot pursuit, leading to a violent showdown before sundown.

1.title: FR - Le Tour du monde en 80 jours - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: An irresistible reunion, deadly dockside danger and regrettable red tape mean Phileas Fogg faces failure while his companions ponder parting from each other.

meta.plot: Londres, 1872. Phileas Fogg, gentleman anglais, prend ce pari insensé : faire le tour du monde en 80 jours. Il s'alloue les services de Jean Passepartout, un serveur français débrouillard. Ensemble, ils embarquent pour un voyage semé d'embûches, suivis de près par une jeune journaliste, Abigail Fix Fortescue.

1.title: FR - Les Hautes Herbes - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: A couple fosters a child after his mother is hospitalized and Eve questions Mounir's disappearance.

1.title: FR - Les Hautes Herbes - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Maud offers to help Eve search for Mounir, while Jules witnesses an act of infidelity.

1.title: FR - Les Hautes Herbes - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Eve finds a clue to Mounir's disappearance, while Glenn reveals a shocking secret to Jules.

meta.plot: L’été, Jules, 10 ans, est accueilli, à la campagne, par un jeune couple, car sa mère a été accidentée. Comment trouver sa place dans un village dont les habitants sont secoués par de profonds antagonismes ; comment ne pas craindre ce qui se cache derrière les hautes herbes ?

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E01 - The Secret Plan
1.plot: Two years after a breakup, Elsa is still obsessed with her ex. But when she meets dreamy schoolteacher Jules, her outlook on life begins to change.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E02 - The Sloppy Plan
1.plot: After learning the truth, Milou tries to steer Elsa away from Jules, while Charlotte ups the ante by orchestrating a magical second date.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E03 - The Booty Plan
1.plot: Elsa comes unglued when she discovers her friends have been hiding big news from her. Milou has a change of heart about Charlotte's scheme.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E04 - The Love Plan
1.plot: Elsa navigates a dizzying swirl of emotions after her night with Jules. Matthieu makes a confession. Antoine springs a surprise on Milou.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E05 - The Party Plan
1.plot: Simmering tensions, unexpected guests and romantic rivalries lead to mayhem at Elsa's 30th birthday party.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E06 - The Lame Plan
1.plot: Anaïs drops in for a visit as Elsa wrestles with growing doubts about Jules. A moment of reckoning pushes longtime friendships to the breaking point.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E07 - The Solo Plan
1.plot: As a shell-shocked Elsa takes stock of her life, Jules and Max vie for her attention. Matthieu helps Charlotte with a new business idea.

1.title: FR - Plan cœur - S01E08 - The Exit Plan
1.plot: Milou goes into labor, Elsa prepares to embark on a new adventure, and Jules realizes he may have one last chance to turn things around.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E01 - The Homecoming Plan
2.plot: After a blissful four months, Elsa announces her return to Paris. But she has mixed feelings about reconnecting with the old gang.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E02 - The Llama Plan
2.plot: Milou and Charlotte give Max a makeover, Julio catches a big break with his music, and Elsa stumbles deeper into a double life.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E03 - The Backup Plan
2.plot: When Elsa's lies come back to bite her, she vows to tell her friends the truth. But a surprise bachelor party upends everyone's day.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E04 - The Pick-Up Plan
2.plot: Elsa begs her friends for forgiveness, Milou dips her toe into a confusing new world, and Charlotte finds her business on the brink of disaster.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E05 - The After Plan
2.plot: After the city announces the winner of the barge contract, Elsa drops another bombshell. Meanwhile, a rendezvous turns into a wake-up call for Julio.

2.title: FR - Plan cœur - S02E06 - The Love Plan
2.plot: A sudden revelation brings the whole gang together for a day of celebration, mischief and romantic mayhem.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E01 - The Wrong Plan
3.plot: As Elsa channels all her energy into getting pregnant, Charlotte helps Max run for office, and Milou contends with the loneliness of country life.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E02 - The War Plan
3.plot: On a group outing, Elsa and Charlotte begin to play nice — but they each have ulterior motives. Antoine tries to sabotage the sale of the house.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E03 - The High and Dry Plan
3.plot: While Elsa and Julio adjust to an awkward living arrangement, Charlotte begins to see Max in a new light, and Milou lands a job with a celebrity.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E04 - The Worst Plan
3.plot: Charlotte decides it's time to rethink her priorities, Elsa embarks on fertility treatments, and Milou wrestles with doubts about the pregnancy.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E05 - The Sorority Plan
3.plot: At the country house, Charlotte and Milou try to help Max overcome his alpha male instincts. Difficult news leads Elsa to a turning point.

3.title: FR - Plan cœur - S03E06 - The Final Plan
3.plot: Two years later, Elsa and friends look back on the moments that changed the course of their lives — and brought them closer than ever.

meta.plot: Alors qu’Elsa, parisienne, n’arrive pas à oublier son ex, sa meilleure amie embauche en secret un escort boy pour l’aider à passer à autre chose. Mais le plan marche un peu trop bien ...

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: Nora takes her first steps toward financial independence in an attempt to move out of her dad's house.

1.plot: Nora and Grandma go to Atlantic City, where Nora gambles and runs into an old acquaintance on the boardwalk, and Grandma and her friends battle to use a casino power outlet.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E03 - Savage Valley
1.plot: Nora takes a job at a real estate office and becomes a hyper-competent assistant with a little help from Adderall, alienating her online gaming friends in the process.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E04 - Paperwork
1.plot: Nora has difficulties cashing a check at her bank. She later joins focus groups to make some extra money.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E05 - Not Today
1.plot: Nora impulsively dyes her hair after a fight with her dad, and Wally goes to a single-parent support group meeting.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E06 - Vagarina
1.plot: After Nora suffers a vaginal injury, she’s tapped by a DJ to record her chronic queefing for his new track.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E07 - Grandma Loves Nora
1.plot: Nora competes with Edmund for their grandmother's affection, and Wally creates an Instagram account to impress his crush.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E08 - Grandma & Chill
1.plot: Grandma tells Nora the story of how she met her husband in the style of a Korean drama.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E09 - Launch Party
1.plot: Edmund and Nora prepare to launch their app, and Wally’s dinner date goes terribly awry.

1.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S01E10 - China
1.plot: After Scrubr gets acquired by a company overseas, Nora moves to China. Back in Queens, Grandma befriends an injured pigeon.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E01 - Never Too Old
2.plot: After a starry-eyed look at her future, Nora trains a new CBD store employee. Grandma's newly diagnosed perfect bill of health leads to a face-off. Daniel catches Nora by surprise.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E02 - Stop! Nora Time
2.plot: After getting an MRI during an earthquake, Nora time travels to the iPod-filled world of 2003, where she sets out to warn her younger self about the mistakes she's going to make.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E03 - Charlie's Angels
2.plot: After Nora and Melanie reunite with a high school friend, they realize New York City isn't what it used to be. Grandma braces herself for a visit from her rich cousin Rosalind.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E04 - Edmund's Back
2.plot: Despite many setbacks and creepy auditions, Nora stands by Edmund's newfound acting career. Wally panics after discovering that Brenda's online dating profile is still active.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E05 - Don't F**k With Grandmas
2.plot: Grandma and her gal pals band together to take down a scammer targeting the elderly.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E06 - Nora Meets Brenda
2.plot: Nora fears that her maniacal imaginary friend is taking things too far when he helps her plot revenge against Wally’s sweet-natured girlfriend Brenda during a weekend trip to the country.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E09 - The Simple Life
2.plot: Edmund embraces life in Los Angeles, Grandma teaches Brenda about Chinese cuisine and traditions, and Nora does some soul searching when her car breaks down in New Mexico.

2.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S02E10 - Home
2.plot: Nora embraces her new life in New Mexico, but a distressing letter from home makes her reevaluate the future, and Grandma deals with loneliness during coronavirus lockdowns.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E01 - Nightmares
3.plot: Nora tries therapy after having weird dreams, Grandma goes to Brooklyn for a distant cousin’s funeral, Wally’s proposal to Brenda doesn’t go as planned, and Edmund enjoys his newfound fame.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E02 - Too Hot to Survive
3.plot: Nora signs up for a survival reality show to get rich quick and prove Wally wrong, and Wally uses his extra time at home to micromanage Grandma's life.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E03 - Love & Order
3.plot: Nora grows insecure as Edmund relishes in his success as a series regular on "Love & Order," Wally tries to land a new IT job, and Edmund discovers something new about his ancestry.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E04 - þetta reddast
3.plot: While accompanying Edmund on a trip to Iceland to track down his long-lost relatives, Nora meets a wise elfin woman.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E05 - Bad Grandma
3.plot: Nora is alarmed when Grandma transforms into a ruthless drug kingpin, Edmund and the gym bros surprise Wally with a bachelor party, and Brenda discovers her fiancé's big secret.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E06 - Carfished
3.plot: Grandma pushes Wally to make a grand romantic gesture to win back Brenda, and Nora gets a mystical glimpse of what her life could have been.

3.title: FR - Awkwafina is Nora From Queens - S03E07 - Nora Is Awkwafina from Queens
3.plot: Nora gains a new perspective on life after meeting Awkwafina, Wally and Brenda make amends, and Edmund unexpectedly finds love.

meta.plot: Nora Lum a vingt ans et vit dans le Queens. Elle aimerait que sa vie soit meilleure mais difficile d'évoluer en cohabitant sous le même toit avec son père et sa grand-mère.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E01 - Ulysses
1.plot: The first manned mission to Mars is now approaching the red planet. The crew includes top-flight scientists and a young female psychiatrist, responsible for their mental health. But just as they are about to land, something goes wrong.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E02 - Mars
1.plot: To save their stricken craft a sub-team seeks salvage, but the trio’s discovery of a body means a surprisingly harsh reception on their return.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E03 - Survivor
1.plot: Vladimir is not all he appears to be as natural disaster threatens the entire mission.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E04 - Stone
1.plot: The crew has a sobering encounter with potential rescuers, and Jeanne tries to hypnotize the enigmatic Komarov.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E05 - Alliance
1.plot: Jeanne is shaken after the failed attempt to hypnotize Komarov enduring memory flashbacks from long ago. Gemma Williams from the Zillion 2 mission arrives and tries to reassure the Ulysse's crew about Goldstein's intentions. Meanwhile, Gramat and Yann find out that Meyer knows a lot more about the mysterious discoveries on Mars than he admits.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E06 - Irène
1.plot: Is Komarov the 'unicorn' Earth-bound billionaire Goldstein hunts? As Jeanne leaves the spaceship to reach Thaumasia, Gramat tries a desperate gambit to regain the initiative on Mars, following her with Gemma as a hostage. Zillion's soldiers arrive to seize Komarov but Alessandra does not let them in. Yann is now alone against all.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E07 - Fault
1.plot: Caught in a predicament, Jeanne is overwhelmed by the memories of her father. In Moscow in the 1960s, Vladimir Komarov is told that the Soyouz mission is doomed to failure. Meanwhile, the crew of Odysseus are encountering more and more problems with the Americans.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E08 - Phoenix
1.plot: Jeanne, Simon and Gemma enter the excavated mountain discovering underground monuments and traces of a past life. Inside the ship, the crew members are under the threat of Doisneau and Wayne. Suddenly Irene wakes up.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E09 - Volodia
1.plot: Jeanne and Simon discover Komarov on the mysterious glacier who reveals what his mission is while Jeanne learns more about what is required of her, becoming the Z2 crew’s prime target. On the ship, Wayne is now alone against the crew of Ulysses while Alessandra tries to convince him to spare their lives - desperate measures take a terrible toll.

1.title: FR - Missions - S01E10 - Thunderstorm
1.plot: The survivors race for Zillion 2, but neither Gemma nor Goldstein (her boss on Earth) have rescue in mind. Simon decides to try anything to join Zillion 2 before the storm falls on them but Gemma refuses to take them with her; Meyer tries to convince her with the unexpected help of Jeanne. The mission is far from over…

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E01 - Dawn
2.plot: A child faces a disturbing rite of passage in a strange community living off the beaten track.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E02 - Returns
2.plot: Two new crew members discover each other while organizing a new mission to Mars at the Meyer Space Center.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E03 - Evolution
2.plot: While the space ship approaches Mars, Alessandra has new visions. In her community, Jeanne is facing the consequences of Atar's death.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E04 - Passage
2.plot: Jeanne encounters a mysterious man who seems to know her well while the Nausicaa mission is about to land on Mars.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E05 - Replicas
2.plot: The crew follow Jeanne's footsteps.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E06 - Alice
2.plot: Komarov tells Jeanne that Ivan Goldstein did not lie to her. Once on the other side of the portal, the crew does not know how to react to Alice's revelations. The other side of the portal.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E07 - Fury
2.plot: Crew members discover traces of life in a strange forest; William Meyer decides to send Sam back to the spaceship.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E08 - Others
2.plot: Meyer realizes it was a mistake to bring his daughter with him; Alan tells Sam to search for Alessandra.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E09 - Architects
2.plot: Sam and Alan raise questions about the origin of the portal; Jeanne is determined to return to Earth, but must search for someone first.

2.title: FR - Missions - S02E10 - Singularity

3.title: FR - Missions - S03E02 - Samuel
3.plot: A provocative encounter revives traumatic memories for Peter, who seeks to exercise control over Sam’s situation, but fate intervenes.

3.title: FR - Missions - S03E03 - The Key
3.plot: With new-found knowledge, Peter tracks down some familiar faces, until he meets his match and a deadly threat.

3.title: FR - Missions - S03E04 - Dark Clouds
3.plot: Alice discovers uncomfortable genetic facts, causing emotional confrontations, while Sam’s cause of death is revealed, along with another mystery.

3.title: FR - Missions - S03E05 - Empty-Handed
3.plot: A violent encounter lends urgency to Peter’s quest, while Jeanne’s mistrust increases, despite the reassurances of a companion.

meta.plot: La première mission habitée vers Mars, financée par un milliardaire philanthrope et l’ESA, est en approche de la planète rouge après 10 mois de voyage. À bord, des scientifiques et des astronautes de haut niveau ainsi qu'une jeune psy, chargée de superviser la sécurité mentale de cette mission historique. Mais, à quelques heures de la plus attendue procédure d’atterrissage de tous les temps, une autre mission, portée par une gigantesque multinationale de l’informatique et la NASA, dotée d’un vaisseau à propulsion plasma plus moderne et plus rapide, leur est passée devant avant de perdre le contact. Ceux qui pensaient être les premiers à marcher sur Mars deviennent donc, malgré eux, une mission de sauvetage de leurs concurrents.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: On a mission to rejuvenate the struggling community's ice hockey program, recently retired pro player Peter Andersson relocates his family to Beartown for a fresh start. But when the elite squad he was promised proves to be anything but, Peter switches his focus to the junior team, aggravating local tensions and reigniting his troubled past with star player Kevin Erdahl's father, Mats.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: With the finals rapidly approaching, Peter pushes his team and coaching staff to their limits. Meanwhile, as Maya attempts to work through the assault, Kevin does everything he can to forget. Later, Peter must choose between his family and the big game.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: While Maya and Kevin provide their statements to the police, the junior team is forced to take on the final without their coach and star player. Meanwhile, news of the allegation threatens to tear Beartown apart, and later, Amat grapples with a loaded offer.

1.title: FR - Björnstad - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The entire hockey community gathers for an emergency meeting to decide Peter's future with the program. Facing increased hostility from the town and harassment at school, Maya reaches her breaking point. Later, after the police close their investigation, Maya and Kevin square off in a chilling confrontation. Season Finale.

meta.plot: Le hockey est la dernière lueur d’espoir pour la ville de Beartown de regagner une certaine dynamique. Une lourde responsabilité pour Peter, le nouvel entraîneur de l'équipe junior, et Kevin, l'étoile montante. Au milieu de cette effervescence, un acte violent sème le trouble au sein de la communauté...

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Summer 1948: The D-Mark is introduced, delighting sisters Ulla, Gundel and Margot. A new phase of post-war life begins for the three sisters.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Ulla is accepted to medical school in Tubingen. Gundel’s father refuses to let her run the family company and Gundel seeks revenge on Ulla.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Eduard Wolf is on trial for war crimes. Ulla wants to prove his innocence. Until further notice, Gundel will run the family business.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The old feelings between Ulla and Tommy flare up again in East Berlin. But there is too much division between them.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Margot marries Bocker. As the new managing director of United Metal Works, he wants to have ammunition manufactured.

1.title: FR - Nos années miraculeuses - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: After almost a week in which no one has heard from Bocker, he suddenly appears again. He makes accusations that Margot betrayed him.

meta.plot: L'histoire de la famille Wolf dans l'Allemagne des années 40 et 50. Alors qu'Eduard Wolf est jugé pour crimes de guerre, Ulla tente de prouver son innocence. Pendant ce temps, Gundel reprend la gestion de l'entreprise familiale.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: The queen consort is pregnant and convinced she will bear Henry VIII a male heir, with their first-born Elizabeth being overlooked for the throne, but the king has his eye on Jane Seymour, one of Anne's ladies-in-waiting.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Anne Boleyn's position at court is in serious jeopardy and her new mission is to secure her daughter's right to the throne. However, Cromwell has other ideas.

1.title: FR - Anne Boleyn - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Anne Boleyn is accused of treason and adultery and stands trial. However, she is prejudged as Cromwell bribes and blackmails her ladies into testifying against Anne.

meta.plot: Biopic qui retrace les derniers mois d'Anne Boleyn, la seconde épouse du roi Henri VIII, en réimaginant sa lutte avec la société patriarcale de l'Angleterre des Tudor, son désir d'assurer un avenir à sa fille, Elizabeth, et la réalité brutale de son échec à fournir à son mari un héritier mâle.

meta.plot: Comme à chaque fin de saison de la Ligue 1, la grande famille du foot français fête ses héros : sourires, selfies, récompenses – c’est la soirée des Trophées UNFP. Tout bascule quand devant les caméras, Fodé Thiam, la star du Racing, assène un violent coup de tête à son entraineur et le traite de « sale toubab ».« Toubab », cela signifie « blanc » en Wolof. Sidération : la tempête médiatique peut commencer.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Nothing is going well in Joseph's life. His marriage to Marie is running out of steam: it is obvious that he is no longer attracted to his wife who is in despair. At work, it's not better. Oppressed by a tyrannical boss, Joseph spends his days in front of his computer, alone and jaded, selling labels. The only person who seems to want to bond with him is Jacques, the company computer scientist, a clumsy nerd who is harassed by his colleagues. But one evening, after having received a couple of friends at their home, Joseph suddenly had a severe stomach ache.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Joseph goes to a gold buyer who estimates his turd at ... 30,000 euros.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: While shopping, Joseph bumps into his upset friend Sylvie. She suspects her husband Stéphane is having an affair.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Joseph is now sure that his wife is cheating on him with Stéphane but prefers to feign ignorance. The gold buyer turns out to be a thug and begins to take a closer interest in Joseph, who has decided to hide his gold turds rather than sell them to him.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Gilles, Joseph's father, tells him that he used to lay gold in the past too! Joseph immediately understands that his mother was cheating on his father who never suspected anything. Marie begins to suspect Joseph to know about her affair with Stéphane.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Nothing goes for Joseph: he realizes that one of his productions is missing of its hiding place and then suspects Marie.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Between Joseph and Marie, the atmosphere is more relaxed since the truth is known. As everything seems to be going better, his marriage comes back to life and he is ready to buy his company, Joseph is kidnapped by Gino, driven by a spirit of revenge after the death of his father, the gold buyer.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Gino still threatens Joseph to get his turds back, while Marie breaks up with Stéphane.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Joseph and Marie find themselves prisoners in Gino's cellar, who intends to sleep with Marie so that Joseph can lay eggs.

1.title: FR - Or de lui - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: At the head of his new company, Joseph tries to find a solution to reimburse the tax authorities. To help, Jacques invests his mother's inheritance. Gino then offers to help ...

meta.plot: Un VRP d’une petite PME de banlieue dont la morne vie se résume à : métro-boulot et mariage raté, découvre un jour un stupéfiant pouvoir : il pond de l’or.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E01 - Willy MacIsaac
1.plot: Marcie faces off against a former colleague in her defence of Willy, a working poor dad accused of drunk driving. Pam hits Colleen's bureaucratic red tape when she volunteers to represent a disinherited friend. Marcie struggles to overcome her anger at the pastor who she believes helped drive her aunt to suicide.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E02 - Renee Joy
1.plot: An activist lawyer jeopardizes the future of Marcie's musically gifted teen client in the name of “the greater good.” Doug's defence of a lawyer accused of defrauding his community of millions dredges up his past at the Eskasoni reserve. Marcie and Carson struggle to keep their jobs from coming between them.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E03 - Taisir Ahmed
1.plot: Marcie races to find her client after he's snatched off the street by law enforcement. Pam scrambles to track down a new home for her pregnant client after her arguments against an eviction leads to the building being condemned. Marcie's work-place dating advice to Leah falls on deaf ears.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E04 - Delroy Nelson
1.plot: Marcie goes to extremes to protect her client after his plea deal is taken away. Reggie re-evaluates his marriage. Colleen and Gregor uses Doug as a pawn in their political games. Carson is caught in a lie.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E05 - Nikki LeBlanc
1.plot: Marcie's defence takes a turn. Doug represents Sam in a discrimination hearing. Colleen is accidentally outed.

1.title: FR - Diggstown - S01E06 - Kim Bond
1.plot: Marcie fights to help a mother regain custody of her infant son. Doug represents Colleen's former manny. Avery gets in the way of Marcie and Carson's rekindled relationship.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E01 - Vince Hu
2.plot: Marcie takes on the case of a dismissed police officer who killed a local woman during a high-speed chase through the streets of North Preston; Pam fights for a single mother charged with prostitution and fraud.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E02 - Cheryl Battiste
2.plot: Marcie's patience is tested when an Indigenous girl accused of murder refuses a deal that will afford her a more lenient sentence. Iris butts heads with Reggie when he fails to notice a client being blatantly racist, and Pam has an unexpected scare.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E03 - Willy MacIsaac Redux
2.plot: Marcie's previous client Willie MacIsaac resurfaces, this time charged with the murder of his ex-wife, Gloria; Doug fights for a nurse accused of stealing from his elderly patient who has fallen into a coma.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E04 - Tanya Ianova
2.plot: Marcie defends trans woman, Tanya Ianova, when she is charged in a seafood stealing scheme masterminded by her boss, but the efforts to clear Tanya's name may lead to her deportation.

2.title: FR - Diggstown - S02E05 - Vi Bayley

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire propose une incursion dans la vie de cette famille plus grande que nature. Tara et Pascal, deux trentenaires allumés et un brin perfectionnistes sont les parents de 10 enfants. Chaque épisode offre un regard intime et drôle sur la vie d'un foyer où le quotidien n'est jamais banal.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Candela, an unconventional judge with character, is sent to the remotest possible posting, El Hierro, an island that is full of peculiar characteristics, where she doesn’t quite fit in. As soon as she arrives, she must face a murder case. The victim is Fran, a young man who was going to get married on that very day. Everything seems to suggest the culprit is Díaz, Fran’s boss and father of the bride, a shady local businessman who had served sentence for murder as a young man.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Candela must decide if Díaz is kept in pretrial custody. Against the criterium of her team, and of the whole island, he is released on bail, although he won’t be allowed to leave the island and he will be closely monitored. In any case, it’s an extremely unpopular decision, compounded by Díaz’s determination to find the real culprit by himself. Candela, at odds with her own team, needs someone by her side to rely on, someone who also knows the ropes of the island. She takes a new controversial decision – she includes Reyes, a local police officer, in the investigation team.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: The investigation brings to light the dark side of Fran’s life: he had established contact with some mysterious person in Holland, and he had an affair with an unknown lover. Did Fran die because he was involved in some shady business? Or was it a crime of passion? Both Candela and Díaz make progress in their respective investigations, carried out independently. Díaz believes Fran used his contacts from the milieu of a dangerous drug smuggler. And Candela makes an uncomfortable discovery – Fran’s mysterious lover is someone very close to her.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: During a clandestine trip out of the island, Díaz discovers that Fran, just before he died, was trying to sell some valuable merchandise. He doesn’t know what kind of merchandise. And above all, he doesn’t know who was the partner from El Hierro who cooperated with him in the operation. This mysterious partner could be the murderer, because he is trying to get something from Fran’s environment (he broke into his and his mother’s houses…) Meanwhile, Candela feels the police investigation is progressing too slowly. The only person she trusts is Reyes. And in fact, the local police officer does discover (and us with her) who the murderer is. But she won’t live to tell the tale.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: The murderer, upon being found out, kills Reyes. From that moment on, he faces the difficulty of getting rid of the body in an island like El Hierro, where it is difficult to vanish without trace. Especially after the disappearance of the local police officer gives rise to a public outcry. There is a reaction in the island. Police forces, civil defense services and volunteers start a desperate search. The most likely scenario is that the murderer Reyes was investigating is back in action. Candela is devastated; she feels guilty because she is the one who enlisted Reyes for an investigation that strictly speaking was not part of her work duties.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Reyes hasn’t been found, but the search operation leads to tracing down a sunk boat which will provide new clues. The boat was used for smuggling African diamonds, and was found by Fran in a diving excursion. Diamonds are the shady business he was involved in. Candela cannot accept defeat in the search for Reyes, or the slowing down in the speed of the investigation as a result of the Descent, a religious festivity that paralyzes the island every four years. Desperate, she tries to get Díaz’s cooperation, who is also vent on finding the real culprit. The murderer feels the investigation is closing down on him. He considers fleeing, but he hasn’t found the diamonds hidden by Fran yet. And he diverts attention to everyone’s ideal false culprit – Díaz.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Díaz avoids being arrested by desperately fleeing. But leaving the island without being found out is impossible, especially with a police operation that shut up firmly the few available exit routes from the island. Finally, Díaz gets caught. And the island sighs, relieved – they will be able to celebrate their Descent in peace. Only three people in the island seem anxious: Díaz himself, who knows that someone has planted false evidence to frame him; Candela, who has a hunch there must be something wrong; and the murderer, who got the police off his back, but who continues looking for the diamonds that are at the root of his whole adventure. In the middle of the Descent festivities, the murderer discovers the location of the diamonds.

1.title: FR - Hierro - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: The murderer, taking advantage of the chaotic situation during the Descent, manages to get hold of the diamonds. But now he must face a new obstacle – the drug smuggler whose help Fran had enlisted has been following him, and he wants to take the diamonds himself. Meanwhile, Candela and Díaz go over their investigations together, and find the key to identify the murderer. They trace him down when he is on his way out of the island. They have caught him. But he is not prepared to surrender.

meta.plot: Mutée à El Hierro, l’île la plus éloignée de l’archipel des Canaries, la juge Candela se retrouve confrontée au meurtre d’un jeune local, assassiné la veille de son mariage avec la fille de Diaz, un riche entrepreneur à la réputation sulfureuse. Ce dernier devient rapidement le principal suspect du crime. Bien que mus par des intérêts diamétralement opposés, Candela et Diaz ont un objectif commun : découvrir le véritable assassin.
