2.title: FR - The A List - S02E01 - A Second Chance
2.plot: Safe at home, Mia recovers from her camp trauma — until she receives an unexpected message. Elsewhere, others work to escape a high-security facility.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E02 - You Don't Remember Me
2.plot: Mia, Petal and Harry officially start their journey with a new ally. In isolation, Midge makes a surprising connection. Amber keeps everyone guessing.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E03 - Two Birds, One Stone
2.plot: As the journey continues, Mia faces a major decision and holds Petal’s fate in her hands. Meanwhile, Midge navigates her new not-so-normal.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E04 - We Were Never Friends
2.plot: Past meets present as Midge reminds Mia of their history as friends… and enemies. Jenna and Fitz search for Harry and uncover a chilling secret.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E05 - We Deserve Each Other
2.plot: Midge addresses the group, sparking a new wave of skepticism. Alex, Petal and Kayleigh examine Dr. Shore's records. Mia and Luka forge a new bond.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E06 - Because of Who I Am
2.plot: After Alex dives deeper into her research, the group prepares a new plan of action. Mia and Luka revisit their pasts. Amber connects with a visitor.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E07 - Save Them
2.plot: Tensions mount as Mia, Amber and Midge meet again. Elsewhere, Dev crosses paths — and exchanges words — with Luka. Sam serves as a voice of reason.

2.title: FR - The A List - S02E08 - Who We Really Are
2.plot: As Midge’s power grows stronger than ever, Mia and the group stage a dark and daring mission in hopes of stopping her once and for all.

meta.plot: Un groupe d'adolescents débarque sur une île paradisiaque. Mais très vite, des secrets inavoués transforment les vacances de rêve en cauchemar.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E01 - The Siren
1.plot: Soon after the Coyotes arrive for Scouts summer camp, Kevin ventures to the nearby village where he meets Marie, then makes the discovery of his life.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E02 - The Corpse
1.plot: To protect his find, Kevin takes some drastic action, roping in Ferret to help. As Marc continues his search for Toni, officer Martine grows suspicious.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E03 - The Oath
1.plot: Now that the rest of the Coyotes are in on Kevin's secret, the group sneaks off to Antwerp to pawn their treasure, but a violent encounter rattles them.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E04 - Confessions
1.plot: The Coyotes return to camp to deal with Kevin's betrayal. Mrs. Kartash sends Amine to sort out the mess in Warnaffe. Meanwhile, Marie is interrogated.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E05 - The Break
1.plot: Dona and Freddo ambush Kevin to demand answers about Toni. Amine finally catches up with Marc, who's forced to propose a deal to protect himself.

1.title: FR - Coyotes - S01E06 - The Deal
1.plot: The Coyotes clash with Dob and conspire on what to tell Martine. Amine and Marc arrange an exchange with Father Julek, setting up a deadly confrontation.

meta.plot: Une troupe de scouts débarque à Warnaffe pour leur grand camp d'été. Parmi eux, le dernier venu de la patrouille des Coyotes, Kevin, un garçon rebelle et solitaire. Dès le premier soir, il part pour trouver de quoi fumer dans le village voisin. Il y rencontre Marie qui est la recherche de Toni, son ex, dont elle n'est plus amoureuse et dont elle n'a plus de nouvelles. C'est le coup de foudre entre elle et Kevin. Marie lui donne un acide et ils passent la nuit au bord d'un lac dans une carrière. Le lendemain, toujours sous l'effet de la drogue, Kevin plonge dans le lac, découvre une grotte, une sirène et des diamants. Ce qu'il ne sait pas c'est que ces diamants ont été volés à Moyersoen, un douanier véreux. Kevin confie sa trouvaille à Furet, son meilleur pote dans la troupe, qui insiste pour qu'ils retournent voir qui était cette sirène. Après avoir caché les diamants, ils retournent dans la grotte et découvrent le cadavre d'un jeune homme.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: An ordinary morning in a small town in Israel is shattered by unicorn mask-wearing assassins who kill four students and terrorize the local community.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Detective Davidi is convinced the four arrested Palestinians are innocent and that the murderers are among the students. Tom makes a "safe" list.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Davidi is partnered with Morag, a younger investigator. Davidi breaks the rules but discovers the Black Space app and receives a chilling message.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A video is posted on Black Space explaining the massacre and making more threats. Davidi arrests two boys but their complicated stories offer no clues.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Davidi and Morag find evidence at the burnt tree behind the high school and at one of the students' homes. Davidi's eye gets worse.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Omer stumbles on a video that had been deleted from Black Space. Tom becomes agitated when he finds out about the video. Miri is rushed to the hospital.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Davidi is taken off the investigation but Morag insists on consulting him. Everyone is freaked out about Tom. Omer turns to Davidi with information.

1.title: FR - Black Space - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Davidi can't be in two places at once and abandons Miri in labor to rush to a party at the school, where he believes the killers will reveal all.

meta.plot: L’enquête qui suit une tuerie dans un lycée sans histoire.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E01 - Mile 1: The Voice in the Shed
1.plot: Twelve-year-old over-achiever Layne finds her orderly life thrown into a tailspin when she discovers a sophisticated talking car named "VIN" hidden in an abandoned shed.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E02 - Mile 2: Paid to Drive
1.plot: Layne and Zora race against time to find the money to replace VIN’s control unit before his memory is lost forever.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E03 - Mile 3: VIN Goes Wild
1.plot: Despite having just uncovered a big secret, Layne attempts to stay focused on her school campaign event.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E04 - Mile 4: Changing Laynes
1.plot: Vin tries to pinpoint his purpose. Layne struggles to perform a physical challenge presented by her presidential rival Jasper.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E05 - Mile 5: Road Trip
1.plot: When Layne’s entire locker goes missing, she, Zora and VIN go on a road trip to search for it. Mel goes overboard while trying to repay his “life debt” to Cody.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E06 - Mile 6: Code Orange
1.plot: Layne misses VIN when her parents block her from spending time with him, and she’s distracted as the school election day nears.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E07 - Mile 7: On the Run
1.plot: To keep VIN safe, Layne and Zora hide him in the woods; VIN grapples with the realization that he might be a burden to Layne.

1.title: FR - Fast Layne - S01E08 - Mile 8: Helicopter Parents
1.plot: Layne must make the biggest decision of her life when both VIN and her parents are endangered.

meta.plot: Layne Reed, une jeune fille de 12 ans à la vie très organisée résidant dans la ville fictive de Cedarville, découvre, aux côtés de sa voisine Zora, l'existence d'une voiture ultra-sophistiquée dotée d'une intelligence artificielle et douée de parole dénommée V. I. N. (acronyme de Vehicle Integrated Nanotech), cachée dans un hangar sous-terrain secret situé sous une cabane abandonnée adjacente à sa maison. Elle finira par se rendre compte qu'elle est liée au véhicule et qu'elle semble donc être par conséquent la seule à pouvoir l'activer et le contrôler mais également que d'autres personnes cherchent à s'en emparer par tous les moyens et qu'elle devra tout faire pour empêcher cela.

1.title: FR - Le Mystère Kendrick - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Investigations into the deadly house fire reveal something sinister and the villagers must pick through the ashes to find answers. Was it a tragic accident or something more troubling?

1.title: FR - Le Mystère Kendrick - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The residents of Kirkdarroch come out in force for Kate and the girls' funerals. Jess meets an old friend of Kate's and is deeply shocked by what she discovers.

1.title: FR - Le Mystère Kendrick - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Armed with new evidence, the case looks cut and dried, but a new revelation raises doubt. The emotional effects of the fire are taking their toll on those closest to the tragedy.

1.title: FR - Le Mystère Kendrick - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: In the final episode, as the villagers try to rebuild their lives, they have to learn to be honest with themselves and each other. But will they ever get to the truth?

meta.plot: Tom Kendrick, médecin, est marié à Kate, institutrice, ensemble, ils ont trois enfants. Le couple est ami avec Jess et Steve, respectivement une collègue de Kate et son compagnon, agent de police. La ville est confrontée à un incendie terrible qui cause la mort de Kate et de ses enfants...

1.title: FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E01 - Our City, Akihabara. Exterminate the Otaku Hunts!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Fighting Maid Akira. Get Revenge in the Cat Fight!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Getting Over YUI's Death. @DEEP Gets Started! Catch the Cosplay Peeper!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Taiko in Love!? Save the Brainwashed Akiba Children!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Appearance of Imposter Yui! Exposing the Suicide Site Targeting Ota!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Female Announcer vs Otaku. Prevent a Media Frenzy!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Akiba of the Dead. Repel the Otaku Zombie!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Great Maid War. Investigate the Ero Maid Cafe!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Box's Past. Conquer that Fear of Women!
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Daruma Falls!? @DEEP splits up!?
FR - Akihabara@DEEP [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - @DEEP Goes Forth! Rescue Yui from the Electric Brain Castle!

meta.plot: Akihabara is a Tokyo district full of manga, anime, electronics, video games, figurines, etc. It is a place that gathers fanatics of such themes, people who are commonly referred to as otaku. Page, Box, Akira, Taiko, Daruma, and Izumu are six otaku each with his/her own troubles and sought relief through a website called "Yui's Lifeguard." When site owner Yui died of a mysterious death, the six who are each experts in their own fields gathered to form "Akihabara@DEEP", a "trouble shooter" group that vows to protect Akihabara and solve the problems of its inhabitants.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Sian O'Callaghan goes missing after a Friday night out in Swindon Old Town. As the family desperately waits for news, the police search for any clues to where she could be.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: The hunt for Sian O'Callaghan continues as Det Supt Steve Fulcher and his team see suspects come and go with no leads to follow.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher takes chief suspect Christopher Halliwell to a remote location to question him about Sian O'Callaghan's disappearance.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: The families of Sian and Becky discover that, despite the confession of Christopher Halliwell, getting justice for their loved ones will not be straightforward.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Detective Superintendent Steve Fulcher is lionized in the media for leading an investigation that recovered not one, but two bodies murdered by serial killer Christopher Halliwell. But behind the scenes he is facing a disciplinary hearing.

1.title: FR - A Confession - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Karen takes her fight for justice all the way to Downing Street, but it proves fruitless. Fulcher's scandalous actions cost him. Last in the series.

meta.plot: Déterminé à retrouver une jeune femme disparue, le policier Steve Fulcher enfreint la procédure pour coincer le coupable. Une décision va lui coûter sa carrière et sa réputation.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E01 - FILE #1
1.plot: Silicon Valley pioneer Paul LeBlanc joins forces with Special Agent Shea Salazar after a series of tech mishaps places the world in danger. Paul juggles his health and family life while Shea's son experiences bullying at school.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E02 - FILE #2
1.plot: After being mishandled by a Zava employee, NEXT escapes the confined servers of its home company and gains internet access. Concerned about her son, Shea recruits Paul and her co-workers C.M., Gina and Ben to help use Ethan's connection with Iliza to track NEXT's possible location. Paul tries to rekindle his relationship with his daughter, Abby, and grapples with the onset of his health condition.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E03 - FILE #3
1.plot: Shea and LeBlanc head to Dartmouth to investigate NEXT's whereabouts, which are potentially linked to Biomotion Labs. There, they visit LeBlanc's friend, Professor Richard Pearish for answers. Meanwhile, Shea, Ethan and Ty take extra precautions to disconnect from electronics and the Internet, and LeBlanc urges Abby to do so, as well, but NEXT complicates their plans.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E04 - FILE #4
1.plot: Shea and LeBlanc steal an important hard drive and enlist Ben, Gina and C.M. to help decrypt it, as NEXT creates chaos to stunt their progress. C.M.'s past resurfaces as NEXT targets the FBI building with a dangerous ploy. Meanwhile, Ted and his Zava team buckle down on their search for NEXT, Ty and Ethan hide out in a remote cabin and LeBlanc discovers new information on his health that may affect Abby.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E05 - FILE #5
1.plot: NEXT orchestrates an unlikely and dangerous reunion between Shea and someone from her past when she goes to check on Ty and Ethan. Ted is in trouble with Zava and figures out a way to remain in the company. Meanwhile, LeBlanc gets honest with Abby and C.M.'s life is threatened.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E06 - FILE #6
1.plot: Shea manages to save Ethan from extreme danger, while Ty makes a difficult decision for his family's safety. Then, LeBlanc takes matters into his own hands to remedy his degenerative brain disease. Also, C.M. and Gina escape the hospital and learn more about each other, Ted makes a risky deal to take over a server farm in Singapore and he uses Abby to access LeBlanc's NEXT hard drive.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E07 - FILE #7
1.plot: LeBlanc and Shea discover Ted's plan for the NEXT server and race to intervene before it is too late. Meanwhile, Ben and Gina investigate NEXT's latest victims, Congresswoman Elenor Beatty and reporter Harrison Cole, after a freak accident occurs, and Shea reaches her breaking point.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E08 - FILE #8
1.plot: NEXT manipulates a GPS system and causes an elderly couple to crash, while it also generates power outages all over the country. LeBlanc decides to plant a virus on the NEXT server, but must break into ZAVA in order to do it. Meanwhile, Shea and Ty have opposing ideas on how they should protect their family and Ben faces a conflict with his father.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E09 - FILE #9
1.plot: NeXt targets Congresswoman Beatty again when Agent Shea Salazar seeks her help to stop it. Shea discovers a leak within her team, as Gina encounters trouble while trying to code the virus into an NSA server.

1.title: FR - neXt - S01E10 - FILE #10
1.plot: NeXt taunts LeBlanc with a new tactic relating to his illness and Shea and LeBlanc devise one last dangerous ploy to destroy neXt, and save their lives, their families and the world.

meta.plot: Un pionnier de la Silicon Valley découvre que l'une de ses propres créations - une puissante I.A. - pourrait provoquer une catastrophe mondiale. Il fait équipe avec un agent de cybercriminalité pour combattre un méchant comme on n'en a jamais vu...

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E01 - Graduation Day
1.plot: When Los Angeles' newly elected sheriff dies, Bill Hollister is suddenly propelled into the role and must lead one of the largest police forces in the world.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E02 - 10-8 Outlaws
1.plot: Struggling to come to terms with the new responsibilities of his role as Sherriff, Bill refuses to stay out of the field when a criminal to whom he is personally connected resurfaces. Meanwhile, two new deputies come into the picture, Gabriel Luna, a training officer overseeing Harris' class of new deputies, and Charlie Minnick. Also, Undersheriff Jerry London and Bill continue to wrestle for control of the department.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E03 - 10-8 Deputy Down
1.plot: After a mysterious shooting leaves one of their own injured, Bill and the team go out on a mission to find the shooter. Charlie attempts to get answers about what happened during the shooting, leading Joseph to a revelation. Meanwhile, when Undersheriff London tries to take control of the department, Bill reminds him who is in charge.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E04 - 10-8 Firestone
1.plot: While enforcing an unsanctioned raid on a human trafficking ring in Los Angeles, Bill finds an old informant of his who is in trouble. After returning from her leave and eager to get back into the field, Charlie is assigned to patrol with Joseph, the one person she would like to avoid. Meanwhile, as Bill continues to disagree with the board on how to best run the department, Jerry does Bill a favor in order to get on his good side.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E05 - 10-8 Black & Blue
1.plot: When Joseph's childhood friend is wrongfully accused by the LAPD, he involves Bill in his mission to find the truth. Paula is put in a tough position when her hospital puts her in charge of making staff cuts in order to meet its budget requirements. Meanwhile, Cade is having second thoughts about the children he is fostering.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E06 - 10-8 Do No Harm
1.plot: When a gunman walks into the medical wing of the Los Angeles Correctional Facility - where Paula is volunteering - Bill has the entire Sheriff's department look for a way to get her out. Meanwhile, with only three months left in Bill's temporary stint as Sherriff, others decide to make a run for the role.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E07 - 10-8 Search and Rescue
1.plot: When a massive fire breaks out and the LAFD needs the help of the Sheriff's department, one of Bill's deputies discovers a suspicious car in the forest that leads them to a missing girl. Maggie learns the consequences of Bill's new job when reporters stake out their house for answers. Meanwhile, Cade and Teresa try to figure out the best way to broach an uncomfortable conversation with their foster children

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E08 - 10-8 Selfless
1.plot: When an ex-marine turns up dead on the street, Bill helps Cade work the case that hits far too close to home. With other candidates waiting in the wings to take Bill's place as sheriff, the department pressures him to be more of a team player. Meanwhile, Paula and Maggie see a counselor to try to deal with the repercussions of Bill's new position.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E09 - 10-8 Entitlements
1.plot: When a rash of home invasions hit West Hollywood, it leads the Sherriff's department to discover a burglary ring, whose members are competing against one another for bragging rights. Paula and Maggie continue to plan Maggie's Quinceaera, enlisting the help of Paula's mother. Meanwhile, Bishop tries to deal with an uncomfortable conversation with Genevieve.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E10 - 10-8 School Ties
1.plot: When one of Charlie's mentees from the local library gets mixed up with a gang, Charlie ropes in the whole team to help save her life. As Bill's term draws to an end, other players continue to enter the race for power. Meanwhile, Cade and Teresa are struggling to deal with an unforeseen situation with their foster children.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E11 - 10-8 Paperwork
1.plot: When Charlie and Joseph arrest a man on his way to a major drug deal, they end up bringing a bigger fight than expected back to the station. Meanwhile, Cade and Teresa continue to deal with the complication in the adoption of their foster children and Bill comes to a big realization about his job as Sheriff, as the window on his term continues to close.

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E12 - 10-8 Agency
1.plot: Charlie, Joseph and Carter investigate a case that becomes more complicated at every turn, while Bishop and Cade make a connection to a homicide they never expected. Still suffering flashbacks from the hospital takeover, Paula tries to find closure. Meanwhile, Bill's family strives to humanize him to the constituents of Los Angeles County

1.title: FR - Deputy - S01E13 - 10-8 Bulletproof
1.plot: When informants for the Sherriff's Department start turning up dead all over Los Angeles, everyone has to work together to find the leak in the department. Meanwhile, Teresa and Cade deal with a major setback in the custody battle for their foster children. Also, on the day of Maggie's Quinceanera, Bill gets stuck in a difficult position between work and family in the season finale

meta.plot:
Plus à l'aise dans les rues que dans les bureaux, l'adjoint Bill Hollister, cinquième génération de sa famille à faire régner l'ordre, donne de sa personne pour mener sa mission à bien.

Lorsque le shérif du comté de Los Angeles meurt, Bill prend sa place et devient responsable des 10 000 officiers assermentés qui contrôlent le Wild West actuel. Seulement intéressé par la justice, notre homme de loi va devoir prendre en compte la dimension politique de ses nouvelles attributions.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E01 - Fingerprint
1.plot: In 1865 two young adventurers, Anna Wetherell and Emery Staines, meet on the last day of their voyage to New Zealand.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E02 - The Place You Return
1.plot: Lydia and Carver hatch a plan to free Carver from his convict past. Emery sets sail to the goldfields in search of Anna. In 1866, the results of Crosbie Wells' autopsy are revealed.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E03 - Leverage
1.plot: Anna's suspicions are aroused as Lydia prepares to host a party. Lauderback is blackmailed. In 1866, Crosbie Wells is buried.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E04 - The Other Half
1.plot: In 1865, Emery and Anna have a disastrous reunion in Hokitika, Emery learns about Carver's past and Quee makes a rewarding discovery. In 1866, hope is fading for Anna - in desperation she takes matters into her own hands.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E05 - Paradox
1.plot: A stranger arrives in town and interrupts a secret council between the men of Hokitika. The events from the night Crosbie Wells died are pieced together.

1.title: FR - The Luminaries - S01E06 - The Old Moon in the Young Moon's Arms
1.plot: Anna is tried for murder. New evidence reveals a connection between Lauderback and Crosbie Wells.

meta.plot: Entre Londres et la Nouvelle-Zélande, une histoire d'amour, de meurtre et de revanche vue par le prisme de deux amants.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: On a solo trip to the Poconos, writer and pundit Muncie Daniels meets a mysterious new neighbor — then finds him dead under shocking circumstances.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E02 - Djibouti
1.plot: As the net tightens around him, Muncie moves to protect his family and offload incriminating evidence. An FBI photograph contains an important clue.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E03 - Discord
1.plot: A trip to an anarchist gun commune turns up a promising lead. Muncie asks Elena for a favor. Quiñones reveals what — and who — he's really investigating.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E04 - Radioactive
1.plot: With his face all over the headlines, Muncie is forced into hiding. But he's running out of options to clear his name and keep his loved ones safe.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E05 - Icarus
1.plot: Lucie revisits her past and reconnects with old friends. Muncie and Quiñones hatch a plan to expose Magnusson and bring him down.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E06 - Loco
1.plot: Quiñones and Khalil arrive at Magnusson's, only to find Muncie gone. They eventually track him to a nearby hospital... but someone else got there first.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E07 - DNA
1.plot: Muncie mourns the loss of a friend — and learns to accept help from the people he loves. All the while, a stealthy assassin is hunting him down.

1.title: FR - The Madness - S01E08 - No More Madness
1.plot: A late-night break-in threatens everything Muncie holds dear. Meanwhile, he has proof of his innocence — but will the world ever hear the whole truth?

meta.plot: Muncie Daniels, un consultant politique devenu présentateur TV, ne sait plus trop où il en est. Mais lors d'un congé sabbatique dans les Poconos pour écrire son grand roman américain, il devient le seul témoin du meurtre d'un suprémaciste blanc notoire… et est bientôt accusé à tort du crime. Muncie se retrouve soudain en cavale, obligé de se battre pour se disculper et démêler un complot mondial avant qu'il soit trop tard. En cours de route, il va renouer avec sa famille, trouver des alliés inattendus et lutter contre la désinformation à l'époque de l'infox.

1.title: FR - Sarah Scazzi – Le meurtre qui a déchiré l’Italie - S01E01 - Episode 1
FR - Sarah Scazzi – Le meurtre qui a déchiré l’Italie - S01E02 - Episode 2
FR - Sarah Scazzi – Le meurtre qui a déchiré l’Italie - S01E03 - Episode 3
FR - Sarah Scazzi – Le meurtre qui a déchiré l’Italie - S01E04 - Episode 4

meta.plot: Le 26 aout 2010, Sarah disparait à Avetrana. Les habitants sont tourmentés, surtout sa cousine Sabrina. Cela ressemble à une fugue mais ce n’en est rien. Pendant que tout le monde la recherche, Sarah s’est simplement volatilisée sans laisser de trace. C’est l’un des cas les plus médiatisés dans l’histoire des crimes italiens, l’histoire troublante d’une disparition, que l’on suit à travers les yeux des protagonistes.

1.title: FR - Docteur Odyssey - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: The Odyssey's new onboard doctor, Max Bankman gets acquainted with Capt. Massey and his medical team, Avery and Tristan, while treating crises miles from shore.

1.title: FR - Docteur Odyssey - S01E02 - Singles Week
1.plot: It's Singles Week on The Odyssey, and lust is in the air. As Max, Tristan and Avery navigate their relationship, the crew fends off advances from passengers. With rising desire and quickly spreading ailments, Max and the team rush to restore order.

meta.plot: Max et son équipe restreinte, mais experte, doivent gérer des cas médicaux uniques en haute mer.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E01 - Spaceship
1.plot: Gabby and Pandy unbox their first surprise, show off their shrinking skills and take to the dollhouse for a meowt-of-this-world mission.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E02 - Gabby Gets the Hiccups
1.plot: It’s time for another dollhouse delivery! Gabby and Pandy share their new Meow Meow Mail with Cakey and work on a cure for a sneaky case of hiccups.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E03 - Hamster Kitties
1.plot: A fuzzy delivery contains a cuddly surprise for Baby Box. In the dollhouse, Gabby and Pandy attempt to keep up with some cute and crafty critters.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E04 - Kitty School
1.plot: As Floyd settles in for a tasty treat, Gabby grabs a new piece of mail from the Meow Meow Mailbox and prepares for an action-packed day at kitty school.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E05 - Kitty Cat Cam
1.plot: Fun is only a snapshot away as Gabby and Pandy set out to take a group photo — and make time for a picture-perfect scavenger hunt!

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E06 - Dollhouse Defenders
1.plot: Super Gabby and Super Pandy shrink down to save the day from a mischievous CatRat. Can they solve his playful puzzles? Let the marvelous missions begin!

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E07 - Mixed-Up Dollhouse
1.plot: A sparkly Meow Meow Mailbox surprise leads to a mysterious dollhouse mix-up. Can Gabby and the kitties find a fix... and some bubbly fun?

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E08 - Game Show
1.plot: Ready. Set. Compete! CatRat takes center stage and hosts a series of dazzling dollhouse games. Will the crew win enough tickets to take home prizes?

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E09 - Kitty Pirates
1.plot: Gabby and Pandy delight in a day of pirate-themed adventures, featuring music, maps and magical travel. Cakey leads a tasty treat tutorial.

1.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S01E10 - MerCat Gets Her Sparkle Back
1.plot: Mush, mash and mix in a dash! Gabby and her friends prepare for a spa day. Meanwhile, MerCat deals with a sparkle disaster. Can the gang find a fix?

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E01 - Itty Bitty Blossom
2.plot: A darling delivery leads to a garden adventure when Gabby and Pandy call on Kitty Fairy and crew to help grow and soothe an itty bitty blossom.

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E02 - Dollhouse Store Day
2.plot: It’s almost time to get groovy at the music store grand opening! Can Gabby and Pandy earn enough kitty coins to buy an instrument?

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E03 - Kitty Fairy’s Sleepover
2.plot: As Floyd snuggles up for bedtime, Gabby, Pandy and Pillow Cat prepare for a sleepover in Kitty Fairy’s garden, complete with a magical pajama tree.

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E04 - Let's Make a Movie!
2.plot: Lights, camera, CatRat! Gabby and the gang help turn a beloved fairy tale into a movie and get crafty with costumes, props and sound effects.

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E05 - Pete the Polar Bear
2.plot: A frosty friend from the North Pole pays a visit to the dollhouse and learns all about the splish-splash spirit on his very first beach day.

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E06 - Kitty Rangers
2.plot: Gabby and Pandy receive special sashes and start their journey as kitty rangers! Can they use their new skills to solve a missing mama mystery?

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E07 - The Meow-Mazing Games
2.plot: Get ready to race, jump and fly as Gabby, Pandy, Carlita and the DooDads compete for a big, beautiful Meow-Mazing Games trophy!

2.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S02E08 - Pandy's Birthday
2.plot: Next stop: Birthday Island! In honor of Pandy’s big day, Gabby prepares a heartfelt gift, and the dollhouse friends celebrate with a series of surprises.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E01 - The Dollhouse Hotel
3.plot: A tiny suitcase surprise leads to a fancy hotel stay for Gabby and Pandy, featuring "cat-abulous" spa treatments and a popping pool party.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E02 - A Knight’s Tail
3.plot: Gabby and Pandy become knights in training and practice bravery by crossing a moat, mixing potions and more.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E03 - DJ's Glow Ride
3.plot: It's time to light up the night with a glow-in-the-dark delivery; Gabby, Pandy and DJ Catnip get to work on a train-building project.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E04 - Rainy Day Banana
3.plot: Inspired by a sparkly banana, Gabby and her friends make the most of a rainy day in the dollhouse and craft songs and snacks.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E05 - CatRat the Bandit
3.plot: Gabby and Pandy say "howdy" to a cowboy adventure as they hit trails and rails to protect a pouch of golden nuggets from CatRat.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E06 - DJ Catnip Gets His Groove Back
3.plot: Gabby, Pandy and DJ Catnip are ready to make music and search high and low for moving and grooving sounds.

3.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S03E07 - Kitty Fairy Gets Sick
3.plot: After Kitty Fairy catches a cold, Gabby and Pandy deliver dandelion soup and step in to save the day.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E01 - Cakey’s Cupcake Cousins
4.plot: It's cousin time; Bakey, Flakey, Marshapan, and Paddycake visit Cakey and the dollhouse gang for a "sprinkle-rific" day of yummy snacks and hug attacks.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E02 - It’s Purrsday!
4.plot: Gabby and friends go all out for an extra special holiday, throwing a "paw-tastic" party, complete with homemade decorations and dessert.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E03 - Dollhouse Safari
4.plot: Gabby, Pandy and their curious crew set out on an animal safari to find a mysterious creature.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E04 - Fluffy Flufferton
4.plot: Glittery and glamorous Fluffy Flufferton is the most "a-meowzing" pop star; the gang helps her shake things up before a big concert.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E05 - Abra-CAT-Dabra!
4.plot: A tiny top hat delivery leads to a dazzling day for new magician Baby Box; meanwhile, her closest friends help her perform a boppin'-and-hoppin' trick.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E06 - The Fairy Festival!
4.plot: It's fairy o'clock and the start of a fantastic festival, featuring rides, games, cotton candy, and a new friend with a flower contest dream.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E07 - Dollhouse FairyTales
4.plot: Tall tales come to life with a king, a mermaid and so much more as Gabby and the gang create and celebrate enchanting fairytales in a storybook castle.

4.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S04E08 - The Easter Kitty Bunny
4.plot: Gabby and Pandy practise patience as they wait for a super cute egg to hatch; luckily, Kitty Fairy, MerCat and DJ Catnip are there to lend helping paws.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E01 - Gabby, I Shrunk the Kitties!
5.plot: When Gabby and Pandy turn tiny from one of MerCat's potions, they'll need to gather the right ingredients to help them grow back to their usual size.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E02 - Mission to CATurn
5.plot: Gabby and Pandy blast off to Planet Caturn after CatRat gets stuck there looking for space cheese.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E03 - Doodlebook
5.plot: Gabby finds a book with the same doodle on every page; inside the dollhouse, the Gabby Cats use their imagination to add their own spin to the drawings.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E04 - Cupcake Tree
5.plot: Cupcake expert Cakey helps Gabby and Pandy shrink down a giant cupcake tree to rescue CatRat and the Gabby Cats from its overgrown branches.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E05 - Dollhouse Detectives
5.plot: Gabby and Pandy play detectives when things start to suddenly and mysteriously disappear around the dollhouse.

5.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S05E06 - Happy CAT-O-Ween!
5.plot: Everyone's in the Cat-O-Ween spirit; Gabby and Pandy make cat-o-lanterns with Baby Box, search for treats with MerCat, and make banana ghosts with Cakey.

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E01 - A CAT-Tabulous Christmas
6.plot: Meow-y Christmas! Gabby and Pandy have some Christmas wishes — but first they need to help Figgy the Elf learn from her present-wrapping mistakes.

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E02 - CatRat's Puzzle Hunt
6.plot: CatRat takes Gabby and Pandy on a puzzle hunt through the dollhouse, where they solve riddles, play games and find fun surprises along the way.

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E03 - Super Thinkers!
6.plot: While completing an obstacle course to become superheroes, Gabby and Pandy learn how to use their bodies — as well as their minds!

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E04 - Paper Cup Popper
6.plot: After Gabby finds a box of paper cups, the friends get creative making paper cup animal crafts, telling stories and playing fur-tastic games.

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E05 - Dollhouse Dress-Up Chest
6.plot: Gabby uses the power of dress-up to travel to the Wild West, outer space and even underwater to help solve her friends' problems.

6.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S06E06 - Kico the KittyCorn
6.plot: On a rainy day, Gabby and friends must take care of Kico — a baby KittyCorn who's part kitty, part unicorn — until it's time for her to meet her family.

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E01 - Planes, Trains, and Kitty Balloons!
7.plot: Gabby and Pandy take a travel adventure using a train, plane, cruise ship and hot air balloon — but they can't forget to take pictures for CatRat.

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E02 - True Fairy Friends
7.plot: A glowing lantern leads Gabby and Pandy to a Fairy Fly House! But to meet their new neighbor, they'll need to prove they're helpful, kind and welcoming.

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E03 - Googly Eyes
7.plot: When Gabby and Pandy find a magical jar of googly eyes, they're in for a troublemaking surprise. Luckily MerCat knows just how to burst trouble's bubble.

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E04 - Spongey-Saurus
7.plot: Roar! Stomp! When Spongey-Saurus gets wet, he grows. When he dries out, he shrinks. Can Gabby and Pandy keep their new dino-pal the perfect size?

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E05 - Baby Box’s Meow-Seum Day!
7.plot: The Gabby Cats need to make a special art project for Baby Box's Meow-Seum Day. But with many different ways to make art, who knows what they'll create!

7.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S07E06 - Carlita the Ice Cream Truck!
7.plot: Carlita has transformed into an ice cream truck! Before she can deliver sweet treats to all the Gabby Cats, she'll need ice cream, a menu and a song.

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E01 - The Magical Mermaid-Lantis
8.plot: SunnyCat invites Gabby to a Mermaid Sparkle Party in Mermaid-Lantis! But to attend, she needs to bring MerCat's blue crystal — and her special sparkle.

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E02 - Snow Cruise
8.plot: Gabby and Pandy learn all about snow science when they take a cruise to the North Pole to see a rainbow igloo that Pete the Polar Bear and CatRat built.

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E03 - Baby Benny Box Is Here!
8.plot: The Box Family welcomes its newest member: Benny Box! When Mama Box needs a nap, Gabby and Pandy teach Baby Box how to babysit her new brother.

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E04 - The Mermaid Cruise Ship
8.plot: Gabby's going on a mermaid cruise! There are a ton of fun activities to do aboard the ship, like making mer-mazing crowns, tails and treats.

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E05 - Charm Bracelet Treasure Hunt
8.plot: Gabby and Pandy follow clues and solve riddles to find sparkly treasures on an a-meow-zing Dollhouse Treasure Hunt. Can they find all three?

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E06 - CatRat’s KittyFish
8.plot: When Gabby receives a fishbowl in her Meow Meow Mailbox, CatRat wants to use it as a home for his itty bitty kittyfish. But they keep hiding!

8.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S08E07 - The Mermaid Christmas Cruise
8.plot: Santa Kitty is on his way to the Mermaid Christmas Cruise to give the first present of the year to MerCat's baby sister Hsiu Hsiu — and we're invited!

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E01 - Music Festival
9.plot: When Gabby and Pandy score party passes to DJ Catnip's music festival, they board a groovy bus to watch shows featuring all their favorite Gabby Cats.

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E02 - Cakey's Birthday
9.plot: Cakey runs out of sprinkles on the most sprinkle-riffic day of the year: his birthday! Can Cakey's friends figure out a way to bring his sprinkles back?

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E03 - Pandy's Bad Day
9.plot: After messing up his hug attack and getting a hole in his Pandy Pack, Pandy realizes he's having a bad day — but things just keep getting worse.

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E04 - Baby Box's Crafty-riffic Adventure
9.plot: Gabby receives a Crafty-riffic Adventure Kit in her Dollhouse Delivery, which comes in handy when CatRat spends the day crafting silly bad guys.

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E05 - Silly Kitty Cubes
9.plot: Gabby brings her Silly Kitty Cubes with her to the dollhouse, where all the Gabby Cats play along by making up fun stories based on what they've rolled.

9.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S09E06 - Carlita's Ameowzing Race
9.plot: It's the day of Carlita's A-meow-zing Race! After choosing their racers, Gabby and her friends speed around solving puzzles to win a special surprise.

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E01 - Happy Birthday, Gabby!
10.plot: CatRat wants to plan a party for Gabby's birthday, but Gabby can't decide on a theme. Will she make up her mind in time for his big surprise?

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E02 - Marty the Party Cat
10.plot: There's a new Gabby Cat in town: Marty the Party Cat! Gabby and Pandy show Marty all the fun features in the party room to make him feel welcome.

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E03 - You Wish!
10.plot: Gabby gets a wishing fountain and helps make the kitties' wishes come true, but Pandy can't decide what he wants — until CatRat gets into a pickle!

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E04 - CatRat's Birthday Surprise
10.plot: It's CatRat's birthday! Help Gabby and the gang plan a super-secret surprise party for their feline friend and his very special guest, Fluffy Flufferton.

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E05 - Craft Bot
10.plot: Baby Box's Kitty Bots cause confusion in the dollhouse when they wind up in the wrong rooms. Can you help the cat pals find where the robots belong?

10.title: FR - Gabby's Dollhouse - S10E06 - Grandma CatRat
10.plot: CatRat wants everything to be perfect for his grandma's visit. But when things don't go as planned, the day is full of new and exciting surprises.

meta.plot: This colorful series leads preschoolers room to room through a fantastical dollhouse of delightful mini-worlds and irresistible kitty characters.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E01 - Compassion
1.plot: Pathologist Virchow tries to uphold his liberal values in a time of upcoming nationalism. Doctor Koch continues his work on battling the rampant tuberculosis. Von Behring tries, in vain at first, to join his lab while Jewish Doctor Ehrlich is welcomed for his work on colorizing cells. Ms. Lenze recovers after an appendicitis but has to work off the fees for her treatment by working as a nurse.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E02 - Sunny Weather
1.plot: Spinola repays Behring for saving a life. Ida is urged to pursue an ambitious dream. Koch receives two visitors: a Tokyo doctor and the new emperor.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E03 - The Light of the World
1.plot: Koch reveals big news at the congress while Ehrlich struggles to find a doctor to deliver his wife's breech baby. Tischendorf and Ida's romance blooms.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E04 - Miracle Cure
1.plot: Nurse Therese falls ill. Koch tests tuberculin on humans, starting with himself. Behring reaches a breakthrough in his work on a diphtheria cure.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E05 - Twilight of the Gods
1.plot: Despite worrying results, demand for tuberculin overwhelms the Charité. Behring's diphtheria cure is put to the test. Ida meets Tischendorf's father.

1.title: FR - Charité - S01E06 - Turning Point
1.plot: Koch fails in one aspect of his life, but succeeds in another. Ehrlich faces a betrayal and increasing anti-Semitism. Ida rethinks her future plans.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E01 - Blighty Wound
2.plot: In 1943, a medical student seeks to use a soldier's case for her psychiatry dissertation, while her brother tries to prevent the man's court-martial.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E02 - A Difficult Birth
2.plot: In hospital, Anni gets a high-profile roommate. Dr. Sauerbruch welcomes forced recruit Dr. Jung, who shares shocking news he heard on the forbidden BBC.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E03 - Last Hope
2.plot: Anni and Artur secretly treat Karin. A colleague begs Sauerbruch to rescue his ill son-in-law from jail. Martin tells Otto why he reports to the police.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E04 - Buried
2.plot: Margot and Jung catch Miss Fritsch and Kolbe red-handed. Anni and Artur suffer a setback. Sauerbruch goes to Switzerland, leaving Dohnanyi vulnerable.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E05 - Underground
2.plot: Nurse Christel presses Otto for an engagement. Artur makes arrangements for Karin behind Anni's back. A coup attempt has consequences for Sauerbruch.

2.title: FR - Charité - S02E06 - Zero Hour
2.plot: As German defeat becomes inevitable, the Charité staff struggle to treat patients without supplies and await the Russians' arrival with mixed feelings.

meta.plot: La vie du célèbre hôpital Charité à Berlin, à la fin du XIXème siècle, lieu d'expérimentations médicales célèbres.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Spring 1945: Peace in Europe poses great challenges for three young people. The factory owner's daughter Klara looks after young concentration camp survivors in the refugee home. Her husband Johann wants to avert the ruin of the family company. And his brother Egon is hunting down Nazis who are hiding in Switzerland.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Egon is looking for a German who is on an Allied blacklist. When looking for a loan for his synthetic fiber project, Johann encounters seemingly insurmountable hurdles and gets advice from an influential lawyer. And Klara wants to fulfill a longing wish for the residents of the home.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Johann brings the German engineer Schneider and his family to Switzerland - the first important step to save the family business. Egon learns that Scholz was a wanted object in the highest Nazi circles. Can he put him in jail? And Klara is looking for a thief in the refugee home.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Klara falls out with Johann and acts dangerously stupid. Johann's synthetic fiber project is about to break through. With that he could save the family business. And Egon gets to feel it firsthand during his investigations: he has messed with very dangerous people.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Johann learns from Egon that Wilhelm Scholz and Carl Frey robbed Jewish families. The young entrepreneur realizes that his synthetic fiber project was probably financed by criminals. And because of the closure of the home, Klara has to find a new home for Jenkele.

1.title: FR - Le Prix de la Paix - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Jenkel's disappearance ends in tragedy. Klara finds out that she is pregnant. Egon is about to arrest Scholz and Frey. And Johann is in a dilemma: if he works with the authorities, he will lose the company. If he doesn't, he loses Klara and Egon.

meta.plot: A travers une histoire de famille, la série se penche sur un pan important de l'histoire suisse, peu connu du public. C'est aussi le portrait d'une génération qui a joué un rôle majeur dans la mise en place des bases de la Suisse d'aujourd'hui. Une histoire sur la volonté de changement de cette génération et sur la façon dont elle a perdu son innocence dans le processus.

meta.plot: À Barcelone dans les années 1960, Helena séduit un dangereux chef du trafic d'héroïne et acquiert les compétences nécessaires pour gravir les échelons.

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E01 - Bears
1.plot: Meg meets a new guy called Russell at work and invites him on a date - to play her favourite online game "Kingdom Scrolls".

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E02 - Tanadaal
1.plot: A movie version of "Kingdom Scrolls" has been announced but Meg and Nicky are not happy with the casting.

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E03 - Betrothal
1.plot: Meg and Nicky decide to get married in the game and things quickly get complicated.

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E04 - Big Nose
1.plot: Meg starts live streaming from "Kingdom Scrolls" but flatmate Alison worries she won't make a living from it.

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E05 - Patricide
1.plot: Nicky's dad tries to bond with him by playing "Kingdom Scrolls" but things get complicated when Nicky gets a taste for killing his father.

1.title: FR - Dead Pixels - S01E06 - Hive-Mother
1.plot: Meg, Nicky, Usman and Russell are set to complete "Kingdom Scrolls" and decide to make a weekend of it by cosplaying the final level.

meta.plot: Les vies de Meg, Nicky et Usman tournent toutes autour de leur obsession pour le jeu fantastique très populaire "Kingdom Scrolls" - un monde mystique, magique et surtout virtuel de sorciers et de wyvernes. Mais lorsque le joueur n00b Russell se heurte à son équipe, le groupe se retrouve de plus en plus obligé de faire face au monde réel.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E01 - One Way
1.plot: Asaf faces a new financial setback when a reckless driver bumps into his taxi without properly compensating him for the damage.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E02 - No U-Turn
1.plot: With an unexpected passenger waiting in the back seat, Asaf must turn to the only person he trusts to help him — his estranged wife.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E03 - Dead End
1.plot: In custody, Asaf seeks solace in the criminal justice system, but instead finds a whole new set of problems.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E04 - Accident
1.plot: A web of lies unravels as Inspector Cüneyt's involvement becomes clear. The young boy's origin comes to light.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E05 - Escape
1.plot: Now on the run with a listed missing child, Asaf faces a whole new challenge with a national target on his back.

1.title: FR - Asaf - S01E06 - End of the Road
1.plot: With Asaf suddenly at the center of the entire operation, he realizes it will be up to him to seal the fates of everyone around him.

meta.plot: A father grapples with his divorce as he spins into a world of organized crime. With his son's life on the line, what will his next move be?

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: A new courthouse drama that follows the chaotic, hopeful and sometimes absurd lives of its judges, prosecutors and public defenders, as they work with bailiffs, clerks and cops to get justice for the people of Los Angeles amidst a flawed legal process.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E02 - A Long Day's Journey Into ICE
1.plot: When an ICE agent pursues a defendant in Lola’s courtroom, she must fend him off while determining the appropriate sentence for the offender, an undocumented immigrant, whose crime was warning people of a grocery store selling spoiled goods.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E03 - Sweet Bird of Truth
1.plot: Lola immerses herself in the world of online gaming when she presides over her first trial concerning cybercrimes, after two friends go head-to-head over a deleted avatar and all the assets associated with it. Also, Mark discovers life without Lola in the DA’s office is going to be lonelier than he thought, and Luke is set to be honored at the annual Valor Awards for his heroism.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E04 - A View from the Bus
1.plot: When a jury's field trip to a crime scene takes a dramatic turn, Judge Lola Carmichael must determine if the trip she granted helped the defendant or biased the jury. Also, Mark is ready to take down a reputed crime boss, but discovers it's more complicated after he learns that a cop may have tampered with the evidence.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E05 - Devotees in the Courthouse of Love
1.plot: Lola officiates her first nuptials on "Wedding Day," an annual event when couples can get married free of charge. A nun with a shady past is charged for a criminal act against the church that Lola believes is morally right.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E06 - Fool for Liv
1.plot: Lola contends with a fame-hungry defendant, personal assistant Olivia McLeland, and a circus-like courtroom while presiding over a celebrity's murder trial that forces her to find peace at Sherri's home after she's chased by paparazzi.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E07 - Uncommon Women and Mothers
1.plot: Mark and Emily go head to head in court for the first time, and things get awkward when Mark must cross-examine Lola’s mother when she’s called as a character witness.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E08 - Maricela and the Desert
1.plot: Lola and Emily find themselves on opposing sides when the key witness in a murder trial is the victim's 11-year-old daughter; when Mark's key witness winds up in jail, Luke accompanies Mark on a road trip to bring the witness back to testify.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E09 - How to Succeed in Law Without Really Re-Trying
1.plot: When one of Lola's former murder cases is overturned on appeal, Mark helms the retrial and struggles to keep the bomber in jail, while Lola fears she may have prosecuted an innocent man.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E10 - Dripsy
1.plot: Lola exercises a rarely used judicial power when she fires a lawyer for failing to provide a robust defense for his client. Also, Mark's dad, Vic, is arrested for murder.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E11 - The Joy From Oz
1.plot: Lola must defend herself before the Commission on Judicial Performance after a bias complaint is made against her; Judge Lisa Benner enlists Sara, Emily and Luke in staging a Wizard of Oz-themed mock trial.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E12 - What the Constitution Greens to Me
1.plot: Following her battle with the Commission of Judicial Performance, Lola questions her own brand of creative justice; Benner assigns Lola a politically charged ecoterrorism trial that involves a senator's son.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E13 - What the Bailiff Saw
1.plot: Lola travels to Washington to help her husband land an important job at the FBI; Mark and Amy Quinn's relationship heats up as Amy tries to put together a winning defense for Vic Callan's murder case.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E14 - Bye Bye Bernie
1.plot: When Lola's mother makes a statement about her daughter in a newspaper, Lola must contend with her mother and her colleagues who commend her mother's harsh words about the justice system.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E15 - Prelude to a Fish
1.plot: As Benner prepares to run for attorney general, she seeks Lola's help to search for anything that could compromise her campaign; Emily's client is hesitant to file a police report against her abusive boyfriend.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E16 - My Fair Lockdown
1.plot: Lola’s world spins out of control when she presides over the trial of Emily’s client who rejects the rule of law and seizes control of the courtroom.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E17 - I Love You, You're Perfect, I Think
1.plot: When Lola learns a secret about Judge Benner, she faces an excruciating dilemma; Emily avoids the implications of Luke's "I love you" as she represents a client with mental health issues.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E18 - The Tale of Three Arraignments
1.plot: Lola and Mark find themselves in trouble for pushing their bosses too hard in their pursuit of justice and fair play; as punishment, Lola is assigned to arraignment court for the week, while Mark is bumped down to the Charge Evaluation Unit.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E19 - In the Fights
1.plot: Emily's composure nosedives when she defends a young man charged with felony domestic violence. Also, Lola struggles with supporting Robin's job offer and causes a rift with Mark when she reprimands his girlfriend, Amy, for grandstanding in the courtroom.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E20 - Merrily We Ride Along
1.plot: After a near breakdown, Emily arrives at a sobering conclusion, and Lola suggests she find professional help in order to get healthy. Also, Mark finds himself in an uncomfortable position after he agrees to do a police ride-along, and Lola is faced with her own crisis after learning that Robin didn't get the job in Los Angeles.

1.title: FR - All Rise - S01E21 - Dancing at Los Angeles
1.plot: With Los Angeles under a mandatory shelter-in-place order and trials piling up, Judge Benner authorizes Judge Carmichael to preside over a virtual bench trial, a case regarding a dispute between brothers over a car. While Emily represents the defendant, Kurt Beto, Mark represents the prosecution, marking the first time he tries a case in Lola’s “court.”

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E01 - A Change Is Gonna Come (1)
2.plot: Lola and Mark try to rebuild their friendship after Mark witnessed Lola being detained during a protest while defending a teen girl, amid an escalating encounter with police.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E02 - Keep Ya Head Up (2)
2.plot: Lola may be asked to recuse herself from a case after the video of her detainment is leaked. Also, Mark continues to seek the hate crime enhancement in Jesse’s trial, even after being met with resistance, and the case is further complicated when Jesse is suspected of having a medical condition.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E03 - Sliding Floors
2.plot: Presiding over Luke's cases forces Lola to acknowledge her own implicit biases and brings her into conflict with Judge Benner. On the home front, while Lola's husband, Robin, is in D.C., she ponders single motherhood and carries on a one-sided conversation with the new baby growing in her stomach. Also, Mark contemplates reopening an old investigation that causes friction between him and Amy

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E04 - Bad Beat
2.plot: Shows up in her courtroom in his official FBI capacity, Benner insists that Lola recuse herself. Also, Mark Callan, in possession of a dossier of explosive evidence in an officer-involved shooting, enlists Sam to help him figure out what to do with it.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E05 - The Perils of the Plea (1)
2.plot: As the holidays approach, Lola begins her first jury trial during the pandemic; Mark digs deeper into his case against a police officer.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E06 - Bounceback (2)
2.plot: It's a new year and Lola's baby is due any day. She learns the jury was going to deliver a "not guilty" verdict in a case in which she pressured defendant Leon Parsons to take a plea deal, forcing her to decide whether to let the plea stand and protect her reputation, or reveal what she knows to Leon. Also, Mark's in the midst of an intense negotiation with DA Louis Bravo regarding how and when to arrest and charge Deputy Sheriff Rashel for attempted murder, when Mark is the victim of a brazen knife attack.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E07 - Almost the Meteor
2.plot: While Lola is on maternity leave after going into labor while on the bench, she attempts to participate remotely in Judge Brenner’s special training about brain science and the law. Also, when Luke finds himself opposite Emily on an armed robbery case, he sees an ally in his experiment with restorative justice, and Mark hits another roadblock in his high profile case against a sheriff’s deputy,

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E08 - Bette Davis Eyes
2.plot: Mark is forced to prosecute his childhood icon, Samara Strong, an '80s Hollywood star accused of murdering her husband 30 years ago; Judge Laski is presiding over cases while Lola is on maternity leave.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E09 - Safe to Fall
2.plot: Emily and Sam face off in the courtroom in an emotionally gripping case that will determine the fate of a mentally ill young man who attacked his father. Also, due to financial struggles, Rachel crashes at Mark and Amy’s place, reigniting Mark and Rachel’s flame.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E10 - Georgia
2.plot: Emily and Mark face off in court in a compelling jewellery store robbery case that puts the entire concept of eyewitnesses on trial; still struggling with financial woes, Amy brings in a potential client who happens to be a friend of Mark's father.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E11 - Forgive Us Our Trespasses
2.plot: With Ness nearing the end of her clerkship, Lola sets her up to shadow Emily, who is defending a young man who reoffended, and the verdict lies with Judge Campbell who is notoriously harsh on repeat offenders. Also, Rachel reveals to Lola that she kissed Mark, and Mark struggles to find out why Luke’s name is on a list of cops dropped off by Deep Throat.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E12 - Chasing Waterfalls
2.plot: Mark and Sam think their "Romeo and Juliet"-style murder case of warring families is a slam dunk until their lead witness is proven to be lying under oath to protect the real eyewitness of a relative's murder. Also, Amy is furious with Mark after a secret is revealed and decides they need time apart.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E13 - Love's Illusions
2.plot: Lola returns to the Hall of Justice and presides over a case where Amy represents a young woman accused of a swatting incident that resulted in the Dean of a university being shot. Also, Amy and Rachel make up, and Amy brings her divorce papers to her dying husband.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E14 - Caught Up in Circles
2.plot: Lola is conflicted when a former judge, Judge Prudence Jenkins, whom she idolized, has been accused of bribery and is representing herself in a bench trial. Also, Mark moves forward with the case against McCarthy and he and Corrine Cuthbert each get one unchallenged request for a new judge, no questions asked.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E15 - Hear My Voice
2.plot: Lola finds herself in the judicial hotseat when she presides over the case of former Sherriff Wayne McCarthy, and struggles because she and Mark can't talk to each other outside the courtroom. Also, Detective Rashel and other cops come forward to speak against McCarthy, but Corinne continues to turn their testimonies against them, and Luke demands that Mark allow him to take the stand.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E16 - Leap of Faith
2.plot: Lola is tested like never before during a high-profile murder case when the women of Audubon and Associates—Rachel and Amy—combine forces with Public Defender Emily to represent the co-defendants. Also, David Sanders helps Lola court donations and endorsements to prepare for her upcoming re-election campaign.

2.title: FR - All Rise - S02E17 - Yeet
2.plot: The murder trials against Alexander Moore and Jack Allen begin, and the pressure mounts when Lola agrees to allow media into the courtroom to support her re-election campaign. Also, Mark and Amy commit to their relationship, even though they’re on opposite sides of the trial, and Luke looks for a way to win Emily back.

meta.plot: En dépit du dévouement de ses avocats, juges et autres procureurs chargés d'assurer le bon fonctionnement de la machine judiciaire, l'envers du décor de la justice américaine peut parfois se révéler absurde, voire chaotique. Et quand Lola Carmichael, adjointe respectée du procureur à Los Angeles, est fraîchement nommée juge, la jeune femme entend profiter de sa nouvelle position pour apporter sa pierre à l'édifice. Saura-t-elle composer avec les limites du système et se remettre en question ?

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E01 - Station to Station
1.plot: CIA Officer Daniel Miller arrives in Berlin on a clandestine mission to unearth an anonymous whistleblower, alias Thomas Shaw, and reunites with his old friend Hector DeJean. As Daniel gets closer to Shaw, his quarry reacts in murderous fashion.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E02 - Lights Don't Run on Loyalty
1.plot: As Daniel pursues Shaw, Station Chief Steven Frost and his associates Valerie Edwards and Robert Kirsch gather intelligence on a Georgian Islamic radical in order to avoid an extraordinary rendition by Langley. By episode’s end, Hector surprises us all.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E03 - Riverrun Dry
1.plot: Frost and Kirsch worry their secrets will be unearthed when Langley investigators sweep Berlin Station to ferret out fodder for future Shaw leaks. Meanwhile, Daniel's hunt for the mole is put at risk.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E04 - By Way of Deception
1.plot: Daniel and Hector embark on a dangerous operation to track down Shaw. Meanwhile, Valerie finds out the truth behind Iosava, and Frost and Kirsch deliberate future plans for themselves and the rest of Berlin Station.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E05 - Unter Druck
1.plot: Daniel teams up with Esther Krug of the BfV to prevent the next Shaw leak involving a foreign defector. Valerie and Robert spar over strategy as her investigation into Iosava gains traction; Hector gets a late-night visit from Shirley Pimple.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E06 - Just Decisions
1.plot: Valerie's investigation into Aleksandre and Ruth Iosava comes to a head in a German/American sting Operation involving Clare Itani, a CIA Officer and Hector’s lover. Langley's unannounced participation moves things from bad to worse.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E07 - Proof of Life
1.plot: Frost must pick up the pieces after the Iosava Operation goes sour while Robert explores a different angle. Hector goes rogue but brings Daniel with him, preempting a crucial moment of clarity.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E08 - False Negative
1.plot: Repercussions from the Iosava debacle leave Frost in the shadows and the Station in disarray as Robert embraces a new role. Hector finds himself in the hot seat, Valerie reveals a secret of her own––and Daniel inches closer to the truth.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E09 - Thomas Shaw
1.plot: The mystery of Shaw's true identity finally solved, Daniel confronts his own conscience as he learns the origins of "Thomas Shaw"; Valerie’s suspicions about Robert further escalate rising tensions between them, and Kelly Frost suddenly becomes an integral part of the team.

1.title: FR - Berlin Station - S01E10 - Oratorio Berlin
1.plot: Daniel assembles the crew as they piece together the extent of Langley's involvement in the Iosava rendition. Steven and Kelly Frost reunite against the odds; Hector pursues a new approach for his atonement – and the Thomas Shaw mantle is passed.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E01 - Everything's Gonna Be Alt-Right
2.plot: Under the direction of new Chief of Staff BB Yates, Daniel Miller, Robert Kirsch, Valerie Edwards and the rest of Berlin Station embark on an unsanctioned operation to uncover a possible Far Right terrorist attack.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E02 - Right Here, Right Now
2.plot: In a 24-hour episode set completely in Spain, Daniel uses Hector to further his mission with Otto, much to Hector's dismay.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E03 - Right to the Heart
2.plot: Valerie works to obtain intel on the Far Right while Robert's teenage son Noah arrives in Berlin and asks questions. Meanwhile, Frost agrees to the Ambassador's request to spy on Berlin Station.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E04 - Do the Right Thing
2.plot: BB Yates's past is revealed while she juggles keeping Berlin Station's Far Right operation covert or revealing it to Ambassador Hanes; Daniel discovers a lack of trust between Otto Ganz and his daughter.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E05 - Right of Way
2.plot: The Station's sting operation to catch the Far Right in an arms deal goes horribly awry, with Otto Ganz escaping. Meanwhile, Robert and Frost make plans to investigate the money trail behind the PfD's nefarious dealings.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E06 - The Right Hook
2.plot: Robert and Frost travel to Norway to investigate the illegal money trail leading to PfD; BB and Valerie devise a new plan involving a member of the Far Right; Daniel deals with the psychological consequences of his mission.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E07 - Right and Wrong
2.plot: April weighs telling Robert about Hector's assassination plot; Daniel tries to arrange safe passage out of Berlin for Hector with help from Esther.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E08 - The Righteous One
2.plot: Hector is wanted by German authorities for the assassination of Katerina Gerhardt, but Berlin Station begins to discover there is more at play than a jaded ex-CIA officer.

2.title: FR - Berlin Station - S02E09 - Winners Right the History Books
2.plot: Berlin Station continues to search for the truth behind Katerina Gerhardt's assassination and Nick Fischer's role in it, as a protest outside the US Embassy and calls to turn Hector over escalate.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E01 - Aut Concilio Aut Ense
3.plot: Valerie Edwards sends Daniel Miller and Robert Kirsch on an urgent mission, where they meet renegade CIA Officer Rafael Torres, and uncover signs of a covert invasion.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E02 - Fire Knows Nothing of Mercy
3.plot: Berlin Station follows up on the evidence Kirsch brought home from his mission, crystallizing their theory about a possible upcoming invasion.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E03 - The Old Lie
3.plot: The Station enlists Rafael Torres to track down a missing comrade's, Daniel Miller's last known location, leading him to hostile territory. Kirsch visits an old friend.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E04 - If You Swear, You'll Catch No Fish
3.plot: The explosion of a fishing boat is detected. CIA agent Rafael Torres violates the order of the Station Chief of Berlin Station, and retrieves the burned body that he believes is of missing CIA agent Daniel Miller.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E05 - The Dream of the Four Policemen
3.plot: Kirsch and Torres must risk their lives to secure their fallen comrade's location. When B.B. Yates returns to Berlin, the Station must decide whether or not they can trust an emissary of the Oval Office.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E06 - In Cold Hell
3.plot: Valerie and B.B. rally the support of the 14-Eyes, a powerful intelligence collective. Kirsch and April, using Sofia as bait, trap Sergei. Kirsch offers to swap Sergei for Daniel. April comes clean to her asset, securing the tech for U.S. interests. Esther activates Bruno, a German Special Operator, to locate Daniel. Frost introduces Torres to Hector, whose new identity as a roofer to oligarchs provides a way to infiltrate the Russian elite. Frost investigates one of the soldiers formerly under Krik's command to gain kompromat from his war days.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E07 - The Eye Fears When It Is Done to See
3.plot: Valerie is stunned when B.B. betrays her and votes against the 14-Eyes invoking Article 5. April faces the loss of the tech when her assets are arrested and face deportation. Kirsch's spy swap goes horribly awry when Bruno, Esther's officer, is exchanged instead of Daniel. Platov invites Hector and Torres to Krik's dacha, forcing them to navigate the treacherous world of Russian oligarchs. Their mission is upended when Hector falls out of favor with Krik and finds himself human prey in their evening hunt, along with one other prisoner: Daniel.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E08 - The Green Dacha
3.plot: Daniel and Hector are being hunted by Vassily Krik. They manage to find shelter in a green house in the woods where a well-kept secret will be revealed.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E09 - End of War
3.plot: Frost volunteers with Valerie's reluctant consent to rescue Daniel from Krik's estate. When Daniel confronts Frost about his past alias as "Diver" shots are fired. Hector is a secret witness. Krik is arrested by his government. Daniel's body is dumped on the streets of Berlin. Torres uses his cover as a ruse to get Platov to Germany. The Estonian communications network is hijacked, but Sofia can only use her master password by returning to her country.

3.title: FR - Berlin Station - S03E10 - Book of the Fallen
3.plot: Mere hours remain before enemy forces topple the Estonian government. Without Langley's backing, Berlin Station acts alone in one final desperate push to prevent the fall of a nation.

meta.plot: Daniel Miller, un analyste de la CIA, est transféré au bureau de Berlin. Sa mission : découvrir de manière officieuse la source qui alimente un célèbre lanceur d'alerte, Thomas Shaw.

meta.plot: Mahinga est une discothèque dirigée par la puissante famille d'un village emblématique de Benguela, Dombe Grande, connu pour sa mystique et ses puissants sorciers. La patronne est Karina, une femme qui exerce un pouvoir effrayant et domine tout le monde autour d'elle. Est-elle simplement bonne dans ce qu'elle fait, ou y a-t-il une force plus sombre et plus surnaturelle à l'œuvre qui pourrait la confronter ?

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E01 - Best Friends
1.plot: Rami has turned his back on a life of crime to be a good husband and father, but a business investment gets him tangled up with the wrong crowd.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E02 - The White Whale
1.plot: Michel and Rami start building their team, while Detective Chief Inspector Leonie Hamsik gets into trouble at work.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E03 - The Devil Is in the Details
1.plot: Michel goes looking for funds. Leonie takes a trip to Belgrade to learn more, while Rami gets an unexpected visitor.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E04 - Cat and Mouse
1.plot: Rami struggles to keep things together at home. The search for a helicopter intensifies. Leonie runs into an old acquaintance.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E05 - Making Tsunami
1.plot: Leonie's investigation comes to a halt. Things heat up as the big day draws near, and the newest member of the crew must follow the line.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E06 - Showtime
1.plot: Everything must go to plan as Rami, Michel and their team land on the high-security cash depot with 15 minutes to get in and out.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E07 - The Hunt
1.plot: The police are slowed down by a confusion of jurisdiction. Axel improvises when the pressure is at its highest.

1.title: FR - Le Casse du ciel - S01E08 - Too Close to the Sun
1.plot: Rami thinks through the consequences of his actions, while Leonie works tirelessly to solve the case.

meta.plot: Deux amis d'enfance décident de se lancer dans un dernier braquage pour voler des millions dans un dépôt de fonds suédois hyper sécurisé. Mais la police veille...
