meta.plot: Gaspard Berthille est le directeur du Tout-Paris, célèbre cabaret entretenant le mythe des folles nuits parisiennes à l’instar du Paradis Latin et des autres grands cabarets de la capitale. Mais contrairement à son père, Dary, l’ancien directeur et légendaire meneur de revue, Gaspard n’a pas su faire perpétuer la notoriété de l’établissement. La faute à un spectacle vieillissant ? À un Gaspard mauvais gestionnaire ? À une concurrence plus innovante ? Gaspard va devoir faire des choix, mais l’arrivée d’un nouvel investisseur, accompagné de son fils, va venir bousculer sa décision première, et profondément modifier la vie et les destins de l’ensemble de l’équipe du Tout-Paris.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E01 - Little Egg Eyes
1.plot: A night at the comedy club prompts Alexis and Charly to leave their hometown. But a new city means new challenges.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E02 - You’re an Inspiration
1.plot: After their first attempt at working fails, Alexis and Charly devise a new strategy to make ends meet. A surprise guest enters the picture.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E03 - You Can’t
1.plot: Alexis regains consciousness at a veterinary clinic — and he's instantly smitten. Charly comes up with a grand gesture to sway Alexis into staying.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E04 - I Just Want to Be Normal
1.plot: Chocho steals Alexis and Charly's business idea. The gang goes to see a performance and, as the night unfolds, punches fly — but so do sparks.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E05 - You Got a Stage Name?
1.plot: As Alexis and Charly find themselves broke once again, Alexis succumbs to doing something he hates in hopes of eventually doing what he loves.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E06 - A Blind Person’s Gotta Do What a Blind Person’s Gotta Do
1.plot: Alexis's parents express their concerns. Chocho is asked to postpone the contest. A visit to Civil Protection provides interesting insights.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E07 - The Dog That Caught the Car
1.plot: Alexis is overwhelmed by fear and nerves as his big chance looms ahead. Once again, obstacles obstruct his path — with himself being one of them.

1.title: FR - On a vu pire - S01E08 - Missing Piece
1.plot: Tragedy brings the gang back together, but it's a short-lived reunion — will Alexis make amends to secure the pieces he needs to complete his dream?

meta.plot: Quand un aspirant comique aveugle poursuit son rêve aux côtés de son meilleur ami atteint de paralysie cérébrale, rien ne peut les arrêter, peu importe ce qui leur tombe dessus.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E01 - Changing of the Guard
1.plot: Two decades since viewers last saw them, the Ewing’s are back. Television's first family of drama, sabotage, secrets and betrayal are gathering at Southfork Ranch for the upcoming wedding of Bobby’s adopted son, Christopher, to Rebecca Sutter. Although the occasion is joyous, an old family rivalry crosses generations after secret oil drilling on Southfork results in a major gusher. Everyone has his or her own agenda when the fight over oil and land threatens to tear the Ewings apart once again.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E02 - Hedging Your Bets
1.plot: The plot to take control of Southfork gets complicated when two-timing affairs and blackmail arise, and J.R. starts to ask one too many questions. Meanwhile, Christopher and Elena bury their feelings in order work together on a business deal. But Christopher’s new bride may be hiding her own secrets.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E03 - The Price You Pay
1.plot: Just as John Ross sets out to claim his birthright and make his father proud, J.R. decides to move back to Southfork, much to Ann’s dismay. Bitter Ewing family enemy Cliff Barnes returns and tries to reconnect with his nephew, Christopher. A startling family announcement offers an opportunity to heal old wounds.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E04 - The Last Hurrah
1.plot: John Ross seeks to gain an upper hand on a family member and resorts to blackmail, but J.R. decides to handle the situation his own way. Meanwhile, Christopher opens up to Bobby about his difficulty in choosing between the two women he loves.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E05 - Truth and Consequences
1.plot: With tension mounting between the newly married Christopher and Rebecca, family ties begin to unravel when the deed to Southfork is revealed. In order to thwart J.R.’s schemes, Ann seeks help from someone in her past, and Christopher decides it is time to fight dirty.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E06 - The Enemy of My Enemy
1.plot: John Ross is bothered by the weight of having to do his father's dirty work and decides to move into Southfork. Strife continues to grow between Ann and Bobby when it is revealed she went to her ex for help with a family problem. Rebecca approaches Bobby and Christopher with information that she believes might help save the ranch.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E07 - Collateral Damage
1.plot: Rebecca reveals a life-changing secret to Elena. Still riling from his interaction with Bobby, Ann’s ex-husband demands an apology. Meanwhile, John Ross is under pressure from his allies and tries to turn one family member against another. And a family associate is murdered, leaving everyone to wonder about the culprit.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E08 - No Good Deed
1.plot: When murder hangs over the Ewing household, the family is forced to make decisions for the good of family. Christopher moves closer to his dream when a large oil company approaches him about rights to new methane technology. And the Ewings fight to protect Southfork from outsiders.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E09 - Family Business
1.plot: John Ross learns the value of family when he must choose between blood and oil. Sue Ellen and Rebecca both find themselves victims of men who could destroy their lives. And the Ewing’s must once again rally around one another when a medical crisis strikes.

1.title: FR - Dallas - S01E10 - Revelations
1.plot: In the dramatic season finale, family bonds bring the Ewing’s together as a loved one faces a medical crisis. Christopher and Elena begin to learn that not everyone is who they appear to be, including the people closest to them. Long buried secrets are revealed as the past rears its ugly head.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E01 - Battle Lines
2.plot: The battle for Ewing Energies heats up as Christopher and John Ross clash over opposing visions for the company. As Christopher seeks to gain the upper hand in his divorce from Rebecca Sutter, a game-changing revelation turns everything on its head, causing the entire family to put their differences aside and rally together -- except for John Ross, who uses J.R.'s dirty little tricks to take revenge on Christopher and Elena. Meanwhile, Ann is blackmailed by her ex-husband, Harris Ryland, forcing her and Bobby to confront a shocking secret from Ann's past.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E02 - Venomous Creatures
2.plot: With Christopher and Bobby at the helm of Ewing Energies, and Elena working to gain a stronger foothold within the company, J.R. and John Ross strike a deal to wrestle control of Ewing Energies away from them. Meanwhile, Pamela Rebecca Barnes schemes with John Ross to take half of Christopher's shares in Ewing Energies to fulfill her father's desire for revenge against the Ewings. And Ryland's mother, Judith, (guest star Judith Light) proves to be just as evil as her son.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E03 - Sins of the Father
2.plot: When new evidence mysteriously surfaces pointing to foul play in Tommy's disappearance, Christopher aims to connect Pamela to the crime. J.R. and John Ross maneuver on two fronts to reclaim their birthright, including poisoning one family member against another. Pamela continues to push her father's agenda to gain control of Ewing Energies. As a new member of the family arrives at Southfork, Ann is pushed to the brink by Ryland's sadistic games and finally takes action.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E04 - False Confessions
2.plot: With the future of Ewing Energies in jeopardy, Christopher does everything possible to keep a key deal alive. J.R. works to undermine Pamela, forcing John Ross to choose between a Ewing and a Barnes. Cliff Barnes (guest star Ken Kercheval) returns to meet with an unlikely visitor

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E05 - Trial and Error
2.plot: Ryland continues his onslaught of Ann, exposing secrets from her past that threaten to destroy her. Meanwhile, John Ross' plot to take over Ewing Energies solidifies; Christopher changes tactics with Pamela Barnes; and an enemy from the Ewings' past resurfaces.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E06 - Blame Game
2.plot: John Ross continues to persuade Sue Ellen to help him take control of Ewing Energies. Christopher and Pamela Rebecca work with their lawyers to settle their divorce. With Drew’s help, Christopher makes a startling revelation that could change the fate of Ewing Energies. And the whole family comes together when an outsider tries to undermine them all.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E07 - The Furious and the Fast
2.plot: "The Furious and the Fast" is the seventh episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. The episode marks the last appearance of J.R. Ewing.

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E08 - J.R.'s Masterpiece
2.plot: RIP J.R. (Larry Hagman)

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E09 - Ewings Unite
2.plot: "Ewings Unite!" is the ninth episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. The episode will continue the story arc started in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E10 - Guilt & Innocence
2.plot: "Guilt & Innocence" is the tenth episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. The episode will continue to expand on the story arc started in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

2.plot: "Let Me In" is the eleventh episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. The episode will continue to expand on the story arc started in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

2.plot: "A Call to Arms" is the twelfth episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. The episode will continue to expand on the story arc started in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E14 - Guilt by Association
2.plot: "Guilt by Association" is the fourteenth episode in the second season of the television series Dallas. It will air along with the final episode in the season, Legacies, functioning as a two-hour finale. It will bring a close continue to the story arc started in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

2.title: FR - Dallas - S02E15 - Legacies
2.plot: "Legacies" is the fifteenth episode and season finale in the second season of the television series Dallas. It will air along with the final episode in the season, Guilt by Association, functioning as a two-hour finale. It will finally answer the question that was uttered in The Furious and the Fast, Who Shot J.R.?

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E01 - The Return
3.plot: Sue Ellen is planning John Ross and Pamela's wedding. However the united Ewing front can't last for long as John Ross gets into a conflict with Bobby over the ownership of the ranch. He's also meets up for an illicit liaison with Emma. Whilst Christopher and Elena are still at odds as Elena returns to Dallas with a secret agenda.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E02 - Trust Me
3.plot: John Ross goes to great lengths to keep his plans for Ewing Global moving forward; Sue Ellen's alliance with her son is threatened; Emma enlists the help of her grandmother; Bobby and Ann investigate Ryland's release from jail.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E03 - Playing Chicken
3.plot: Bobby tries to outmaneuver John Ross; Christopher makes a discovery about Nicolas' past; Emma's games jeopardize John Ross and Pamela's wedding.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E04 - Lifting the Veil
3.plot: It's wedding day at Southfork and Afton, Ray and Lucy return for the occasion. The only one missing is the groom, John Ross, who's skipped out to strike a deal with a family adversary. Meanwhile, Christopher returns from Mexico to witness Nicolas and Elena's relationship deepening, and to his surprise finds a new burgeoning romantic connection. As Pamela wonders what's keeping John Ross from the nuptials, Sue Ellen fears it's Emma and contemplates stopping the wedding.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E05 - D.T.R.
3.plot: Bobby and Sue Ellen try to keep John Ross from becoming like his father; Christopher makes a discovery about Heather's past; Cliff persuades Elena to try a new tact; Judith, Ryland and Ann try to get Emma under control.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E06 - Like Father, Like Son
3.plot: John Ross scrambles to keep the Arctic lease deal alive; Elena and Nicolas get Pamela and John Ross out of the office; things get complicated for Christopher and Heather; Ryland's plot takes an unexpected turn.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E07 - Like a Bad Penny
3.plot: Bobby and Ann work to get Sue Ellen released; John Ross enlists the help of one of J.R.'s last business partners; secrets come to light; Elena makes a decision; Drew returns to Dallas.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E08 - Where There's Smoke
3.plot: Pamela discovers that John Ross has been sleeping with Emma; Christopher and Heather must deal with Bo's drastic action; Elena and Nicolas' relationship is tested.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E09 - Denial, Anger, Acceptance
3.plot: The mid-season premiere finds the Ewing family searching for answers as to who set the fire at Southfork Ranch and who will survive. While John Ross and Emma struggle with their role in Pamela's overdose, relationships among the family are forever changed.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E10 - Dead Reckoning
3.plot: The dark cloud over Southfork continues to grow with the news of a family death. Meanwhile, Christopher and Heather's relationship is put to the test as John Ross tries to redeem himself with Pamela, who begins to face the real reasons behind her overdose. Elsewhere, Elena makes a drastic move to get justice for her family, putting John Ross directly in her crosshairs.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E11 - Hurt
3.plot: In a thrilling showdown, Elena finally confronts the Ewings for what J.R. did to her father and for framing Cliff. Sue Ellen, Pamela and Ann are shocked over the truths Elena exposes, realigning relationships and forcing Bobby to re-examine the steps he took to implement J.R.'s master plan. Meanwhile, Nicolas' plan to steal Ewing Global for the Cartel moves forward, setting the stage for a new battle.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E12 - Victims of Love
3.plot: As Ewing Global goes public, twists and turns abound while everyone scrambles to claim ownership. Pamela struggles with what to do now that she knows Cliff didn't really kill J.R., and Bobby seeks the aide of an old flame Tracey McKay (guest star Melinda Clarke) to help get back control of the company. Meanwhile, Judith and Ryland work to fix their own problems with the cartel, which ends up putting lives in the balance and aligning the Rylands and Ewings in a way no one ever expected.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E13 - Boxed In
3.plot: In the wake of a devastating family kidnapping, Bobby puts everything on the line to save lives. John Ross and Pamela form a truce of sorts. Elena, who's been in hiding with Nicolas, finally learns the truth about his connections to the cartel, which sends her spiraling. Christopher desperately searches for Elena, fearing for her safety. And Bobby is forced to make a choice he never anticipated.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E14 - Endgame
3.plot: While Christopher races to find Elena, Bobby is double-crossed by the cartel. No longer able to sit by, John Ross puts his own life on the line to attempt a rescue. Meanwhile, Nicolas tries to prove himself to Elena by making a deal with the authorities that puts him on a collision course with John Ross' plan and places both their lives in jeopardy.

3.title: FR - Dallas - S03E15 - Brave New World
3.plot: In the electrifying third season finale, the Ewings and the Rylands finally force the cartel to pay the piper as some lives are saved and others are lost. Bobby and Sue Ellen form a new alliance to protect the family, which pits them against John Ross, who is still trying to regain control of Ewing Global and fix his marriage to Pamela. And Elena is pushed to the brink when she finds out the real depths of Nicolas' betrayal. As the season comes to an end, enemies are unmasked, new alliances are formed, and John Ross learns a shocking secret about J.R. that sends him halfway around the globe in search of a surprising new cohort.

meta.plot: Au ranch de Southfork, 20 ans plus tard, les Ewing se déchirent toujours sur fond de trahisons, secrets et autres drames. John Ross et Christopher, les fils respectifs de J.R. et Bobby, reprennent les affaires familiales, poursuivant par la même occasion les querelles de leurs pères...

1.title: FR - L'ombre d'un fils - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After their son is presumed dead in a Moroccan earthquake, a couple's world is turned upside down when they spot a boy in Dublin, leading them on a desperate search for the truth.

1.title: FR - L'ombre d'un fils - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Robin’s behaviour grows more mysterious when she begins to surreptitiously Google a woman called Eva Doyle.

1.title: FR - L'ombre d'un fils - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Forced to put their own troubles to one side, Robin and Harry look to a local policeman for help tracking down Ollie.

meta.plot: Lorsque Harry, le père de Dillon, revient à toute allure dans leur petit appartement pour sauver son enfant, l'appartement est en ruines et il n'y a aucun signe de son fils. Trois ans plus tard, à des milliers de kilomètres de là, à Dublin, Harry aperçoit un garçon de six ans dans la foule et est convaincu qu'il s'agit de Dillon. Désireux de retrouver son fils, l'obsession de Harry déchire son mariage avec Robin, révélant des secrets honteux qui mènent à la vérité sur ce qui est arrivé à leur fils la nuit où il a disparu.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E01 - The Rising
1.plot: Angus MacGyver and Jack Dalton, special agents for the Department of External Services (DXS), join forces to recover a missing bioweapon that has the ability to destroy hundreds of thousands of people with one single drop.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E02 - Metal Saw
1.plot: MacGyver and the team attempt to rescue Sarah, Jack’s former CIA partner/ex-girlfriend who went missing in Venezuela after she obtained evidence to take down an international arms dealer.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E03 - Awl
1.plot: MacGyver and the team are in Malaysia to extract a terrorist groups’ money man, Ralph, who holds key intel to an impending attack. But the mission goes south when the man is shot, and now, with only a driver’s license and hand sanitizer available, MacGyver must keep Ralph alive in order to learn the terrorists’ plans.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E04 - Wire Cutter
1.plot: Mac and Jack partner with older versions of themselves, a Russian bomb programmer and his estranged handler, to shut down a Soviet-era warhead in Moscow. But when the antiquated computer needed to disable the warhead becomes inoperable, Mac must find a way to fix it with only duct tape and wire in time to prevent a new Cold War.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E05 - Toothpick
1.plot: Using only an armrest, a curtain rod, and a toothpick, MacGyver must fix a sabotaged train in order to protect a whistleblower who has proof that her boss is selling weapons to U.S. enemies.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E06 - Wrench
1.plot: Using only a wrench and rope, MacGyver must diffuse a bomb set near the United Nations by his old nemesis, “The Ghost”, a notorious criminal whose work killed his mentor, and track him down before he strikes again.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E07 - Can Opener
1.plot: MacGyver is tasked to go undercover as an inmate in a maximum security prison to break out El Noche, a notorious drug kingpin, using only batteries and salt, and track him to his cartel's secret location and dismantle it.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E08 - Corkscrew
1.plot: When MacGyver comes face to face with Murdoc, an international assassin hired to kill him, Mac must defend both himself and Bozer, armed with only a corkscrew and paper towel rolls. Also, Bozer feels completely betrayed when he finally learns Mac's true identity.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E09 - Chisel
1.plot: With only a chisel and matchbook, MacGyver and team must defend themselves the U.S. embassy workers in Latvia from extremists who are attempting to retrieve their leader. Also, Bozer faces a big decision now that he knows who Mac really is.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E10 - Pliers
1.plot: Mac and the team have no time to reminisce while visiting Mac’s and Bozer’s hometown when they immediately start searching for a kidnapped prodigy from Mac’s old middle school, Valerie.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E11 - Scissors
1.plot: MacGyver and Jack search for Riley, using a microwave and a power strip, after she mysteriously disappears and hacks into the NSA, possibly unleashing World War III. Also, Bozer goes on his first official mission, and Jack opens up about his history with Riley’s mother, Diane.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E12 - Screwdriver
1.plot: Using a screwdriver and bug spray, MacGyver must find the U.S. government mole who is leaking classified intel to the organization that is trying to take down The Phoenix Foundation. Also, Sarah returns to help with the mission, and Nikki reappears, but Mac can’t tell which side she’s on.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E13 - Large Blade
1.plot: On the way back from capturing a war criminal, Mac and Jack’s helicopter crashes in a remote area of Kazakhstan, injuring their pilot and allowing their prisoner to escape with Jack’s gun. Using a large blade and a water bottle, MacGyver must get help as the pilot’s condition worsens and before the war criminal takes them as prisoners.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E14 - Fish Scaler
1.plot: Using a fish scaler and some fishing wire, Mac and Jack must track down a corrupt FBI agent who has framed a man for murder. Also, everyone on the team is terrified to get their first performance review from Matty, their tough new boss.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E15 - Magnifying Glass
1.plot: When Matty’s goddaughter and her boyfriend are killed in a San Francisco park, Mac and the team investigate the crime and start to suspect that the 1970s Zodiac Killer has returned.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E16 - Hook
1.plot: While tracking down the dangerous fugitive Aaron Deckard, Mac and Jack face the notorious Colton family of bounty hunters who already kidnapped their mark. Also, Bozer and Riley try to hack into Jack’s CIA file to find out about his history with Matty.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E17 - Ruler
1.plot: Bozer’s first overseas mission goes terribly wrong when Mac and the team are blamed for a terrorist bombing and the Phoenix Foundation is forced to disavow them.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E18 - Flashlight
1.plot: When Mac and the team travel to Hawaii to aid in earthquake relief efforts, they team up with Chin and Kono from the Five-0 task force to rescue a group of government scientists trapped in a building. However, as they work on the complicated rescue, a group using the chaos as a distraction aims to steal the top-secret weaponry from the scientists.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E19 - Compass
1.plot: Mac and Jack help Mac’s close friend from M.I.T. after she fakes her own death to prevent someone from killing her in order to suppress her scientific research.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E20 - Hole Puncher
1.plot: When the team intercepts a terror group’s message meant for Murdoc, Mac poses as the psychopath to save the intended target and find out why they want Murdoc to assassinate him.

1.title: FR - MacGyver - S01E21 - Cigar Cutter
1.plot: Murdoc moves forward with his plans for revenge against MacGyver by recruiting his recently released former cellmate to infiltrate the Phoenix Complex as a “lab technician” and kill every agent inside.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E01 - DIY or DIE
2.plot: Using a cell phone and soccer ball, MacGyver and the team search for a Navy SEAL who is believed to be alive in captivity in the Middle East.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E02 - Muscle Car + Paper Clips
2.plot: Using a necklace and a microwave transmitter, Mac and the team attempt to locate Riley after her first solo mission with a group of dangerous hackers goes off the rails

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E03 - Roulette Wheel + Wire
2.plot: Using cuff links and wire, MacGyver and the team go undercover in a high stakes casino to steal diamonds from a vault before a terrorist group gets there first and trades the jewels for a weapon of mass destruction.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E04 - X-Ray + Penny
2.plot: When Murdoc drugs and kidnaps MacGyver, Mac uses a needle and his teeth to escape and join the team to save Murdoc’s next victim.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E05 - Skull + Electromagnet
2.plot: The team is pulled away from their Halloween plans when they head into the dreaded Bermuda Triangle to retrieve the Vice President’s son after his plane goes down with a mysterious prisoner on board.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E06 - Jet Engine + Pickup Truck
2.plot: Using a cassette player and a plastic bucket, Mac and the team attempt to extinguish a massive oil wellhead fire in a Nigerian village, set by a rebel group, which is trying to topple its government by destroying their most valuable resource.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E07 - Duct Tape + Jack
2.plot: MacGyver uses a heater and hot sauce to help a key presidential candidate in Ecuador receive a heart transplant he desperately needs after a rebel group tries to sabotage delivery of the organ.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E08 - Packing Peanuts + Fire
2.plot: When MacGyver and Jack "steal" a priceless painting, using a table cloth and a shoe lace, in order to draw an infamous stolen art dealer out of hiding, they wind up getting conned out of the painting by the dealer's team. Also, Riley's estranged father, Elwood, asks to be part of her life, and Matty sends Bozer to a spy training camp.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E09 - CD-ROM + Hoagie Foil
2.plot: Mac and the team follow a group of Indonesian mercenaries who are transporting a lethal amount of stolen nerve gas in the hopes of tracking them to their dangerous leader. Also, Jack confronts Elwood about Riley, and Bozer is pushed to his limit in spy school.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E10 - War Room + Ship
2.plot: When 32 college students are stranded on a research ship in the Arctic Ocean with no heat and erupting fires, Mac develops an emotional connection to the group leader, via video chat, as he relays how to stay alive as they await a rescue ship. Also, Jack kidnaps Elwood to find out what scam he’s up to next, and Bozer’s feelings toward Leanna grow stronger.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E11 - Bullet + Pen
2.plot: The LAPD interrupts the team’s Christmas celebration to arrest Mac for terrorism when they find a body in a building destroyed by a bomb Mac built.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E12 - Mac + Jack
2.plot: When Mac and Jack are trapped inside Mac's house, which his nemesis, The Ghost, has rigged with explosives, Mac uses a karaoke mic and an audio transformer to let the team know that this bomb is a distraction for a bigger one. Also, through flashbacks, Mac and Jack's contentious first meeting unfolds.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E13 - CO2 Sensor + Tree Branch
2.plot: While Mac participates in a challenge for government operatives to create robotic combat machines, he must help his biggest competitor, Allie, when her vehicle is hacked and heads to the Pentagon. Also, Jack attends his high school reunion, hoping for a showdown with his old rival who beat him out for homecoming king.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E14 - Mardi Gras Beads + Chair
2.plot: When the team heads to New Orleans to track down the con artist who is posing as the wife of “Duke Jacoby,” one of Jack’s old CIA aliases, Jack finds himself in jeopardy when “Duke’s” old enemies resurface looking for revenge.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E15 - Murdoc + Handcuffs
2.plot: After one of Murdoc's go-to assassins agrees to hand over Murdoc to MacGyver in exchange for $10 million, the team finds itself protecting Murdoc from his former mentor, Nicholas Helman, who wants him dead. Also, Jack realizes he may still have feelings for Riley's mother, Diane.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E16 - Hammock + Balcony
2.plot: MacGyver, Leanna, Riley and Bozer pose as honeymoon couples at a resort in order to gain information about a Serbian war criminal from his newly married son. Also, Bozer wonders if Matty knows about his relationship with Leanna, and Jack recruits Elwood to help him break into Matty’s home.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E17 - Bear Trap + Mob Boss
2.plot: Mac, Jack and Riley set out to find a mobster-turned-informant after he’s kidnapped and taken to Chernobyl by an international crime boss who’s worried he will deliver incriminating information to the CIA. Also, Bozer struggles to keep a secret from Matty.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E18 - Riley + Airplane
2.plot: When Matty and the team search for a former government tech who stole classified intel and has been evading capture, they reunite with the Coltons, the family of bounty hunters, who are pursuing the same man for different reasons.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E19 - Benjamin Franklin + Grey Duffle
2.plot: As Mac and the team investigate the suspicious death of Dawn's CIA supervisor, the evidence leads to a dirty CIA agent and a massive counterfeiting ring.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E20 - Skyscraper - Power
2.plot: Mac and Jack attempt to rescue a billionaire’s son after he is kidnapped by a former Navy SEAL who uses an EMP weapon to cut off power and communication lines to the Shanghai skyscraper where the boy lives.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E21 - Wind + Water
2.plot: While MacGyver is in Puerto Rico helping his friend rebuild his hurricane-damaged home, he is taken hostage in the bank his friend manages when robbers attempt to steal $2 million.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E22 - UFO + Area 51
2.plot: Mac and Riley are attacked by a group of masked men after the government calls them in to examine a mysterious object that crash-landed in the Nevada desert. Also, Riley uncovers new information about Mac’s father but questions whether to deliver it to him after he says he needs to move on.

2.title: FR - MacGyver - S02E23 - MacGyver + MacGyver
2.plot: MacGyver gets a shocking surprise when he tries to tell Matty that he’s quitting the Phoenix Foundation.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E01 - Improvise
3.plot: Three months after quitting the Phoenix Foundation and moving to Nigeria, Mac puts aside his differences with his father and returns when he hears Jack is the target of a murderous dictator he double-crossed.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E02 - Bravo Lead + Loyalty + Friendship
3.plot: When Jack receives an emergency distress signal from one of his old Delta buddies who is falsely accused of terrorism in a foreign country, MacGyver and Jack quickly recruit the rest of Jack’s old Delta team and stage an unsanctioned rescue op.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E03 - Bozer + Booze + Back to School
3.plot: MacGyver, Riley, Bozer and Leanna go undercover on a college campus to smoke out a deep-cover operative who is recruiting students to carry out deadly attacks around the world. Also, Jack joins bounty hunter Billy Colton in the hunt for a bail jumper but is concerned when he finds out Billy offered Riley a job.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E04 - Guts + Fuel + Hope
3.plot: MacGyver and Riley, with the help of Vasil, a distraught father, must find a way to drive a tanker filled with liquid oxygen through a region occupied by rebels and deliver it to a children’s hospital before they run out. Also, Riley helps MacGyver decide whether or not to allow his father back into his life.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E05 - Dia de Muertos + Sicarios + Family
3.plot: When Oversight’s attempt to capture a drug cartel’s leader goes bad, MacGyver and Jack rush to Mexico to pull their boss out while racing through the heart of the country during Dia de Muertos celebrations. Also, Bozer and Riley use Halloween as a distraction to gather intel on a man accused of treason.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E06 - Murdoc + MacGyver + Murdoc
3.plot: Murdoc abducts MacGyver’s girlfriend, Nasha, to force Mac to help him rescue his son, Cassian, from a kidnapper. Also, a dangerous individual from Murdoc’s personal life shows up, giving Mac a glimpse into the villain’s past.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E07 - Scavengers + Hard Drive + Dragonfly
3.plot: Matty sends MacGyver and team to Ghana to recover a hard drive from an e-waste landfill that is run by a powerful and violent man. But when Matty refuses to reveal what’s on the drive, other than a mysterious file called “Dragonfly,” the team speculates about what could be so important to her.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E08 - Revenge + Catacombs + Le Fantome
3.plot: MacGyver and the team set off on a dangerous capture operation after an Irish military intelligence officer approaches them claiming to know the whereabouts of “The Ghost,” a lethal bomb maker whom Mac has been hunting for years.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E09 - Specimen 234 + PAPR + Outbreak
3.plot: When a vial containing a deadly virus is stolen from the Center for Disease Control in Atlanta, MacGvyer and team race to recover it before the thief unleashes a global pandemic.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E10 - Matty + Ethan + Fidelity
3.plot: Matty reveals a shocking secret to the team: she has a husband who’s been undercover in a criminal organization called S-Company for eight years. When his status as a CIA agent comes out, Matty needs MacGyver to find and extract her husband before it’s too late.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E11 - Mac + Fallout + Jack
3.plot: Mac and Jack hit the road for a weekend of relaxation in Las Vegas, but their mini-vacation is cut short when someone from their past abducts them and locks them in a concrete room. Also, Matty tasks Riley, Bozer and Leanna with stealing a diamond encoded with terrorist intel from a princess in Milan.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E12 - Fence + Suitcase + Americium-241
3.plot: The Phoenix teams up with a woman who’s a soccer mom by day but a master thief by night to catch one of her contacts, an underworld criminal, who has hired her to steal a dirty bomb.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E13 - Wilderness + Training + Survival
3.plot: When MacGyver takes Riley and Bozer into the wilderness for a weekend of survival training, things take a turn when they run into a violent group of criminals who are searching the rugged backcountry for a lost crate of money. Also, Jack and Matty go on a road trip to place Matty’s ex-husband and his family in witness protection.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E14 - Father + Bride + Betrayal
3.plot: An international crime boss offers Matty a deal she can’t refuse – he’ll surrender himself into her custody if he’s allowed to return to the United States to watch his daughter walk down the aisle. MacGyver and team crash the wedding to ensure the crime lord doesn’t run, only to discover they’re not the only ones lying in wait at the event.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E15 - K9 + Smugglers + New Recruit
3.plot: After a surprising introduction to Phoenix’s newest recruit, Desi, MacGyver and team are assigned to escort and protect an ATF (alcohol, tobacco, firearms) gun-sniffing dog who has a bounty on his head, only to discover they’re not the only ones crashing the weapon drop.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E16 - Lidar + Rogues + Duty
3.plot: The Phoenix must recover the body of a pilot whose plane crashed while testing an experimental laser mapping system that MacGyver designed. Also, Riley tries to identify the hacker who tricked a SWAT team into arresting her and Elwood.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E17 - Seeds + Permafrost + Feather
3.plot: MacGyver and team are asked to solve a locked-door mystery when a man working inside a remote, ultra-secure international seed vault disappears.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E18 - Murdoc + Helman + Hit
3.plot: When Nicholas Helman resurfaces to carry out a killing spree, the Phoenix is forced to get help from the one person who knows him best… his protégé, Murdoc.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E19 - Friends + Enemies + Border
3.plot: MacGyver and Desi help a group of Syrian refugees who are being pursued by human traffickers. Also, in Los Angeles, Bozer is trapped in Oversight’s car which is rigged to explode.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E20 - No-Go + High-Voltage + Rescue
3.plot: When two American tourists go missing while doing a “No-Go Scavenger Hunt” through some of the world’s most dangerous countries, the Phoenix team goes undercover as backpackers to find them and bring them home alive.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E21 - Treason + Heartbreak + Gum
3.plot: Matty’s ex-husband, Ethan, asks her for help when a criminal organization, S-Company, kidnaps his wife and daughter, forcing Matty to decide if she’s willing to commit treason in order to help him save his family. Also, Riley joins Billy Colton and Mama Colton on a mission to Paris and makes a heartbreaking discovery.

3.title: FR - MacGyver - S03E22 - Mason + Cable + Choices
3.plot: MacGyver faces off with a cunning new adversary whose carefully crafted plans put Mac at the epicenter of an impossible choice: save the life of a friend, or save the lives of hundreds of innocents. Also, Mac receives new information that will drive a wedge between him and his father.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E01 - Fire + Ashes + Legacy = Phoenix
4.plot: Ex-MI6 agent Russ Taylor recruits former Phoenix Foundation members Mac, Riley, Bozer, Matty and Desi to hunt down a bioweapon that’s planned to be used by a mysterious organization for a devastating attack on a major U.S. city.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E02 - Red Cell + Quantum + Cold + Committed
4.plot: Department of Defense General John Acosta recruits MacGyver to steal a highly classified project from a military lab in order to find flaws in its security. But when it’s discovered that the general is planning an attack using the weapon, Phoenix must stop Acosta before the weapon is uploaded.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E03 - Kid + Plane + Cable + Truck
4.plot: MacGyver and the team board a plane that’s mid-flight when the pilot has a heart attack, and discover the medical emergency was intentional.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E04 - Windmill + Acetone + Celluloid + Firing Pin
4.plot: As MacGyver works quickly to rescue survivors from a collapsed building in Germany, he discovers a new safety threat – a 1,000-pound undetonated bomb from World War II hidden beneath the rubble.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E05 - Soccer + Desi + Merchant + Titan
4.plot: In an attempt to find the main players in the Codex and cut off their match-fixing funding, Desi goes undercover to infiltrate a soccer team and find the corrupt player working with the shadow organization.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E06 - Right + Wrong + Both + Neither
4.plot: When Russ’ first love, Emilia, is kidnapped by the same rebels he fought during his private military contract days, he takes the Phoenix team to a small, impoverished town to rescue her and rid the town of the rebels for good.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E07 - Mac + Desi + Riley + Aubrey
4.plot: A double date descends into chaos when Mac and Desi witness a murder in the back of the restaurant, and as they work to find the killer, Riley tries to keep the secret about her and her friends’ “day jobs” from her new boyfriend, Aubrey.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E08 - Father + Son + Father + Matriarch
4.plot: After Oversight is almost killed in a bombing, he recruits Mac to help him find the suspected bomber, Mason. However, when Mason reveals he didn’t plant the bomb, the three team up to track down Codex, the shadow organization that set them up. Also, Mac meets his aunt Gwendolyn.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E09 - Code + Artemis + Nuclear + N3mesis
4.plot: While Mac’s friends surround him during his time of grief, Los Angeles’ power grid is taken hostage in a ransomware attack resulting in a citywide blackout, and the team discovers the code used was written by Riley years ago

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E10 - Tesla + Bell + Edison + Mac
4.plot: When Mac is put into a dream state to help him recall key evidence found in Nikola Tesla’s secret lab that could stop Codex’s deadly plot, he encounters Nikola Tesla, Alexander Graham Bell, Thomas Edison…and his mother.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E11 - Psy-Op + Cell + Merchant + Birds
4.plot: Mac is placed inside a fake prison cell with a top Codex operative, The Merchant, in order to gain his trust and get intel on their next move.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E12 - Loyalty + Family + Rogue + Hellfire
4.plot: The Phoenix team is forever altered when MacGyver’s Aunt Gwen gets into his head about family and connection and convinces Mac and Riley to join Codex. Also, Matty and Russ take their concerns about Codex to the White House.

4.title: FR - MacGyver - S04E13 - Save + The + Dam + World
4.plot: With Mac and Riley undercover with Codex, hoping to stop the organization from within, their mission is interrupted when Russ, Desi and the Phoenix team move to prevent Codex from detonating a weapon of mass destruction, with Mac and Riley caught in the crosshairs. Also, the team discovers Russ’ real reason for purchasing the Phoenix Foundation.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E01 - Resort + Desi + Riley + Window Cleaner + Witness
5.plot: Mac and the team infiltrate a glamorous hotel used as an international hideout for criminals to find a woman with vital information on Codex. However, their target has a new secret identity, including a completely new face.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E02 - Thief + Painting + Auction + Viro-486 + Justice
5.plot: When Taylor’s former protégé is killed while preventing a bio-weapon from falling into the wrong hands, Mac and the team must find the weapon so Desi can pull off the ultimate heist before it’s sold to a terrorist cell.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E03 - Eclipse + USMC-1856707 + Step Potential + Chain Lock + Ma
5.plot: When Russ is kidnapped, Mac and the team must break out a previously murderous psychopath, now pacifist, from prison to help find him. Also, while on the run, Mac and Desi are forced to confront their relationship issues.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E04 - Banh Bao + Sterno + Drill + Burner + Mason
5.plot: Mac's meeting with Desi's parents goes sideways when her brother finds himself in trouble and desperately needs their help. Also, Russ and Matty must ask an old nemesis for assistance when their new recruitment candidate is kidnapped.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E05 - Jack + Kinematics + Safe Cracker + MgKNO3 + GTO
5.plot: Using a cryptic postcard as their only clue, Mac and the team must solve a fallen friend’s final case and bring him justice.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E06 - Quarantine + N95 + Landline + Telescope + Social Distance
5.plot: During COVID-19’s first stay-at-home order, as Mac, Bozer and Riley quarantine together, they try to stop a crime in progress at their neighbor’s house. Also, Russ’ romantic fling takes on a longer and more complicated turn when they quarantine together.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E07 - Golden Lancehead + Venom + Pole Vault + Blood + Baggage
5.plot: The secret experimental cancer treatment Mac’s developing with a friend is discovered when culprits ransack their lab, kidnap Mac’s partner and plan to use the research to create a powerful new nerve agent.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E08 - SOS + Hazmat + Ultrasound + Frequency + Malihini
5.plot: Mac and team rush to help when Matty’s former mentor, Ian Cain, and his embassy staff come down with a deadly, mysterious illness. Taylor and Bozer work with Jerry Ortega to infiltrate a Codex cell.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E09 - Rails + Pitons + Pulley + Pipe + Salt
5.plot: When Mac and the team are unable to prevent Department of Defense intel from falling into Codex’s hands, Mac must scale a vertical cliff using only gear he can cobble together himself to prevent the info’s transmission.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E10 - Diamond + Quake + Carbon + Comms + Tower
5.plot: While on a mission to hunt down a Codex lead, Mac and the team discover Murdoc hacked their comms and has recorded them for months. Now, Mac and the team must stop Murdoc, who is working with Andrews, as they plot to kill thousands and reveal each Phoenix member’s most-guarded secrets.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E11 - C8H7ClO + Nano-Trackers + Resistance + Maldives + Mind Games
5.plot: Mac and Riley head overseas together to prevent a governmental collapse and inadvertently inhale new deadly microscopic technology.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E12 - Royalty + Marriage + Vivaah Sanskar + Zinc + Henna
5.plot: Mac, Desi and Russ go undercover during a royal Indian wedding to protect a princess whose policies could put her life in danger. Also, Russ and Sophia come face-to-face at the wedding, Bozer suspects Riley is up to her old hacking ways and Matty runs down a lead in hopes of getting to the bottom of Mac and Riley’s ingested nano-trackers,

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E13 - Barn Find + Engine Oil + La Punzonatura + Lab Rats + Tachometer
5.plot: While Mac and the team delve into the world of Italian car culture in order to track down a crime boss-in-hiding, Mac must lean on Desi when he discovers that he losing the ability to control his hands. Also, Mac and Desi move in together and Riley reveals the truth about her secret team of hackers to Russ.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E14 - H2O + Orthophosphates + Mission City + Corrosion + Origins
5.plot: Mac and Desi travel with Bozer to his childhood home when his aunt dies in a tragic accident, however, they soon discover she may have been murdered for trying to expose the city’s contaminated water supply. Also, Riley, Matty and Russ continue to follow leads on their nano-trackers investigation.

5.title: FR - MacGyver - S05E15 - Abduction + Memory + Time + Fireworks + Dispersal
5.plot: When Mac and Riley go missing and wake up 24 hours later in a corn field with no memory of how they got there, they must unravel the mystery to find who took them, and how to get rid of the nanotrackers in their bodies, no matter the cost.

meta.plot: Agé d'une vingtaine d'années, MacGyver, qui possède un don unique pour la débrouille et des méthodes peu orthodoxes pour parvenir à ses fins, travaille pour le gouvernement au sein d'une organisation secrète dont le but est de sauver des vies.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E01 - The Fuller Dogfight
1.plot: Ohio State astrophysicist Dr. Allen Hynek is recruited by the Air Force into their top-secret program investigating UFOs called Project Blue Book. Partnered with Captain Michael Quinn, they investigate the case of a military pilot who survived a dogfight with an alien craft. Based on the "Gorman Dogfight" case.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E02 - The Flatwoods Monster
1.plot: Dr. Hynek and Captain Quinn investigate a West Virginia case of a woman and her two children who witnessed a flying saucer crash near their farm and an alien being emerge from the fiery wreck; based on the Flatwoods Monster case.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E03 - The Lubbock Lights
1.plot: When the citizens of Lubbock, Texas witness a mysterious V-shaped craft in the night sky, Hynek and Quinn are brought in to investigate the mass sighting. Based on the “Lubbock Lights” case.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E04 - Operation Paperclip
1.plot: Quinn and Hynek are lead into a secret program involving the Operation Paperclip.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E05 - Foo Fighters
1.plot: Quinn and Hynek follow clues that lead them to a secret group who have witnessed strange lights.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E06 - The Green Fireballs
1.plot: Mysterious green fireballs nearly cause a nuclear disaster during a weapons test, and Hynek and Quinn must investigate how it could have occurred.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E07 - The Scoutmaster
1.plot: After a Scoutmaster vanishes when he and his troop witness a strange craft hovering in the woods, Hynek is sent to investigate for Project Blue Book, while Quinn is pulled into a rogue mission for General Harding.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E08 - War Games
1.plot: When a film emerges documenting an Army platoon under UFO attack, the Generals send Hynek and Quinn in to investigate, where they find the soldiers not only suffer from physical effects of war, but psychological ones as well.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E09 - Abduction
1.plot: Hynek is drawn into a case from which he literally can't escape when a man arrives at Blue Book headquarters with his wife. The man claims he was abducted by aliens, and he plans to hold Hynek and Quinn hostage until he learns the truth.

1.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S01E10 - The Washington Merry-Go Round
1.plot: Washington D.C. is invaded by UFOs, and Hynek and Quinn must uncover the true nature of the threat before it's too late.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E01 - The Roswell Incident (1)
2.plot: Hynek and Quinn follow General Harding to Roswell, New Mexico, where an anonymous townsperson has threatened to expose evidence to the world of an extraterrestrial crash-landing six years ago.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E02 - The Roswell Incident (2)
2.plot: Hynek and Quinn nearly reach a potential culprit, which could take them to just where they need to be to discover the truth behind the famous Roswell incident.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E03 - Area 51
2.plot: Hynek and Quinn investigate reports of a soldier who was allegedly taken inside a flying saucer at a remote military base in Nevada, where they subsequently learn about the several reasons why the secrets contained in Area 51 should not be released.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E04 - Hopkinsville
2.plot: A supposed alien invades a rural home in Kentucky, which prompts the CIA to give Hynek and Quinn access to their top-secret program known as MK Ultra, which asserts that the alien attack has the potential to be the beginning of a larger plan.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E05 - The Men in Black
2.plot: The mysterious Man in Black kidnaps Hynek, which sends Quinn on a mission with the CIA to follow him and rescue Hynek.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E06 - Close Encounters
2.plot: While reminiscing on the set of `Close Encounters of the Third Kind', Hynek recounts his experiences with the infamous Robertson Panel and the eccentric alien contactee for whom he put everything on the line.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E07 - Curse of the Skinwalker
2.plot: Hynek and Quinn head to a Utah ranch to investigate a young family’s claims of unexplainable and dangerous phenomena.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E08 - What Lies Beneath
2.plot: When sensitive material is stolen from Generals Harding and Valentine, Hynek and Quinn realize that their culprit is far closer to home than they could imagine, but so is undeniable evidence of a UFO conspiracy.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E09 - Broken Arrow
2.plot: When Hynek and Quinn track down a mysterious plane that has vanished in the Canadian wilderness, they must embark on a dangerous mission to recover its missing cargo.

2.title: FR - Projet Blue Book - S02E10 - Operation Mainbrace
2.plot: Strange interlopers in the sky and sea, and the actions of a rogue admiral, threaten to turn a naval exercise into World War III. It's up to Hynek and Quinn to stop the rogue admiral.

meta.plot: Un brillant scientifique, le professeur J. Allen Hynek, est recruté par l'armée de l'air américaine pour mener des enquêtes non résolues, de simples faits divers à des théories plus farfelues, comme l'existence d'extraterrestres.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: After meeting the twins' parents, Lisa is shocked to discover that her connection to the family might be more than just professional.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: With the Meredith family reeling from Dylan’s death and Sean’s arrest, Lisa is charged with finding his alibi and makes a game-changing discovery. Abbie grows closer to newcomer Vincent, whilst Rob agrees to take on a risky dare.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: When the main suspect goes missing, Lisa is concerned about Sean’s possible involvement.  Abbie falls deeper into Vincent’s world, bringing Sam with her.  Meanwhile, Sean’s vigilante justice leads him down a dangerous path.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: With Nick seriously injured in hospital, Lisa furiously seeks out Sean, while Med feels increasingly side-lined. Meanwhile, Rob attempts to leave the online forum, but finds that it is not as easy as he had hoped, and Sam tries to offer Abbie a way out from Vincent.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: A confession to Lisa shines a possible new light on Dylan's killer. Meanwhile, Abbie has a terrifying experience with some local addicts, and Rob's escalating actions begin to impact on his family. Elsewhere, Med starts to suspect Lisa is hiding something from him and begins to make his own investigations.

1.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Despite Holly's confession that she killed her brother, the team are convinced there's more to the story than she's telling them.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: DC Lisa Armstrong is asked to assist a murder investigation in Morecambe. The team try to uncover why the victim was targeted, but meanwhile, Lisa and her family are unknowingly stalked by a mysterious figure who has an agenda.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Determined to ignore Andy's unexpected arrival the night before, Lisa throws herself into the case and discovers a significant lead from her only eyewitness. The new information opens up the investigation and the team uncover vital evidence.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: As the team press on with the investigation, Lisa and Med dig deeper into the family.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Following an unexpected turn in the case, Lisa and the team accept help from a new unit.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: Lisa pursues a new line of investigation, uncovering a far-reaching secret.

2.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: As a confession brings the team closer to the truth, Lisa identifies a suspect.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: DS Jenn Townsend, Morecambe's new Family Liaison Officer, is immediately thrown into the deep end when a body washes up in the bay on her first day on the job.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: An uncooperative suspect causes difficulties for the team, and a frustrating turn in the case causes tensions to rise within the community, leading to an unexpected altercation.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: Several major developments in the case point the team towards suspects in surprising places. Meanwhile, Erin offers an olive branch to Conor.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: It's the day of Saif's funeral, and as Jenn watches closely for any suspicious behaviour, divisions within the Rahman household widen.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: Shazia's explosive revelation threatens to destroy the Rahman family. The police investigation grinds to a halt until a vital clue offers a glimmer of hope.

3.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Jenn remains determined to find out the truth about Saif's murder. With one suspect arrested, the race is on to find the missing pieces of the puzzle before the killer escapes.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E01 - Episode 1
4.plot: Jenn is working late when an emergency is called in - she races to the scene to find horror unfolding for a broken family... and must now uncover the truth behind it.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E02 - Episode 2
4.plot: The Morecambe community rallies around the grieving Metcalf family, but Jenn and the MIU team find key evidence that all was not well in their home.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E03 - Episode 3
4.plot: The Metcalf kids struggle with their loss while CCTV evidence leads to a development in the case, and an unexpected arrival causes tensions in the victim's family to resurface.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E04 - Episode 4
4.plot: Under pressure to solve the murder, Jenn fails to see the troubles her own family is facing. New evidence comes to light from an unexpected source that could completely change the course of the case.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E05 - Episode 5
4.plot: An old case puts the MIU under further pressure. Jenn must track down a key suspect before it's too late but when trouble follows her home, it leaves her whole family in danger.

4.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S04E06 - Episode 6
4.plot: A prominent Morecambe family arouses suspicion through their aggressive business dealings, while in the MIU, a chance meeting for Jenn leads the team closer to the truth.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E01 - Episode 1
5.plot: DS Jenn Townsend returns to the Morecambe MIU after her father's death but when a new case challenges the team she has to put her own grief aside.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E02 - Episode 2
5.plot: The victim's boyfriend is found and Jenn struggles when the family she's helping starts to point the finger of suspicion at each other.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E03 - Episode 3
5.plot: New information leads to a major development in the case, but the Morecambe community are looking for reassurance, intensifying the pressure on the MIU.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E04 - Episode 4
5.plot: A vital clue leads the MIU to take a closer look at a member of the victim's family but when red tape stops the team, frustrations reach an all-time high.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E05 - Episode 5
5.plot: A new SIO is called in to lead the MIU while Jenn's family feel the full force of the grief she's been trying so hard to contain.

5.title: FR - Enquête à Morecambe - S05E06 - Episode 6
5.plot: The team discovers someone has been withholding information and as they set to piece together the truth Jenn's left contemplating her future in the MIU.

meta.plot: Assignée au service des personnes disparues à Morecambe Bay, Lisa Armstrong doit apporter son soutien aux familles au pire moment de leurs vies. Entraînée à ne jamais s'impliquer émotionnellement, il lui faut rester attentive au moindre indice susceptible d'aider à faire avancer l'enquête. Sa situation est cependant compromise quand elle découvre qu’elle a un lien de parenté avec deux jumeaux disparus...

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E01 - Dogs
1.plot: Imagine a future where AI fully translates animal language and behavior for pet lovers — and picture how it will transform life with our fur babies.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E02 - Dating
1.plot: Swipe left, right — or forward? In the future, finding the perfect match could rely on AI, biometric data and wearables that gauge compatibility.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E03 - Houseplants
1.plot: From pollution monitoring to data storage — biologists and botanists explore the potential of plant modification and its effect on our everyday lives.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E04 - Gaming
1.plot: Specialists discuss the next level of augmented reality, its potential to transform mundane places and the downsides of immersive experiences.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E05 - Space Vacations
1.plot: Business leaders and astronauts delve into the practical challenges of making space travel less time-consuming and more accessible.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E06 - Cheeseburgers
1.plot: Driven by ethical and environmental concerns, food tech startups are using smart engineering to reimagine a comfort food classic: the cheeseburger.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E07 - Life After Death
1.plot: Holograms, voice cloning, human composting: Experts examine end-of-life services and the physical, digital and spiritual remains we leave behind.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E08 - Sports
1.plot: Athletes and engineers examine new developments in artificial intelligence and robotics that can make career-ending injuries a thing of the past.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E09 - Fashion
1.plot: Disposable fashion comes into focus for designers and researchers, who also delve into compostable garb merging personalization with sustainability.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E10 - Skyscrapers
1.plot: From vertical cities to sustainable skyscrapers — inventors and designers envision a future of ambitious architecture that could reimagine our cities.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E11 - Health
1.plot: Experts break down 3D-printed super organs, genetic upgrades and other medical breakthroughs that will revolutionize health care as we know it.

1.title: FR - The Future Of - S01E12 - Headphones
1.plot: Musicians, neuroscientists and futurologists talk about the power of sound and emerging tech that can interpret brain activity in real time.

meta.plot: Avec l'aide d'experts, cette série documentaire innovante explore les tendances technologiques nouvelles et émergentes pour imaginer des possibilités révolutionnaires.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E01 - SEIYA
1.plot: After exhibiting special powers, Seiya is approached by the enigmatic Alman Kido, who urges him to fulfill his destiny and become a Bronze Knight.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E02 - Burn Your Cosmo
1.plot: Seiya obtains the Pegasus Armor with ease, but to be a true Knight of Athena, he must first prove himself in the Galaxian Wars tournament.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E03 - Enter the Dragon
1.plot: Believing in the dark prophecy, Magnus confronts Lady Sienna. Seiya faces his toughest opponent yet: Dragon Long.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E04 - Nebula Chain
1.plot: Reluctant to fight, Andromeda Shaun takes a defensive approach against Unicorn Jab using her Nebula Chain. Meanwhile, Vander's army attacks.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E05 - The Black Knights
1.plot: Seiya takes down a helicopter to retrieve the stolen Gold Armor from Phoenix Nero, only to be confronted by Vander's Black Knights.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E06 - Phoenix Rising
1.plot: Phoenix Nero has built up his overwhelming power with hate. To stop him, the Bronze Knights must combine their strength to reclaim the Gold Armor.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E07 - The Silver Knights
FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E08 - The Rising Tide
FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E09 - To Fight for Athena
FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E10 - The Challenge
FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E11 - The Prophecy
1.plot: Graad assembles his own Black Knights to protect mankind from the gods. When his forces abduct Sienna, the Bronze Knights set out to rescue her.

1.title: FR - Les Chevaliers du Zodiaque - Saint Seiya - S01E12 - One War Ends, Another Begins
1.plot: The Bronze Knights face Graad's upgraded Black Knights. Though Seiya and the others gain the upper hand, Graad proves to be a formidable foe.

meta.plot: Seiya et les Chevaliers du Zodiaque s'unissent à nouveau pour protéger la déesse Athéna, mais une sombre prophétie pèse sur leurs destins.

1.title: FR - The King Who Never Was - S01E01 - A Shot in the Dark
1.plot: In the summer of 1978, a one-day trip to a Mediterranean island takes a tragic turn when visitors get into an argument with Vittorio Emanuele of Savoy.

1.title: FR - The King Who Never Was - S01E02 - Chain Reaction
1.plot: After her brother's death, Birgit seeks for justice. When every attempt seems vain, a lawyer from Paris willing to help finally shows up.

1.title: FR - The King Who Never Was - S01E03 - Confessions
1.plot: Years later, Vittorio Emanuele goes to trial. Birgit hopes that the truth will be finally unveiled, but unexpected witnesses show up for the Prince.

meta.plot: Cette série documentaire fait la lumière sur l'homicide d'un adolescent allemand en 1978 à travers le témoignage de sa sœur et de la famille royale impliquée dans l'affaire.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: When the bodies of seven minors wash ashore, detective Darius Asram contacts a troubled young woman with ties to a pro-suicide sect.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Darius and Lesky trace the anonymous message to a youth center. Meanwhile, Christa contends with a surprise visitor and painful reminders of her past.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: As Christa begins decrypting the documents, Darius receives a tip about Linus. Back at the ward, Christa asks Lana for help with a secret plan.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: A gruesome discovery prompts Darius and Christa to reconstruct Linn Gonzales's journey along a desolate bus route.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Flashbacks reveal what happened the night of the stadium suicides. Ten years later, Caron finds his secret -- and his life's work -- in danger.

1.title: FR - Ad Vitam - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Forced off the case, Darius works alone to connect the dots between the Future Foundation, the bodies at the beach and Christa's disappearance.

meta.plot: Alors qu’on pense avoir vaincu la mort, sont découverts les corps de sept suicidés, tous mineurs. Dérive sectaire, acte politique, cri d’alarme d’une jeunesse sans repères ? Darius, flic de 120 ans, mène l’enquête avec Christa, jeune fille révoltée et suicidaire. Une descente vertigineuse dans les entrailles d’un monde qui dérive vers l’infini ou le néant...

1.title: FR - High on the Hog - S01E01 - Our Roots
1.plot: The hunt for African American food's roots goes to Benin, where okra and yam rule the market and pre-enslavement fish and corn plates reign at a table.

1.title: FR - High on the Hog - S01E02 - The Rice Kingdom
1.plot: In the Carolinas, Stephen looks at the human cost of rice and goes whole hog with Gullah chef BJ Dennis and those preserving Black culinary traditions.

1.title: FR - High on the Hog - S01E03 - Our Founding Chefs
1.plot: From mac and cheese to Virginia ham: Jefferson's and Washington's renowned enslaved chefs James Hemings and Hercules left the nation hungry for more.

1.title: FR - High on the Hog - S01E04 - Freedom
1.plot: Barbecued brisket meets Senegalese lamb and a Juneteenth feast as Stephen heads to Texas to ride with Black cowboys and take in Jerrelle Guy's cakes.

2.title: FR - High on the Hog - S02E01 - Food for the Journey
2.plot: From black-eyed peas to gumbo, African ingredients define New Orleans' signature dishes. Up north, the Great Migration inspires Chicago's culinary style.

2.title: FR - High on the Hog - S02E02 - The Black Mecca
2.plot: In Harlem, chef Charles Gabriel shares the secret to his pan-fried chicken and other trailblazers tell stories of their ancestors' connections to food.

2.title: FR - High on the Hog - S02E03 - The Defiance
2.plot: Stephen meets former student activists in Atlanta and honors the legacy of the chefs and bakers who fueled and funded the Civil Rights Movement.

2.title: FR - High on the Hog - S02E04 - Feeding the Culture
2.plot: A Black Panther reflects on the pivotal free breakfast program. Luminaries gather for a special dinner and layered conversation about race and food.

meta.plot: Black food is American food. Chef and writer Stephen Satterfield traces the delicious, moving throughlines from Africa to Texas in this docuseries.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E01 - Pilot
1.plot: While on assignment, agent Michael Westen gets a "Burn Notice" and becomes untouchable. Having no idea what or who triggered his demise, Michael returns to his hometown, Miami, determined to find out the reason for his sudden termination.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E02 - Identity
1.plot: Michael helps Madeline's friend retrieve money from a swindler, and in return he receives information about some visitors that came to his mother's home.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E03 - Fight or Flight
1.plot: A drug dealer is witnessed brutally beating up a man by a single mother. Oleg asks Michael to help the woman, Cara, his best waitress, after she stops showing up for work.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E04 - Old Friends
1.plot: Michael's friend, Bill, asks for the spy's help in freeing his daughter from a prostitution ring. Meanwhile, Michael dodges multiple assassination attempts.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E05 - Family Business
1.plot: Michael takes on arms dealers for an airport worker, while Nate obsesses about the car and their dad's will together.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E06 - Unpaid Debts
1.plot: Michael discovers a surprise aboard a boat he has retrieved from Jamaican gangsters. Meanwhile, a CSS agent urges Michael to stop his investigation into who burned him.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E07 - Broken Rules
1.plot: Michael works to rid a community in little Havana of a crime boss, all the while baiting Jason Bly at the risk of his family and friends.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E08 - Wanted Man
1.plot: With Michael's assistance, Fiona helps a man who has been framed for the theft of an expensive brooch.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E09 - Hard Bargain
1.plot: A slightly dim house sitter's fiancée has been kidnapped, and Sam guilts Michael into a rescue while he's negotiating with a D.C. bureaucrat to stop the burn notice.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E10 - False Flag
1.plot: Michael is hired to track down a woman's estranged husband, who has disappeared with their son. Michael soon finds himself pitted against somebody just as skilled and dangerous as he is.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E11 - Dead Drop (1)
1.plot: Sam takes on a case for a woman named Gillian, who is being blackmailed into using her security clearance to help smuggle heroin into the United States. Meanwhile, Michael is busy trying to arrange a meeting with Philip Cowan.

1.title: FR - Burn Notice - S01E12 - Loose Ends (2)
1.plot: Michael must rescue Sam from heroin smugglers, who happen to be ex-Special Forces, while also evading agents who are out to get him.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E01 - Breaking and Entering
2.plot: Having been recruited by the people who burned him, Michael's new handler, Carla, tasks him with helping a computer tech, whose wife and daughter were kidnapped, liberate some information that is guarded by mercenaries.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E02 - Turn and Burn
2.plot: While Michael's new handler asks him to locate a Tunisian counterfeiter, Sam asks him to help a woman who says she is being stalked by a drug dealer, and his mother asks him to join her in seeing a therapist.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E03 - Trust Me
2.plot: Andy, a cell-phone salesman, was conned into investing in a fake Cuban nightclub. Michael helps Andy when the people he borrowed the money from come knocking.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E04 - Comrades
2.plot: Michael helps a Russian woman, Katya, whose sister was smuggled into the U.S. by gangsters; however, Katya cannot afford their extortionate demands and her sister is being held captive.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E05 - Scatter Point
2.plot: Michael poses as a safe cracker to help out a reformed ex-con who is unwillingly part of a heist, and tries to sneak into the heavily-guarded office of his handler. Meanwhile, Sam gets an unexpected proposition from his girlfriend.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E06 - Bad Blood
2.plot: When someone's suspected of embezzling from a hip-hop mogul's charity, Michael attempts to trick the thief into stealing a larger sum.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E07 - Rough Seas
2.plot: Michael is hired to track down nearly a million dollars worth of pharmaceuticals that were stolen by thieves on their way to Tanzania.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E08 - Double Booked
2.plot: Michael and Sam discover the location of Bill Johnson (Joe Kimble) by going through his trash and finding laundry bluing, a staple among spies to prevent snooping in trash. Michael returns to his loft to find Larry Sizemore (Tim Matheson), a former mentor of Michael's. Larry offers Michael $20,000, but then Michael raises it to $30,000, to kill a nurse named Jeannie (Amy Pietz) who stands to gain a lot of money when her ailing husband dies. Michael and Fiona track down Jeannie and inform her that Drew (Zachery Ty Bryan), her stepson, has placed out a bounty on her head. Michael protects Jeannie by faking her poisoning, aided by Fiona's new boyfriend, Campbell (Gary Weeks), a paramedic. Larry kills Drew to cover his tracks and leaves Miami. Michael and Sam follow Bill Johnson into a building and find out that Carla has been using Michael for tactical support for an unknown operation. Michael had collected the ID card for entry into the building (Episode 2), and the rifle that sniper Bill Johnson would be using. Michael also attends family counseling with his mother.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E09 - Good Soldier
2.plot: Hired by Fiona's boyfriend's friend Henry, Michael poses as a disgruntled bodyguard to thwart a kidnapping plot masterminded by a ruthless man named Lesher.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E10 - Do No Harm
2.plot:
Michael prevents a man from committing suicide, whose son suffers from a heart condition. He had lost his savings in a scam after investing in a "miracle drug" for his son, so Michael decides to get him his money back.

Meanwhile, he has to deal with an explosion at his place and his brother in jail.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E11 - Hot Spot
2.plot: Sam calls in a favor and asks Michael to talk to Sean Martin, a football coach who helps impoverished kids. Sean wants Michael's assistance helping one of his players, Corey Jensen, who's being targeted by gangsters.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E12 - Seek and Destroy
2.plot:
Michael, under the alias of Miles Parker, is hired by Scott Chandler to investigate strange activity - log-ins at odd hours, unusual computer activity and telephone bugging - at an art gallery. But after being attacked by the the gallery's receptionist, Michael finds himself working against Chandler.

Meanwhile, Michael needs to find the person who planted the bomb at his loft, therefor he turns to arms dealer Seymour for help.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E13 - Bad Breaks
2.plot: A federal agent with a knack for giving Michael trouble returns to Miami to force Michael to hand over blackmail materials; the two enemies must work together during a bank robbery.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E14 - Truth & Reconciliation
2.plot: Michael takes on a sympathy case for a Haitian man whose daughter was murdered by a corrupt government official he believes is hiding in Miami. Michael gets closer to tracking down the person who tried to kill him.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E15 - Sins of Omission
2.plot: Michael's ex-fiancé seeks the spy's help in freeing her son, who was kidnapped by a disillusioned ex-spy named Brennen.

2.title: FR - Burn Notice - S02E16 - Lesser Evil
2.plot: Michael gets to know Victor's motivation and his connection to Carla after capturing him. When the truth about Carla's organization is revealed, everyone is put in danger.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E01 - Friends and Family
3.plot: Michael is bailed out of jail by an old friend who asks for his help in return.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E02 - Question and Answer
3.plot: Michael faces a new foe in Detective Paxson, who has tracked down some explosives Michael has been hiding in a storage facility, forcing Michael to surreptitiously get them out before Paxson gets a warrant.  Meanwhile, Michael and team must rescue a kidnapped child by using reverse interrogation.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E03 - End Run
3.plot: Arms trader Brennen returns and kidnaps Nate, forcing Michael to help him pull off an elaborate heist. Michael must also contend with Paxson's ongoing investigation.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E04 - Fearless Leader
3.plot: Michael gets a hold of a crime lord who seems to be the prime suspect in a Miami PD investigation, so he wants to hand him over in return for being left alone.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E05 - Signals and Codes
3.plot: A paranoid mathematician enlists Michael's help to stop the vice president of a defense firm from selling company secrets; Michael tracks down a new contact in the intelligence community.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E06 - The Hunter
3.plot: When he hears about an operative from his past who is hunting him, Michael turns to a prominent member of Miami's underworld for help; a man approaches Michael with an offer.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E07 - Shot In The Dark
3.plot: Michael convinces an abusive stepfather of a young boy to leave town by telling him he is the target of an assassination plot. Elsewhere, Strickler makes a promise to Michael that he will help him get back into the intelligence community if they can work together.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E08 - Friends Like These
3.plot: Barry enlists Michael's help in tracking down his money-laundering client list, which has been stolen by a vicious thief. Michael goes after the thief, only to find that there's a lot more to the situation than he realized. Fiona tries to be supportive of Michael's efforts to reconnect with the intelligence community, but she and Michael find that their differences on the subject may not be reconcilable.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E09 - Long Way Back
3.plot: A dangerous man from Fiona's past resurfaces in Miami after years of hiding, with deadly intentions. Teaming up with Fiona's ruthless brother, Michael will do whatever it takes to save her... even if that means crossing a few lines.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E10 - A Dark Road
3.plot: When a recently widowed woman hires Michael and Fiona to get her away from a group of violent con men, Michael turns to Madeline for help — but he may ask her to go too far. Meanwhile, a mysterious contact goes to extreme lengths to get Michael's attention.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E11 - Friendly Fire
3.plot: When Sam gets an unexpected visit from a former Seal buddy asking for help, Michael must infiltrate a protected urban barrio and hunt down a child predator. Michael also befriends a psychotic former spy runner in order to learn more about his destructive plans while in town.

3.title: FR - Burn Notice - S03E12 - Noble Causes
