1.plot: Cha Dal-geon encourages his nephew to go to Morocco with the taekwondo demonstration group. Go Hae-ri walks in late to a meeting at the Korean embassy.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: Cha Dal-geon makes a disquieting announcement to the other bereaving families and implores Go Hae-ri for help, but she seems to be hiding something.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Hae-ri remains skeptical about the flight-deck voice recording but is told that the evidence points to a faulty aircraft. Dal-geon is ambushed.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Dal-geon gets a call from someone out of the blue and is approached by a journalist, who claims to be pursuing a story about the plane crash.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Dal-geon attempts to alert the press about what he knows -- but someone interferes. Hae-ri contacts Gi Tae-ung to get answers about the flash drive.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: The NIS takes Dal-geon to a safe house. Tae-ung questions O Sang-mi about her husband’s involvement in the plane crash but is ordered to release her.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: Dal-geon sees someone who’s supposed to be dead. Hae-ri and Tae-ung head to Morocco to capture their suspect. The NIS takes Jessica Lee into custody.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Dal-geon runs into trouble while trying to carry out his own search. Tae-ung is displeased that the operation in Morocco doesn’t go as planned.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E09 - Episode 9
1.plot: Dal-geon and the agents try to keep Kim Woo-gi alive, and request NIS backup. Jessica moves to pin the plane crash on someone else.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E10 - Episode 10
1.plot: After running from the embassy, Dal-geon and the others head back to Korea another way. Min Jae-sik confronts Gang Ju-cheol.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E11 - Episode 11
1.plot: Dal-geon and Hae-ri make contact with Jae-sik. Jessica and Yun Han-gi see a big win at the National Assembly. Tae-ung undergoes scrutiny.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E12 - Episode 12
1.plot: The plan to get Woo-gi safely to the courthouse takes an unanticipated turn -- and throws the Blue House into panic mode.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E13 - Episode 13
1.plot: Dal-geon's explosive on-air accusation toward the president sparks a media storm. Jessica's press conference goes south quick.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E14 - Episode 14
1.plot: When O Sang-mi disappears, Dal-geon and Hae-ri realize there's more to the situation. Meanwhile, Hong Sun-jo takes advantage of the crisis.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E15 - Episode 15
1.plot: Sang-mi leaves behind a warning about a shady figure named Samael, putting everything Dal-geon thought he knew about the crash into question.

1.title: FR - Vagabond [VOSTFR] - S01E16 - Episode 16
1.plot: When Jessica asks for NIS protection in exchange for Samael's identity, Hae-ri heads to prison undercover. In hiding, Dal-geon plans his next steps.

meta.plot: La poursuite de vagabonds qui tentent de percer le mystère national pour révéler la vérité cachée à l'arrière-plan d'un accident d'avion de ligne qui a tué des innocents.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E01 - Part 1: The Dream Team
1.plot: Now that Riley is a teenager, dream director Paula needs to age up her glitter-filled productions.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E02 - Part 2: Out of Body
1.plot: Paula and her new assistant director Xeni struggle while Janelle's debut dream is a huge hit.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E03 - Part 3: Romance!
1.plot: Paula and Xeni's production goes off the rails, leading to dangerous behavior when Riley sleepwalks.

1.title: FR - Rêves Productions - S01E04 - Part 4: A Night to Remember
1.plot: Paula and Xeni team up to stop a nightmare, creating a new dream that may give Riley what she needs.

meta.plot: Riley grandit et ses souvenirs méritent parfois un traitement de faveur. Le quartier cérébral envoie ces souvenirs à Rêves Productions, où la célèbre réalisatrice Paula Persimmon doit faire face à un véritable cauchemar : réaliser le prochain rêve à succès de Riley aux côtés de Xeni, un réalisateur de rêveries prétentieuses, qui cherche tant bien que mal à entrer dans la cour des grands en matière de rêves.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E01 - Original Sin
1.plot: The Medici family suffers a great loss with the death of its patriarch Giovanni. When the designated heir Cosimo discovers that his father was poisoned, he decides to put Marco Bello on the assassin's trail.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E02 - The Dome and the Domicile
1.plot: The war is throwing Florence into chaos. Piero, Cosimo's only son, is eager to fight. Meanwhile, Cosimo manages to "buy" the withdrawal of Milan's troops, thus saving the city, but in the meantime Florence has again fallen into the plague.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E03 - Pestilence
1.plot: Albizzi has managed to foment the citizenry against Cosimo, accusing him of the crime of usury. When Cosimo learns of the situation, he decides to return to Florence. Albizzi then invents a ploy to get Cosimo arrested and held for trial.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E04 - Judgement Day
1.plot: From prison, Cosimo asks Contessina to try bribing a member of the Signoria, to buy votes in his favor. Albizzi starts poisoning Cosimo's food through his prison guard. Contessina negotiates exile rather than the death penalty.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E05 - Temptation
1.plot: While the Medici are in exile in Venice, the situation deteriorates day by day in Florence, with Albizzi imposing his rule over a city gravely depleted by the absence of the Medici.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E06 - Ascendancy
1.plot: The return of the Medici to Florence is an out-and-out triumph, with Albizzi in prison for his attempt to become the city's "tyrant".

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E07 - Purgatory
1.plot: The Signoria now has a vacant chair, and Cosimo is asked to choose who should occupy it. Piero thinks that his moment has now come, but the banker Pazzi, too, has his eyes set on that seat.

1.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S01E08 - Epiphany
1.plot: Pazzi has managed to convince the Pope to remove the Medici as Church bankers, but Cosimo is disinclined to surrender what he has worked so hard to attain.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E01 - Old Scores
2.plot: After a surprise attack, Lorenzo and Giuliano search for the culprits. The trail leads the brothers to the Pazzis, but treachery lies closer at hand.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E02 - Standing Alone
2.plot: Lorenzo's power play comes at a cost and stirs up outrage. With leadership comes sacrifice as he travels to Rome and weighs an advantageous match.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E03 - Obstacles and Opportunities
2.plot: The death of the pope brings strategic challenges as Lorenzo negotiates with the Duke of Milan and welcomes his new bride, Clarice, to Florence.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E04 - Blood with Blood
2.plot: Lorenzo aims to strengthen ties with the Pazzis and proposes a treaty with Venice. Clarice appeals to Lucrezia and learns the way to Lorenzo's heart.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E05 - Ties That Bind
2.plot: In opposition to the pope, Lorenzo moves quickly to acquire the strategic city of Imola. A forbidden love flowers between Giuliano and Simonetta.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E06 - Alliance
2.plot: The papal army advances as important coalitions shift. Meanwhile, Lorenzo negotiates a crucial treaty, and Jacopo attempts a major power grab.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E07 - Betrayal
2.plot: As forces threaten a fragile alliance, the Pazzis embark on a murderous plan to destroy the Medicis while Lorenzo seeks to make peace with Rome.

2.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S02E08 - Mass
2.plot: The day of reckoning arrives as the circle of conspirators tightens around the Medicis during Mass, and rivals attempt to take control of Florence.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E01 - Survival
3.plot: A few months after the Pazzi Conspiracy, Lorenzo is still animated by the spirit of revenge. There is a distant clash between Lorenzo and Pope Sixtus IV; the cruel count Riario - the last of the conspirators left alive - tries to take advantage of this conflict. A Dominican friar arrives in Florence who seems capable of reading Lorenzo's heart: Girolamo Savonarola.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E02 - The Ten
3.plot: The entry into the field of the Kingdom of Naples alongside the papal troops is likely to mark the end of Florence. Among the Priors there are those who doubt Lorenzo, but the Magnificent, determined not to let Florence fall into the hands of his enemies, finds a stratagem to deprive the Priors of authority. Lorenzo decides to leave for Naples to try to break the encirclement and restore peace.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E03 - Trust
3.plot: Arriving in Naples with Bernardi, Lorenzo finds it difficult to convince King Ferrante of Aragon to abandon the alliance with the Pope. While the Magnificent tries to win the king's trust, Florence remains under siege: the people and Clarice herself fear that Lorenzo has abandoned them.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E04 - Innocent
3.plot: Seven years have passed and Lorenzo hopes to close the accounts with the Pope by obtaining the signing of a peace treaty between the various Italian rulers. Riario hopes to induce Lorenzo to return to open war. While the Magnificent faces this new diplomatic crisis, his mother Lucrezia involves Clarice in the management of the bank. Worn out by the constant clash with Sixtus IV, Lorenzo decides to start his son Giovanni on an ecclesiastical career hoping to increase the influence of the Medici in the Roman Curia. The Treaty of Bagnolo, signed by all the Italian rulers, marks the triumph of the Medici family and Lorenzo, who has become the deciding vote of Italian politics.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E05 - The Holy See
3.plot: Sixtus IV is dead. Lorenzo and Clarice travel to Rome to support the election of their candidate for the papal throne, but they have to deal with the plots of Riario. The Medici find an unexpected ally in Caterina Sforza, Riario's wife. Despite the family's efforts, the new Pope Cybo proves difficult to control. In Florence, Savonarola harangues against Lorenzo for his influence in the conclave.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E06 - A Man of No Importance
3.plot: Lorenzo begins to show the first symptoms of a serious illness while his political enemies decide to attack him, questioning the solidity and provenance of Medici Bank's capital. Among these, Tommaso Peruzzi, once a supporter of the family, is now eager to bring to light a scandal that would condemn the Medici to exile. To cover up the crime and avoid losses, the Magnificent risks a new war and plans to kill Peruzzi.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E07 - Lost Souls
3.plot: Savonarola, who had taken Tommaso's confession, denounces his killing and openly accuses Lorenzo, who however continues to deny. Clarice begins to suspect the truth. To continue his strategy of control over the Holy See, the Magnificent makes a promise that triggers a family crisis.

3.title: FR - Les Médicis : Les Maîtres de Florence - S03E08 - The Fate of the City
3.plot: Lorenzo allows Bernardi to convince him that the only solution not to lose everything is to kill Savonarola, whose following gets bigger and bigger. By now, the friar openly preaches the overthrow of the established order to found a new Jerusalem. Lorenzo's plan is ready and the assassins recruited ...

meta.plot: La mort du patriarche est un coup terrible pour le clan Médicis. Lorsque son héritier et successeur, Cosimo, découvre que son père a été empoisonné, il décide de garder l’information pour lui et charge son fidèle ami Marco Bello de remonter la piste de l’assassin. Cosimo, qui a depuis longtemps fait son deuil de son rêve d'être artiste, reprend alors la tête de la banque familiale et le siège de son père à l’assemblée florentine, la Seigneurie, où il doit faire face à l’hostilité des familles nobles menées par Rinaldo Degli Ablizzi. Lorsque le Duc de Milan annexe la ville de Lucques jusqu'ici sous contrôle florentin, Cosimo doit faire un choix: soutiendra-t-il Albizzi et les nobles sur le chemin de la guerre, comme Giovanni l’aurait fait, ou s’affranchira-t-il de l'ombre de son père?

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E01 - Dulcinea
1.plot: In the outer solar system near Saturn, James Holden and the crew of the ice-freighter Canterbury, investigate a distress call from a mysterious derelict ship, the Scopuli. On Ceres Station, Detective Miller begins an off the book investigation of a missing heiress, Julie Mao.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E02 - The Big Empty
1.plot: Holden and crew are trapped in badly damaged shuttle. On Ceres, Miller uncovers clues about Julie Mao. On Earth, Chrisjen Avasarala questions a terrorist.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E03 - Remember the Cant
1.plot: Holden and the crew are taken prisoner by the Martian Congressional Republic Navy. Miller deals with unhappy rioters. Avasarala plays politics and gets severely burned.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E04 - CQB
1.plot: Holden and crew find themselves in the middle of a desperate battle while still aboard the Martian battleship. Miller’s partner, Havelock, goes missing.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E05 - Back to the Butcher
1.plot: Holden finds an unlikely ally. Miller’s obsession with Mao intensifies.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E06 - Rock Bottom
1.plot: Miller gains valuable information from a hidden data cube. Holden and his crew learn their host’s agenda.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E07 - Windmills
1.plot: Holden and his crew face a Martian military blockade. Miller finds a new reason to forge ahead. Avasarala visits Holden’s family.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E08 - Salvage
1.plot: A derelict vessel holds a potentially devastating secret. Holden and his crew cross paths with Miller on Eros. Avasarala receives bad news.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E09 - Critical Mass
1.plot: Julie's origin story ends up revealing her trajectory. Holden and Miller work together as they take a look at a strange emergency happening on Eros.

1.title: FR - The Expanse - S01E10 - Leviathan Wakes
1.plot: Avasarala uncovers a game-changing secret while the future of the human race might be in Holden and Miller's hands.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E01 - Safe
2.plot: Unlikely allies Joe Miller and the crew of the Rocinante led by Jim Holden uncover more about the conspiracy to release the protomolecule on Eros station.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E02 - Doors & Corners
2.plot: With the help of Fred Johnson and the OPA, Miller, Holden and the crew stage a raid for information on the protomolecule. On Earth, Avasarala learns a truth about Fred Johnson.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E03 - Static
2.plot: Holden and Miller butt heads about how the raid was handled.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E04 - Godspeed
2.plot: Miller devises a dangerous plan to eradicate what's left of the protomolecule on Eros.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E05 - Home
2.plot: The Rocinante chases an asteroid as it hurtles towards Earth.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E06 - Paradigm Shift
2.plot: Earth and Mars search for answers in the aftermath of the asteroid collision.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E07 - The Seventh Man
2.plot: Preparations for the Earth/Mars peace conference tighten the tension on Erringwright.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E08 - Pyre
2.plot: Naomi tracks down signs of the protomolecule; Fred Johnson's control over the OPA collapses.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E09 - The Weeping Somnambulist
2.plot: Bobbie becomes a political pawn in the struggle between Earth and Mars.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E10 - Cascade
2.plot: Holden leads his crew through the war-torn station on Ganymede.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E11 - Here There Be Dragons
2.plot: Bobbie makes a decision that changes her life forever.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E12 - The Monster and the Rocket
2.plot: A discovery pushes Naomi and Holden apart and sets the Rocinante crew against each other.

2.title: FR - The Expanse - S02E13 - Caliban's War
2.plot: The Rocinante crew must fight to save the ship.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E01 - Fight or Flight
3.plot: The Rocinante crew deals with the fallout over Naomi's betrayal while caught in the middle of the war between Earth and Mars while Avasarala and Bobbie hatch an escape plan.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E02 - IFF
3.plot: The Rocinante answers an unexpected distress signal. Bobbie and Avasarala find themselves being hunted by a mysterious captor. UN Secretary-General Sorrento-Gillis brings in a colleague from his past to lend an ear during this crucial time of war.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E03 - Assured Destruction
3.plot: As Earth strategizes a costly ploy to gain advantage in the war against Mars, Anna struggles to convince Sorrento-Gillis to do the right thing. Avasarala and Bobbie seek refuge aboard the Rocinante.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E04 - Reload
3.plot: The Rocinante tends to wounded Martian soldiers in exchange for supplies. Avasarala struggles with how to disseminate a key piece of evidence despite being in hiding.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E05 - Triple Point
3.plot: The search for Prax's daughter comes to a head. Admiral Souther's men plan for mutiny aboard the Agatha King

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E06 - Immolation
3.plot: The final battle between Earth and Mars threatens the very future of humanity. A new monster is unleashed on Prospero Station. Anna receives the smoking gun she needs.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E07 - Delta-V
3.plot: All eyes turn to the edge of the solar system as a mysterious new presence emerges; Naomi recommits to her roots; Drummer butts heads with a seasoned new commander aboard the Behemoth; and a young Belter makes a name for himself.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E08 - It Reaches Out
3.plot: An old friend taunts Holden with the answers he seeks. Naomi struggles to fit in. A mysterious low-level tech aboard the Thomas Prince enacts a terrifying plan.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E09 - Intransigence
3.plot: The Rocinante seeks a new gameplan as they attempt to avoid capture. Melba's true motives are revealed. Naomi is torn between identity and ideal. Anna seeks a way to stay aboard the Thomas Prince.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E10 - Dandelion Sky
3.plot: Holden sees past, present, and future. A ghost from Melba's past threatens her mission. Bobbie struggles to trust an old friend as she leads a group into unchartered territory.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E11 - Fallen World
3.plot: Drummer and Ashford find themselves trapped with few options for survival; Anna tends to the wounded masses as Melba continues to hunt down her prey; the Rocinante crew struggles to survive as Naomi reunites with her true family.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E12 - Congregation
3.plot: As survivors arrive to the Behemoth, two factions form over how to handle a life-or-death threat. Holden grapples with what he's seen and the choices he must make.

3.title: FR - The Expanse - S03E13 - Abaddon's Gate
3.plot: Holden and his allies must stop Ashford and his team from destroying the Ring, and perhaps all of humanity.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E01 - New Terra
4.plot: The crew of the Roci investigates a strange protomolecule ruin on an alien planet. Bobbie copes with civilian life on Mars. Drummer and Ashford battle with piracy in the Belt.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E02 - Jetsam
4.plot: Avasarala is blindsided while on a visit to Mars. The Roci crew continue their protomolecule investigation while tensions between the RCE and Belters reach a tipping point. Drummer and Ashford track down a terrorist.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E03 - Subduction
4.plot: New alien threats emerge on Ilus as Naomi battles health challenges on the planet. Bobbie searches for a missing person on Mars. Avasarala faces a new challenge in the UN.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E04 - Retrograde
4.plot: Drummer and Ashford confront a dangerous person from Naomi's past. Murtry hunts down a target. Bobbie's makes a life-changing confession.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E05 - Oppressor
4.plot: As tensions on Ilus reach a boiling point, Holden reveals a secret. Avasarala debates Nancy Gao while an emergency on the Roci forces Alex and Naomi into action.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E06 - Displacement
4.plot: The Roci crew prepares for an incoming disaster on Ilus. Ashford and Drummer close in on an enemy within the Belt. Bobbie takes on a dangerous job.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E07 - A Shot in the Dark
4.plot: Naomi and Alex work to keep the Barbapiccola in orbit amidst a power outage. Avasarala faces a tough decision. Holden and Elvi race to find a cure for a disease spreading on Ilus.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E08 - The One-Eyed Man
4.plot: Avasarala faces fallout for the UN's military mission. Ashford and Drummer makes big decisions about their future within the OPA. A spreading illness on Ilus takes a toll on Amos. Alex and Naomi's attempt to rescue the Barb turns desperate.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E09 - Saeculum
4.plot: Holden and Miller race to save Ilus. Murtry puts his endgame into motion, putting the Roci crew's lives at risk.

4.title: FR - The Expanse - S04E10 - Cibola Burn
4.plot: Ashford closes in on an enemy while uncovering a dangerous plot. Avasarala faces a crossroads in her personal and political life. The Roci crew works to reestablish life on Ilus in the wake of a deadly catastrophe.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E01 - Exodus
5.plot: Holden tries to convince Fred Johnson to destroy the last sample of protomolecule. Naomi gets an important lead to her son. On Luna, Avasarala begins to hunt for Marco Inaros.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E02 - Churn
5.plot: Holden and Fred deal with infiltrators on Tycho. Drummer's past comes back to haunt her. Amos returns to Baltimore. Alex and Bobbie's investigation on Mars leads to rogue soldiers.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E03 - Mother
5.plot: Naomi comes face to face with Filip. Holden and Fred turn the tables. Avasarala closes in on Marco's plot.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E04 - Gaugamela
5.plot: Marco's grand plan shocks Earth, Mars and the Belt.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E05 - Down and Out
5.plot: Amos and Clarissa are trapped in a collapsed building. Naomi contends with her old family. Holden assembles a new crew on the Roci. Alex and Bobbie make a dangerous discovery in the Belt.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E06 - Tribes
5.plot: Holden and the Roci go on the hunt. Amos and Clarissa seek shelter on a devastated Earth. Bobbie and Alex fight a desperate battle. Marco makes Drummer an offer she can't refuse. Avasarala returns to a position of power.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E07 - Oyedeng
5.plot: Naomi makes a desperate attempt to save her son from Marco. On the Roci, Holden battles for the last sample of protomolecule.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E08 - Hard Vacuum
5.plot: Amos returns to Baltimore with Clarissa. On Luna, Avasarala's alliances begin to shift. Alone and adrift, Naomi becomes a deadly lure.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E09 - Winnipesaukee
5.plot: Amos, Clarissa, and a gang of thieves work together to leave Earth. Avasarala tries to head off a brutal military strike. Drummer's new family bonds are tested as Naomi's life hangs in the balance.

5.title: FR - The Expanse - S05E10 - Nemesis Games
5.plot: Holden and the Roci face off against Marco's forces and Drummer, while Alex and Bobbie attempt a dangerous rescue of Naomi, and the balance of power in the Solar System shifts.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E01 - Strange Dogs
6.plot: The Rocinante crew make a startling discovery on an asteroid. Avasarala and Bobbie contend with the devastation on Earth. Drummer and her family must make a heartbreaking decision. On Ceres, Marco and Filip's struggles turn inward.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E02 - Azure Dragon
6.plot: With an unexpected passenger aboard the Rocinante, Holden and crew undertake a dangerous mission that could shift the balance of power in the war. Drummer decides to make an uneasy alliance. Filip wrestles with his guilt.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E03 - Force Projection
6.plot: Avasarala, with the Combined Fleet of Earth and Mars, takes the war to Marco. Filip and Marco's relationship is tested. The war becomes more perilous and personal for Holden and Naomi when the Rocinante is suddenly forced into a battle.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E04 - Redoubt
6.plot: Holden finds himself at odds with his crew when a controversial decision is uncovered. On Ceres, Avasarala struggles to contain an escalating humanitarian crisis. Drummer's growing faction stage a daring raid with dire stakes. Filip, demoted to repair skiff duty, makes an unexpected discovery.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E05 - Why We Fight
6.plot: Paths converge on Ceres when Drummer and her fleet arrive to aid the relief effort. Holden tries to convince Avasarala to release crucial information that might avert catastrophe, but she has her own request of him. As Amos and Bobbie get a little R&R at the station, Naomi has a difficult and long-awaited reunion.

6.title: FR - The Expanse - S06E06 - Babylon's Ashes
6.plot: In the thrilling season finale, Inners and Belters fight side by side with the crew of the Rocinante in a last, massive, desperate battle with Marco and his Free Navy, with the fate of the Solar System, the Ring Gates, and of all humanity hanging in the balance.

meta.plot: A thriller set two hundred years in the future following the case of a missing young woman who brings a hardened detective and a rogue ship's captain together in a race across the solar system to expose the greatest conspiracy in human history.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E01 - Episode 1
2.plot: The recently returned Syrian warrior, June al-Baqee, is taken hostage by four Islamist terrorists, several of whom are believed to be returning Syrian warriors who – unlike June – fought ISIS in Syria. Philip Nørgaard, currently is on leave from TTF, June knows from the past and, unlike PET, believes that a major crime lies behind her disappearance. He decides to investigate the case on his own.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E02 - Episode 2
2.plot: Philips’ hunt for June has led them both aboard the Swedish ferry in the Sound. As June opportunistically manages to escape the hostages and hide, they now have to panic search the ferry before it reaches land. Meanwhile, Philip manages to alert the Ferry Captain, who activates the terrorist alarm. Soon PET and the Defense Intelligence Service are realizing that a highly tense and apparently Islamist terrorist campaign is underway. The police anti-terror unit TTF is activated, but this time without Philip to lead it.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E03 - Episode 3
2.plot: The hostages have hijacked the ferry and taken passengers and crew hostage. While the ship is stationary in the middle of the Sound, the TTF from their position at Kronborg tries to get an overview of the situation. Negotiation and attack strategies are evaluated and the attackers motive investigated. On the ferry, the hostages still find June unsuccessful, and they must now use other means to lure her out of her hiding place. But Philip is also looking for June.

2.title: FR - Below the Surface - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: With Philip trapped in the ferry’s freezer room, the hostages use harsh methods to grab June’s cell phone, which turns out to be the object of their kidnapping and hijacking. On land, investigators SP and Simon quickly try to get closer to the hostages’ identities, motives and possible conspiracies, while the TTF with the government in the back sets for an armed surprise attack to get all the hostages released and the situation shut down once and for all.

meta.plot: Dans un métro de Copenhague, quinze innocents sont pris en otages par un groupe de terroristes . Alors que le gouvernement refuse de payer la rançon, les familles des victimes se tournent vers les médias pour faire pression. L'événement tragique tourne en débat politique national.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E01 - People Can Change
1.plot: Helena and her twin sister Siri have long lived separate lives. When a reunion approaches, Helena thanks and travels to an idyllic resort in the Italian Alps, but it quickly turns out that Siri has her own agenda with her invitation.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E02 - The Truth Will Set You Free (And Other Lies)
1.plot: Helena becomes painfully aware of Himmelsdalens main activity. Desperately, she tries to prove her true identity, but the staff of the institution dismiss her claims as another of Siri's manipulative tricks.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E03 - The Jackals Are Circling
1.plot: Doctors disagree on how to interpret "Siris" sudden behavioral improvement. Helena realizes that she can take advantage of her fellow prisoners' fear of Siri and get to know a secret organization that can pave the way for a possible escape.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E04 - Suffer The Little Children
1.plot: The doctors' actions suggest that they are beginning to take Helena's story seriously, but in fact they are just looking to confirm their own theories of treatment. Enzo understands that Helena speaks truth and shares her escape plan.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E05 - The Lord Giveth, And The Lord Taketh Away
1.plot: The young guide turns out to be anything but trustworthy, but confidence in Enzo exists. Helena gets valuable information about her sister during the sessions with Silva and a new plan to prove her identity is beginning to take shape.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E06 - Staying Alive
1.plot: Helena gets a life sign from Siri for the first time, which apparently has no plans to return. The flight is close, but first another risky mission awaits, as Helena refuses to leave the Valley of Heaven without having found the hammer.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E07 - Hail Mary
1.plot: Helena's newly won expectations are crushed when she is reached by the news of her own death, but suddenly Margot emerges with a new spark of hope. At the same time, Redpath and Fischer are trying to clear evidence in the hope of saving the facility's reputation.

1.title: FR - Sanctuary - S01E08 - Will The Circle Be Unbroken?
1.plot: Season finale. Helena wins over Silva on her side, but an accident happens when he tries to leave the facility. Now it remains only for Helena and Enzo to carry out their escape attempt - and they are both prepared to do so at all costs.

meta.plot: Siri et Héléna sont des jumelles qui ont été séparées à la naissance du fait de leur relation conflictuelle. Des années plus tard, Héléna rend visite à Siri dans une station balnéaire des Alpes. Mais, une fois sur place, elle se rend compte qu'elle a été piégée et qu'elle va se retrouver au sein d'un établissement psychiatrique désireux de faire des expérimentations...

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E01 - Contamination
1.plot: An epidemic looms. Anne-Marie Leclerc, director of the Emergency Public Health Laboratory, must deal with an outbreak, an overzealous cabinet minister, and a media storm. To top it off, she discovers that her husband has been deceiving her. All this is trivial compared to what’s in store...

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E02 - The Invisible Threat
1.plot: The disease continues to spread silently. For now, Anne-Marie has other worries. She sets out to prove to the Minister that her lab is effective. She’s still hesitant to confront Marc. Françoise organizes a celebration for Xavier. It’s a small gathering – with immense consequences.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E03 - Suspicion
1.plot: Nelli tells Anne-Marie that a strange illness is affecting people she’s close to. Anne-Marie initiates an investigation into the deaths of the two homeless people. The young girl infected by Nelli’s cousin risks infecting others. In the lab, the arrival of a new staffer affects Anne-Marie’s work.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E04 - The Finger on the Trigger
1.plot: The dead can’t talk. Anne-Marie needs to know if people close to the victims are suffering from the disease. The clock is ticking. The lab team does all it can to break the chain of transmission and discover the nature of the virus.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E05 - The Last Card
1.plot: Unaware that the epidemic is developing a second hot-spot, Anne-Marie focuses her energy on finding medication that will help patients. Will she go as far as breaking the law? Françoise is now in contact with Marcellin, a friend of Xavier’s who’s suffering from the same “flu.”

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E06 - Out of Control
1.plot: Cases of COVA are multiplying; enforced home quarantines number in the hundreds. Anne-Marie redoubles her efforts to contain the epidemic and limit deaths. Confined to her home, Geneviève hides her symptoms. She has one wish – to be near her hospitalized son – even if that means breaking the rules.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E07 - Consequences
1.plot: Anne-Marie combats the misinformation prompting irrational behavior. The minister no longer has faith in her and wants to be directly involved in the experimental treatment. At the lab, Nelli follows up a new lead in the investigation. Will she find the source of the virus?

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E08 - Fear
1.plot: The 200th COVA death is about to be announced. How can public panic be minimized? Montrealers are fleeing the city and ignoring symptoms. Anne-Marie needs a new strategy.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E09 - The Hens
1.plot: A drop in the number of new cases heralds the end of the epidemic. Will there be a second wave? Anne-Marie is suddenly confronted with several cases of sick people who have had no contact with infected individuals. The team works to solve the puzzle. Sabrina and Juliette sell their first ferret.

1.title: FR - Épidémie - S01E10 - Scars
1.plot: Two days before the official announcement that the epidemic is over, the infection of two little girls brings Anne-Marie back to square one. The epidemiological investigation resumes, but the girls are uncooperative. Will Nelli get them to talk and prevent COVA from claiming more victims?

meta.plot: Un dangereux virus se répand à Montréal dans un groupe d’itinérants ostracisés et vulnérables. Combien de temps Anne-Marie Leclerc, infectiologue et directrice du Laboratoire d’urgence sanitaire, prendra-t-elle avant de réaliser l’existence de cette maladie hautement contagieuse ? Sera-t-il trop tard pour empêcher qu’une épidémie mortelle se propage dans l’ensemble de la population ?

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E01 - Episode 1
1.plot: Pervin faces a treacherous dilemma after moving to Raqqa with her husband, a member of ISIS. SÄPO officer Fatima seizes the chance for a career boost.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E02 - Episode 2
1.plot: As Ibbe lures Kerima, Sulle and Miryam into his scheme, Fatima pressures Pervin to access Husam's notebook, which contains details of the attack.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E03 - Episode 3
1.plot: Pervin scrambles to cover her tracks after a fateful deed. Fatima stumbles upon a clue. Ibbe introduces Sulle and Kerima to a persuasive recruit.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E04 - Episode 4
1.plot: Miryam sets Ibbe's plan in motion. Fatima's investigation hits a snag. Dolores makes a shocking discovery as hidden agendas come to light.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E05 - Episode 5
1.plot: Calle visits with Suleiman and Tuba. Fatima arranges for Pervin's escape from Raqqa. Kerima hands Sulle a surprise from Ibbe.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E06 - Episode 6
1.plot: Fatima tracks down a man who could be an important lead, but he's one step ahead. At wits' end, Suleiman heads for the Syrian-Turkish border with Calle.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E07 - Episode 7
1.plot: With Lisha's fate in her hands, Pervin enlists Husam's help. Fatima tails Jakob and Emil and turns to her last resort.

1.title: FR - Kalifat - S01E08 - Episode 8
1.plot: Nadir reveals an unexpected truth. Kerima prepares to deal the final blow. Fatima fulfills her end of the bargain with Pervin — at a price.

meta.plot: L'agent de sécurité nationale Fatima reçoit une information selon laquelle une attaque terroriste contre la Suède est en cours de planification. Pendant ce temps, Sulle, une adolescente de Stockholm, s'intéresse à son assistante étudiante qui ouvre les portes d'un monde nouveau et fascinant - le vrai chemin. Kalifat est un thriller sur les destins entremêlés de cinq jeunes femmes qui sont prises dans la force séduisante et destructrice du fondamentalisme religieux.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E01 - Code of Umbrellas
1.plot: In an ancient kingdom, a vicious warlord is on the hunt for a magical sword. Forced to escape his soldiers, the young girl who guards the sword is hunted until she receives some unexpected help from a pair of odd strangers.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E02 - Attack of the Xuán Guǐ Zōng!
1.plot: Shāng Bù Huàn has no intention of following the sly Lǐn Xuě Yā's advice and helping in the quest to protect the mystical Tiān Xing Jiàn sword, but when finds himself targeted by the evil sect that is trying to take it, he finds he might not have a choice.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E03 - The Woman In Night Devil Forest
1.plot: To defeat the villainous Miè Tiān Hái, Dān Fěi and her party will need to get through an army of bloodthirsty undead. The safest way to do this would be to recruit the help of a necromancer, but the person that Lǐn Xuě Yā has in mind makes the others very nervous, for a good reason...

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E04 - The Whereabouts of the Soul Echo Flute
1.plot: After an attempt to recruit the otherworldly Night's Lament, the group moves to rendezvous with the owner of the Soul Echo Flute. What they find in his place spells big trouble for the enigmatic Guǐ Niǎo...

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E05 - The Sword Devil, Shā Wú Shēng
1.plot: After the group returns to their inn, they talk about confronting the Screaming Phoenix Killer. Cán Yún is determined to fight Wú Shēng in a duel the next morning, because he considers himself expendable and because, if he wins, then he would make a name for himself. Xíng Hài offers her help in the form of spells. Guǐ Niǎo, however, feels that confrontation should only be used as a last resort. Bù Huàn gets tired of the talk and decides to head off on his own. He goes to the Devilwood Flower Garden himself and asks Wú Shēng to hand over the Soul Echo Flute. Wú Shēng refuses and they prepare to battle, but Guǐ Niǎo diffuses the situation and asks Wú Shēng the favor of becoming the performer of the Soul Echo Flute; in exchange, Guǐ Niǎo propositions Wú Shēng his head once they have reached the summit of the Demon Spine Mountains. Wú Shēng agrees. Meanwhile, Miè Tiān Hái suspects that Guǐ Niǎo's group will head to him.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E06 - Seven Comrades
1.plot: Bù Huàn is worried that the group cannot work together, as everyone is suspicious of each other. However, he still accompanies them as they ride a boat to the Demon Spine Mountains. Upon arrival to shore, the group encounters the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, led by Liè Mèi and Diāo Mìng. Cán Yún is motivated by Wú Shēng to attack and takes care of the "cannon fodder," while Hài and Yún Xiāo work together to raise the dead created by Cán Yún. Wú Shēng finally attacks after all the soldiers have been taken care of, killing Liè Mèi. Suddenly, Miè Tiān Hái shows up.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E07 - Demon Spine Mountains
1.plot: The group arrives at the Demon Spine Mountains, encountering the Valley of the Dead, the first trial.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E08 - The Enigmatic Gale
1.plot: After Bù Huàn storms off, Fěi admonishes the groups and runs after him. Guǐ Niǎo also follows her. The remaining four comrades decide to pass through the Labyrinth of Darkness using the Soul Echo Flute. Guǐ Niǎo and Fěi find Bù Huàn spying on some Xuán Guǐ Zōng soldiers, who are trying to catch more demon birds. The three of them ambush the Xuán Guǐ Zōng and use a bone-whistle to call the demon birds and ride them to the Seven Sins Tower. Once they arrive, they find Tiān Hái waiting for them. Fěi immediately attacks him, seeking vengeance for her brother and to obtain the hilt of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn. However, Guǐ Niǎo sprays Fěi with smoke, causing her to attack Bù Huàn instead. Diāo Mìng then knocks out Fěi and arrests Bù Huàn. They are then thrown into cages, where they are found by the other four. Yún Xiāo reveals Guǐ Niǎo's other name, Enigmatic Gale (Lüè Fēng Qiè Chén), while Fěi reveals his real name, Lǐn Xuě Yā.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E09 - The Essence of a Sword
1.plot: Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài reveal that their letters from Lǐn Xuě Yā asked them to swindle Fěi of her crossguard. Wú Shēng affirms this with the letter he stole from Xuě Yā's teacher, Lián Qí. Cán Yún is shaken up by this turn of events, but still follows the other three as they leave Bù Huàn and Fěi in their cells. Wú Shēng returns to the Tower, though, seeking Xuě Yā's head as promised. Meanwhile, Xuě Yā and Miè Tiān Hái are having a discussion about the Tiān Xíng Jiàn. Wú Shēng interrupts this discussion, though, and before going after Xuě Yā, challenges Tiān Hái to a duel. Tiān Hái slays Wú Shēng, and explains his swordsmanship to Xuě Yā. While this happens, Bù Huàn breaks out of his cell.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E10 - A Thief's Pride
1.plot: After Bù Huàn exits his cell, he sees Wú Shēng fighting through endless streams of Xuán Guǐ Zōng fodder. Bù Huàn picks up a sword from a dead soldier and continues searching the Seven Sins Tower for Lǐn Xuě Yā. He then spots Xuě Yā and Diāo Mìng, and hides. Bù Huàn confronts Xuě Yā after Diāo Mìng leaves. Xuě Yā then explains his plan to Bù Huàn, and explains that both Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài are villains that would take the Tiān Xíng Jiàn for themselves. All Xuě Yā wants to do is make Miè Tiān Hái despair. Xuě Yā also reveals the hiding place of the crossguard—the Limitless Temple. Bù Huàn then meets with Fěi and tells her the plan and to stay in the cell. Meanwhile, Xuě Yā sets up a deal with Tiān Hái. Afterwards, Xuě Yā meets with Bù Huàn again and gives him a hood that changes his appearance to that of Xuě Yā. They then begin to carry out Xuě Yā's plan. At the same time, Cán Yún breaks Fěi out of her cell.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E11 - A Proud Life
1.plot: Bù Huàn, disguised as Xuě Yā, meets with Tiān Hái, who becomes very suspicious, and together with the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, ride their demon birds to the Limitless Temple. As this happens, Xuě Yā discovers that Yún Xiāo and Xíng Hài also met with Tiān Hái. He then goes to unlock the safe containing the hilt of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, transforming his pipe into chopsticks. Erstwhile, after Bù Huàn receives the gold agreed upon for the crossguard of the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, he is questioned by Tiān Hái and Diāo Mìng, who have already seen through his disguise. Bù Huàn then acts as bait to allow Xuě Yā to finish his part. However, Tiān Hái had kept the hilt on him the entire time. Meanwhile, Cán Yún and Fěi also head to the Limitless Temple by way of a Spirit Tree.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E12 - A Blade That Doesn't Cut
1.plot: After escaping, Bù Huàn happens upon Cán Yún and Fěi. He learns Yún Xiāo and Hài stole the crossguard and intend to sell it to Tiān Hái. Suddenly, Diāo Mìng and the Xuán Guǐ Zōng show up and attack the three of them. Bù Huàn shows his true colors and fights with a wooden branch. After killing Diāo Mìng and the Xuán Guǐ Zōng, Bù Huàn explains his philosophy as the three of them head to the Duàn Jiàn Cí. Meanwhile, Yún Xiāo and Hài meet with Tiān Hái at the Duàn Jiàn Cí. After removing the sword from the pedestal, Yāo Tú Lí is revealed, the lost demon god. Hài then kills Yún Xiāo for trying to prevent the awakening of the demon god. Xuě Yā confronts Tiān Hái outside the Duàn Jiàn Cí after Hài leaves.

1.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S01E13 - A New Duty
1.plot: Xuě Yā duels Tiān Hái, with Xuě Yā crushing Tiān Hái's spirit. Because of this, Tiān Hái destroys the Tiān Xíng Jiàn, releasing Yāo Tú Lí from the binding. Bù Huàn decides to face Yāo Tú Lí. He defeats the demon god by channeling the power of one of the thirty-six swords he collected from his travels, and banishes the demon god to the far reaches of space, ending the threat once and for all. He leaves the sword in the care of Cán Yún and Fěi, and departs, but not before receiving a parting gift from Xuě Yā.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E01 - Xian Zhen Fortress
2.plot: The Sorcerous Sword Index is a collection of 35 magical swords wielding otherworldly powers, many of which have the potential to bring ruin to the human realm. Shang Bu Huan has fled his homeland of Xi You with the index in order to keep it from falling into the wrong hands... but trouble has a way of finding him.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E02 - The Stolen Sorcerous Blades
2.plot: The Princess of Cruelty Xie Yingluo has managed to make off with a pair of blades from the Sorcerous Sword Index, and now she plots to use them and her mastery over poison to seize the rest from Shang Bu Huan.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E03 - The Princess of Cruelty
2.plot: Shang Bu Huan is stricken by the Princess of Cruelty's poison, leaving him and Lang Wu Yao on the run. Between the toxic temptress' attack and the and the ruthless pursuit of magistrate Xiao Kuang Juan, their quest to protect the Sorcerous Sword Index might be impossible... without some help.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E04 - Close Foes
2.plot: Lin Xue Ya and Shang Bu Huan are reunited, while the fugitive hunter Xiao Kuáng Juan approaches the Princess of Cruelty with an offer she can't refuse.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E05 - Hellfire Valley
2.plot: With his health recovered, Shang Bu Huan takes a stand against the poisonous Xie Yīngluo and the treacherous Xiao Kuang Juan.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E06 - A Poisoner’s Pride
2.plot: With his health recovered, Shang Bu Huan takes a stand against the poisonous Xie Yingluo and the treacherous Xiao Kuang Juan.

2.title: FR - Thunderbolt Fantasy (VOSTFR) - S02E07 - Bewitching Whispers
2.plot: Xie Yīngluo has been bested, beaten, betrayed, and brutalized, and at this point she has nothing to lose. What will happen when the cornered scorpion is presented with a means of turning her doomed luck around?

Rencontres, trahisons et combats épiques jalonneront sa quête d'une relique volée.

meta.plot: Pouvoir voir les fantômes et autres esprits surnaturels est une lourde responsabilité. Le prince Lee Rin (Jung Il Woo), comme son père avant lui, découvre qu'il est capable de voir des fantômes et d'autres êtres surnaturels. Fort de ses nouvelles capacités, Lee Rin devient le chef d'un groupe de gardes de nuit qui patrouillent dans les rues du crépuscule à l'aube pour protéger les habitants de la dynastie Chosun contre les mauvais esprits. Moo Seok (Jung Yun Ho) est le meilleur épéiste du pays, qui est le fidèle garde du corps du prince. Mais leur loyauté sera mise à l'épreuve lorsqu'ils tomberont amoureux l'un de l'autre de la même femme - Do Ha (Go Sung Hee), successeur de la tribu des Ma Go, qui cherche leur aide pour protéger les esprits de la montagne Baek Do. Mais Park Soo Ryun (Seo Ye Ji), fille d'un officier de justice, ne recule devant rien pour épouser le prince Lee Rin. «Le gardien de nuit», également connu sous le nom de «Journal d'un gardien de nuit»

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E01 - Her Boy
1.plot: Julia and Benjamin meet by chance and start dating. When Julia introduces him to her grown-up children, they question if Benjamin's intentions are financially motivated.

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E02 - Her Daughter
1.plot: Julia realises she's in love with Benjamin. Patrick and Della, who are suspicious of Benjamin, follow him and catch him in a compromising situation. Is he really who he seems?

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E03 - Her Rival
1.plot: When Julia's children accuse Benjamin of infidelity it threatens to split them up. But their relationship grows stronger as they move in together and Benjamin proposes.

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E04 - Her Husband
1.plot: When Julia tells Ted about her engagement to Benjamin it causes unexpected consequences. Meanwhile Patrick entreats Julia to get Benjamin to sign a pre-nup to protect her wealth.

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E05 - Her Baby
1.plot: When Benjamin's half-brother turns up, Julia goes on a quest to find out what Benjamin's hiding. When she discovers his secret, will she still marry him?

1.title: FR - Le Doute - S01E06 - Her Love
1.plot: Julia is reeling from the revelations about Benjamin's past. But the future is up to her.

meta.plot: Julia et Benjamin se rencontrent par hasard et entament une histoire d'amour passionnée, malgré la différence d'âge. Benjamin a en effet 25 ans de moins que Julia. Quand celle-ci présente son nouvel amour à ses enfants, ces derniers se posent des questions sur son honnêteté.

1.title: FR - The Musketeers - S01E01 - Friends and Enemies
1.plot: Young swordsman d'Artagnan arrives in Paris seeking the man responsible for killing his father – a quest that brings him into conflict with one of the king's guards. But as he quickly discovers, when you take on one Musketeer, you take on them all. It's soon back to business when the swashbuckling heroes are ordered to find a missing soldier who was carrying important letters on behalf of King Louis, while the dastardly Cardinal Richelieu plots to increase his political power.

1.title: FR - The Musketeers - S01E02 - Sleight of Hand
1.plot: Notorious criminal Vadim seeks to make life unbearable for the authorities that have imprisoned him. When he engineers a full-scale riot, it falls to the Musketeers to protect those whom he seeks to destroy.

1.title: FR - The Musketeers - S01E03 - Commodities
1.plot: The Musketeers must escort a merchant trader back to Paris and thwart his enemies.

1.title: FR - The Musketeers - S01E04 - The Good Soldier

meta.plot:
En 2040, Agatha et ses deux frères jumeaux Dash et Arthur ont la capacité unique de prédire le futur, notamment de prévoir les meurtres avant qu'ils ne soient perpétrés. 

Sous la supervision de scientifiques, Precrime les a isolé pour exploiter leurs dons et ainsi stopper de nombreux crimes avant qu'ils ne surviennent. 

En 2065, maintenant dans leurs trentaines, la fratrie a été libérée et Precrime démantelé. 

Arthur a malheureusement été séparé de son frère et sa soeur. 

Toujours hanté par des flashs lui montrant le sort funeste de nombreuses victimes, Dash tente en vain d'en sauver au moins une. 

Mais sans son frère, son don est incomplet. 

Un enchaînement de circonstances l'amène à collaborer avec une enquêtrice, Lara Vega. 

Ensemble, ils vont s'efforcer d'arrêter les criminels, tout en préservant le secret de Dash.

2.title: FR - Humans - S02E04 - Episode 4
2.plot: Mia and Ed get closer but their relationship is thrown into jeopardy when their secret is discovered. Toby gets closer to Renie but offends her when he breaks through her synthie mask. Things look bleak for Niska until Laura brings in a surprise witness. When Milo  confronts Athena about her secret agenda, she persuades him her research could be mutually beneficial. Karen and Pete delve deeper into the mysterious 'seraphim' investigation. As Hester's influence over Leo becomes clear, cracks appear between him and Max.

2.title: FR - Humans - S02E05 - Episode 5
2.plot: When Mia risks falling into the hands of a mysterious organisation, she is forced to take drastic action. Odi struggles to find meaning, while Sophie is awestruck by Renie's 'Synthie' lifestyle. As Pete recovers from his assault, Karen makes an admission that rocks their relationship. Hester and Leo stake out the Silo and track down the sniper who killed Ten. Hester agrees to deal with her peacefully, but can she be trusted? Mattie leaves home to reconnect with Leo.

2.title: FR - Humans - S02E06 - Episode 6
2.plot: Athena challenges Milo's ethics and is shocked when he reveals his real plan. Mia's surprise return has ramifications for the Hawkins family. Mattie finds Leo but can she trust him with her secret? Max resolves to begin a new community of Synths; when he learns how far Leo is prepared to go to complete his mission, he takes matters into his own hands.

2.title: FR - Humans - S02E07 - Episode 7
2.plot: When Mattie reveals that the Synths are planning to break into the Silo, Laura is determined to find Niska and ask for her help. Mattie asks Max to help save Leo from Hester's influence. Toby receives a disturbing message from Renie. Karen seeks out Athena's expertise and makes a life-altering decision. Mia and Hester break into the Silo, but things don't go according to plan.

2.title: FR - Humans - S02E08 - Episode 8
2.plot: The acclaimed drama concludes. In the aftermath of the Silo tragedy Karen feels she and Sam have no future and takes matters into her own hands. Niska and Astrid prepare to return to Berlin, but can Niska really walk away from her family? Joe leaves Laura shell-shocked with a frank admission. Hester seeks revenge and will stop at nothing to hurt Leo.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E01 - Episode 1
3.plot: When fractures within the Synth community start to appear, all hope of stability comes under threat, and both families are brought back to fight for the Green-Eyes' survival.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E02 - Episode 2
3.plot: A grieving Max must face the consequences of his painful decision. Laura discovers she's not being told everything at the Dryden Commission, while Joe uncovers Karen's shocking secret.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E03 - Episode 3
3.plot: As Leo struggles to come to terms with being human, Mattie takes him back to the Hawkins' home, where a surprise night out allows them to confront their feelings for each other. Laura is determined to uncover the truth about the too-secret Operation Basswood and tries to enlist Dr. Neil Sommer's help, only for things to take an unexpected turn. Joe reluctantly decides to help Karen with Sam, and Niska receives a mysterious message.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E04 - Episode 4
3.plot: Laura leads a tense Dryden Commission on a visit to the Railyard, but will Agnes' anger threaten its success? Mia comes face to face with Ed forcing her to confront her past, while an evening out for Karen, Sam and Joe turns to tragedy.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E05 - Episode 5
3.plot: While Sam reels from the events of Waltringham and Joe struggles to help him through it, truths are revealed and dangerous plans put into action at the Railyard.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E06 - Episode 6
3.plot: Laura discovers a shocking truth that threatens her life and those around her. Niska continues on her mysterious journey, and must defy all her instincts to survive.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E07 - Episode 7
3.plot: Laura reels from her heartbreaking decision. Niska's journey takes an unexpected turn. And Leo races to be by Max's side, but walks into danger.

3.title: FR - Humans - S03E08 - Episode 8
3.plot: In a dramatic showdown, humans and Synths go head-to-head - but will Mia and Max's peaceful protest cost them their lives? Laura, Niska and Mattie face major decisions.

meta.plot:
Dans un présent alternatif, le "Synth" est le dernier gadget à la mode. Ce robot ultra-développé ressemble tellement aux humains que leur mode de vie en est transformé.

Quand un père de famille achète un "Synth" d'occasion, il espère que la machine le soulagera dans ses tâches domestiques et l'aidera à préserver son mariage. Mais le robot possède un secret extraordinaire...

Remake de Real Humans (Äkta Människor).

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E01 - Behold...The Inhumans
1.plot: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E02 - Those Who Would Destroy Us
1.plot: After a military coup leaves the Royal Family stranded in Hawaii, they must find a way to reunite with each other and return home before their way of life is destroyed forever.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E03 - Divide and Conquer
1.plot: After fleeing their home, The Inhumans desperately search for each other in the wake of Maximus’ coup. Now they must learn who they can trust on Earth.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E04 - Make Way For... Medusa
1.plot: The search for Black Bolt continues on Earth; meanwhile, Maximus makes bold moves to cement his status as the new ruler of Attilan.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E05 - Something Inhuman This Way Comes...
1.plot: On the run from Auran’s forces, Black Bolt and Medusa reluctantly work with Louise to help locate the rest of their family. Back on Attilan, Maximus’ actions change the game completely.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E06 - The Gentleman's Name is Gorgon
1.plot: Gorgon and Karnak take on Auran and her Inhuman army with disastrous results.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E07 - Havoc in the Hidden Land
1.plot: The Royal Family returns to Attilan and comes face to face with Maximus.

1.title: FR - Marvel's Inhumans - S01E08 - ...And Finally: Black Bolt
1.plot: It’s brother versus brother as the final showdown between Black Bolt and Maximus takes an unexpected turn – one with lasting consequences for all of Inhumanity.

meta.plot: Sur la face cachée de la Lune, la cité d'Attilan cache une communauté d'Inhumains vivant depuis plusieurs générations loin de la Terre. Alors que des Inhumains réapparaissent sur Terre après que des cristaux tératogènes ont été libérés en mer, le règne du roi Blackagar Boltagon, à la voix destructrice, est menacé par son frère Maximus, un Inhumain sans pouvoirs qui aspire à ce que ses semblables reprennent leur place sur Terre. La conspiration va forcer le roi, la reine Médusa, son conseiller Karnak et le chef de la garde royale Gorgone à trouver refuge sur Terre, sur l'île d'Oahu, pendant que Maximus prend le pouvoir.

1.title: FR - Criminal: France - S01E01 - Émilie
1.plot: As a woman recounts her memories of the attack at the Bataclan, which killed her boyfriend, detectives become convinced that she's hiding something.

1.title: FR - Criminal: France - S01E02 - Caroline
1.plot: After a casualty at a building site, the team interrogates a construction executive who seems to know more about the victim than she's letting on.

1.title: FR - Criminal: France - S01E03 - Jérôme
1.plot: Summoned to work before dawn, the team questions a sales manager suspected of a violent hate crime. Audrey makes a bid to win the trust of her colleagues.

meta.plot: De sombres affaires se dénouent dans une salle d'interrogatoire de la police parisienne tandis que suspects et enquêteurs s'affrontent selon une chorégraphie complexe.

2.plot: Jérémie is back from her mysterious trip. The joys of homecoming are quickly eclipsed by reality: the gulf between her and her loved ones is getting wider. 2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E02 - Oli is Oli
2.plot: Olivier is trying to escape his past, but reality catches up to him. His family problems lead him to come back to the Domaine and face Jérémie. Olivier couldn’t have guessed that his troubles would be far from over: Maxime has a bitter surprise for him.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E03 - I am your Daughter

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E04 - I Don't Want to Force You
2.plot: Since the death of a swimmer, Jérémie hasn’t been doing well. Max organizes a surprise expedition for her. Olivier is also struggling. His father hasn’t been found and he feels guilt towards Jérémie. Raphaëlle is the only who’s perfectly happy. Only one thing: her boyfriend doesn’t seem to like her friends…

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E05 - How Do I Do This?
2.plot: Jérémie is torn between love and friendship. To prove to her boyfriend that she’s completely committed to the relationship, she has supper with Max and his parents. But Olivier receives bad news and would have needed her… Camille, for her part, has trouble getting respect as lead lifeguard.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E06 - Do I Look Like I Play Tennis?
2.plot: Max tries hard to hide it, but the complicity between Jérémie and Olivier is royally getting on his nerves! Following advice from her friends, Jérémie works hard to reassure her boyfriend. But the arrival of an unexpected visitor turns the lovers’ plans upside down.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E07 - There's No Rush
2.plot: Max has a big proposition for Jérémie, who doesn’t seem too thrilled. Raphaëlle wants to work on her career, but her boyfriend is doing nothing to support her! Camille, completely taken by her relationship with Étienne, doesn’t see any of this. But is he really the right guy for her?

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E08 - You Look So Much Like My Mother
2.plot: Jérémie has all her plans disrupted by Mathieu, who’s embedded himself in her private life. Thomas’s ego is wounded when Benjamin ridicules him in front of his harem. But not as wounded as Camille. She never imagined she’d find herself in this situation! Fortunately, she does not let herself be treated that way!

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E09 - What I Want
2.plot: Olivier’s father is finally ready to see his son again. Olivier is anxious about this reunion. But now is the time for him to face up to the demons from his past. It’s the only thing he can do to regain his confidence, in the future… and in love.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E10 - You Can't Have It All
2.plot: Jérémie feels fragile in her feelings for Olivier. She is doing everything she can to avoid him. An idea from Max is making this easier for her when he proposes a flirting contest between Thom and Oli. Camille is wondering about her future. Studying pharmacology is a simple option, even if it makes her feel sick to her stomach…

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E11 - We're Leaving
2.plot: Jeremiah is forced to ask his father for a favor. Thomas is selected to take part in a preliminary training camp.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E12 - Tell Me It's All In My Head
2.plot: Jérémie refuses to think about Olivier, but, unfortunately for her, everything seems to force her to spend the day alone with him.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E13 - You Ran After It a Little
2.plot: Jeremy wants to explain himself to Max, but he won't listen. Jeremy finds comfort with Raphaëlle and Mathieu.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E14 - The Mistake of Our Summer
2.plot: The mood at the beach is tense. The lifeguards put aside their differences to celebrate Thomas's departure for Stanford.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E15 - Question Mark!
2.plot: The anniversary of Fanny's death shakes Jérémie and forces her to get closer to those she loves, or rather to the one she loves.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E16 - Team Max vs. Team Oli
2.plot: Jérémie hesitates between Maxime and Olivier. Max presents Jérémie with a heartbreaking ultimatum. The friendship between all the rescuers is in jeopardy.

2.title: FR - Jérémie - S02E17 - I'll Wait for You
2.plot: Jeremy wants to change Max's mind. Olivier is growing impatient. Raph makes an important choice that will not be without consequences.

meta.plot: Jérémie avait le vent dans les voiles. Le vent est tombé... Cet été, elle tente de le retrouver dans une base de plein air, le Domaine du lac. Hantée par un douloureux secret, la jeune femme se joint à une équipe de sauveteurs. Son arrivée brise l'équilibre entre Olivier, Raphaëlle, Thomas, Camille et Maxime. Entre les partys, les dates et les escapades, les six amis seront confrontés aux petits tracas, aux grands remous et aux responsabilités du monde des adultes. Alcool, amours difficiles, relations familiales complexes et hormones qui leur jouent des tours : ils exploreront des terrains encore méconnus et testeront leurs limites!

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E01 - The Munaciello Is Back
1.plot: The Wonderboys set off to search for a mysterious figurine in underground Naples.

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E02 - A Matter of Chemistry
1.plot: The Wonderboys join forces with Tonino, while the Old Hag's henchmen are on their heels.

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E03 - The Royal Crocodile
1.plot: The Wonderboys' adventure seems over, but someone at Nino D'Angelo's mansion can help them.

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E04 - True Love
1.plot: The Old Hag searches for Clemente while Antonia, Tonino and the Wonderboys end up in a solfatara.

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E05 - The Mermaid's Song

1.title: FR - Wonderboys - S01E06 - A Magical Night
